text:
I had a fantastic time here on re-opening night! The music choice was mostly all current and modern tracks that still gave the perfect atmosphere to just skate the the night away! Maybe other nights will have another mix of music, they have a good sound system 😎 The rental skates are actually pretty good for what they are, and the price was pretty good for being there for 2 & 1/2 hours.
I really enjoyed the semi retro backdrop and vibe of the building itsself and enjoyed seeing people of all levels of skating enjoying themselves. Absolutely magical when it came time for the disco ball to be on~
Kinda nice note, they also have reffs on the rink to help people when they fall and make sure everyone is following the rules, they are nice :)
I highly recommend checking this place out, I know I will be back as often as I can be!

Skates come in Toddler sizes down to size 7. If your kid is 2, they can most likely skate there.

CASH only - very important to know. Luckily I happened to have cash on me.

Restroom stalls have no doors. Even on the toilets... Know this and do what you need to do before going.
Makes sense for security purposes.

All ages were there and it was a fun atmosphere.

Definitely recommend this place.

Only 4 stars due to limited, poor quality (nutrition wise) food, and no doors on the stalls.

text:
Ordered their mini combo with grilled chicken and kalua (pork) and very tasty! I think I liked it more than the kalua I had in Hawaii. But be prepared, the chicken comes with this yummy sauce (aka yummy oil) that leaked out of the box, thankful for the bag, but it also does solidify after cooled sooo I had a salad the next day to combat that (attempt) 😅

Got the spam masubi also butttt that probably wasn't worth it given it was a lot of rice and not a very thick spam...

name: Drea Park
text:
In Anchorage to help get my daughter settled in for college, and came across this place in search of some island grindz.
Staff definitely showed da Aloha spirit!!  I ordered a regular Kalua pig plate, the portions was so generous, I had to take the rest home to finish off.. food was ono-licuous!
I will definitely be stopping in whenever I am in town to visit my baby girl!

name: Zahby Ellis
text: Have been eating at Hula Hands since before I could effectively communicate. Here's a good story about a past experience: I always ordered chicken katsu as a babe because it's practically chicken nuggets. One day my dad orders the luau pork and puts a small bite of it on my plate. "Try it and if you don't like it you don't have to eat anymore," he implores. I begrudgingly oblige. He says that I then stand up in my chair and slam my fork into his plate. Dad had chicken katsu that night and I had my first full serving of luau pork of many.

text:
The food is only ok, but it reminded our family of the Islands so it was endearing to us. The music and atmosphere really made the place feel authentic.

The shoyu poké is delicious and I'm a huge fan. I've never liked raw fish of any kind and I dislike tuna, but I can tear up this poké.

The kalhua pork was very good, but I'd prefer a side of sauce, teriyaki or barbecue, to come along with it.

The chicken katsu was a hit with the kids.

They let us sub out the macaroni salads for another scoop of rice.

The teriyaki beef was a little tough, but it tasted good.

The kalbi beef ribs were very good.

We'll be back, for sure! Gotta get more of that poké!

name: Ryan Stafford
text:
There are plenty of liquor stores in Anchorage, but the Brown Jug Warehouse is known for having the biggest and best selection of beers, wines, and liquor.  My wife and I bought all our alcohol for our wedding in one stop.  The employees not only located all the varieties of wine and beer, but they also had them ready for pickup.  We had a discount for buying in bulk, so that money went towards the honeymoon.  If you're planning a party call ahead and you'll save time and money.

Love going to this Brown Jug the staff is very helpful and friendly they have staff for each department wether its fine, beer, liquor etc... They always know what your looking for even if you just describe what the packaging or color is if you didn't know the name.

Katrina the general manager is awesome she helps out with literally everything she helps customers find items from each department never redirects a person to one of her other employees, if there's a big line forming she help on the cash registers. Always keeps a positive and friendly attitude when I see her.  She is extremely professional and very personable. Being a store manager can be tough considering the size of the store dealing with large amounts of inventory and staff from top to bottom she exhausts all areas of being a face of a store with that amount of responsibility with outstanding control and ability not to crack under pressure. She is all around solid.

Great work Brown Jug thanks for the help. 👍

name: Sonia Revolorio
text:
I have lived here for a year, now, (came from Houston, TX) and have come to terms with not finding an exceptional Mexican restaurant. Because I've had bad food at Garcia's, Chepo's, Jalapeños, QDOBA, La Cabaña, and Xalos I cringe at the thought of eating Mexican, here. [Note: I do think Tequila 61 has great food but i wouldnt consider it a mexican restaurant since it doesnt serve traditional mexican food]. That being said, my hubby convinced me to try this "new" restaurant (Gallo's) since he thought it was good. I have to say that Gallo's is, by far, the best mexican restaurant, HERE, that ive tried. Gallo's actually tastes like Mexican food and its good. The only reason I gave it a 4 star is because they let me down on dessert. I ordered the fried ice cream, which is ice cream covered with corn flakes and fried. As soon as I ate a spoonful I could tell it wasnt fresh (i.e. the corn flakes were stale). On the other hand, my husband enjoyed his flan. Desserts dont make up a food restaurant so i will definitely be going back or, at least, having my hubby pick some up on his way home since we live in ER. Definitely recommend.
Btw, the plates are big even for my little ones who usually eat up their kiddie plates and ask for more, but not here.

From there on, she kept coming to our table and abruptly grabbed our half eaten chips n dips and looked upset. That certainly ruined the happy atmosphere we were having. text:
Food was good enough, not typically what i go for. My friend got food poisoning, so i took precautions once i heard.
The service seemed a bit oblivious, their menu was Americana at best. The food will make you gassy to the high heavens and back.

I don't eat this style often, closest i get is maybe taco night at home. Therefore, i asked the waitress, politely, as to what some things were and the differences between them. From what i gathered, there was little to no difference; some things had a bag of cheese from Costco on it, while some things were a bit more reserved.

It seems the health concerns of this place are still very real, but there were enough people inside when i went to warrant saying people either like it regardless or have not heard. 3/5 for my experience alone, 1/5 for being a hazard to public safety.

Waiter appeared about 15 minutes after we were seated and took our good and drink order. Finally had to ask for some chips but wish we hadn't. One salsa was too spicy and the other one so over-salted we could not eat it. And, what type of Mexican restaurant has no queso (melted cheese)? Really? You serve melted cheese on many of the menu items, but don't offer it for purchase separately for dipping or pouring? Interesting. Would probably eat here again as decor is festive, music not too loud, and the taco salads were small but tasted ok. Surprised they had such strong positive ratings, as that was not our experience.

text: The visit to Gallo's tonight was not what I expected from previous visits to this location - albeit not recent visits as we don't live in Anchorage so rarely visit it. We asked about what came on the kids burger, and were told it was a plain cheeseburger, only to have it come out with vegetables and mayo. That was fixed. The sodas were never refilled and we got only one water refill. After saying we didn't want dessert, it took 15 minutes to get our bill. And, the additional meal we had ordered to go for our daughter was not included on the bill or provided.  My wife spoke with the hostess on the way out who guessed which server we had, so I suspect that issues with that individual are know and hopefully will be dealt with.

text:

Best burgers in town.  Just get there before 1:30! They use the previous night's filet mignon or whatever fine steak they have left over for your excellent burger.

name: Jackie Willis
text: I feel soo cheated! I've lived in Anchorage for 20 years now and have never made it to Club Paris till today....I've cheated myself of this delicious food for far too long. Just a spur of the moment decision to drop in for lunch today but there was plenty of seating available.  Masks are required to enter. I had the french dip sandwich and everything from the meat, to the slightly salty AhJus  to the "foot-stompingly hot and good" horseradish was amazing. I'll be back again soon to try other items on the menu!

There is a bar with a TV for sports or whatever. The Olympics is on currently.

text: Went to Club Paris for lunch.  The hamburger was delicious, the fries were crispy.  Service was prompt and friendly.  I'll go again to try something different.  It's worth checking out.

text: I've lived here 20+ years, and still find the best steaks, quiche, and key lime pie at Club Paris. Call early to make a same day lunch or dinner reservation and enjoy the entire dining experience from any seat in the house.

text: The best lobster tail I've ever had.  And the steak was really great also . Super nice waitress.  And really really strong drinks or I haven't drank in a while.

name: Justin shults
text: Went here for a great dinner.  We sat at the front of the house and it was pretty good.  The decor is old and a little quirky, but it adds to the ambiance.  Was a little dark, but the lights at the table helped quite a bit.  I ordered a side Cesar salad and it came but the dressing was a little off.  The server was very nice about it and took it off the bill, they even offered a green salad at no cost, but I didn't want it.  Ordered the ribeye rare and it came out cooked almost perfectly.  The only issue I had was they served it on a sizzling hot cast iron dish, which was nice, but it continued to cook the underside of the steak.  The steak was still so tender and the seasoning was delicious.  I had an dirty martini with gin, which was absolutely delicious.  This is a great steak restaurant for Alaska and definitely will return.

name: Theresa Philbrick
text:
Today's review August 14, 2017.
Back again.
Where to begin.
You want a superb chunk of beef and the perfect cocktail or your whiskey neat? Club Paris is  the place to be. Club P. is a well established restaurant that has "seen it all" over the years. It's weathered vegan and fusion. Presentation is clean and uncluttered.

A spiced apple ring and lettuce garnish is a pleasant homage to a by gone era.  Your meal won't arrive suffocating in heavy sauce or lost in the weeds of some grated greenery.

You want pretension? You want  foo foo fussy and frilly? Oh dear god. Please. Stuff that poodle in your man purse, sit down, and don't make it harder than it is to order and indulge in a great meal.

Club Paris is consistently excellent. Beef is their stock in trade. The Bar keep is an adult, experienced, and doesn't surprise easily.

Just place  your order-- don't explain or apologize, he'll whip it out in a heart beat. Food and beverage is NOT complicated for the staff at Club Paris.

I ordered the petit filet, baked potato, and a dinner salad with blue cheese dressing. I reserved most of my blue cheese dressing for my baked tater.

My only quibble. Yes, a quibble but a wee little quibble... Is... Rare steak should be so rare the last gasp of the cow is exhaled with the first slice. I ordered rare. I expected a cool center, but it was warm. However, the steak blade sliced smoothly through the fillet, and there was juice to spare.

I was a cook for 20+ years. I always did steaks more rare than well. You can always sear that chunk of beef a little more. But, you can't ever fix over cooked. Even if they want shoe leather.

An icy cold gin and tonic trimmed out the spread. Chocolate sweet potato pie  and a freshly brewed cup of coffee capped off my meal. I can't vouch that dessert was made fresh on site, I forgot to ask.
Even though my steak was less rare than I anticipated, it was still delicious. Maybe I'm just a picky old broad.

Anyway, Club Paris didn't disappoint. Especially when I got to watch the Yankees Aaron Judge whack a homer off the unsuspecting Mets pitcher.

The review below is from two months ago.
What's excellent:

Cocktails...classic martinis, gin/tonics, even blended pina coladas. That's right...a pina colada. And boy was it tasty.
The bar keeps are expert and no nonsense. Want a good straight bourbon neat? you got it. None of this frilly dilly fancy schmancy stuff.
Steaks. Any cut.

Fish? meh. The fish I don't order any more because it is just overcooked. The blackened salmon was so dry. Did I mention steaks? any cut. They will even cook it to shoe leather if you want...(please, please, rethink this option though). Medium Well is far tastier than shoe leather, even expensive shoe leather.

The only thing missing is the pall of cigarette smoke and booths full of attorneys and politicians from the old days.

name: Boyd Soule
text:
My rating here used to be 5 stars as my husband and I would love to have steak dinner dates at Club Paris often.

On Thursday, July 16, 2020 we had just received our food and a tall Caucasian gentleman (who I’m assuming is either the manager or owner of the place) left from behind the bar area and approached and sat down with some newly arrived guests at the table behind us and greeting them as they were long time friends.  Usually this would be great but by doing so he violated the social distancing rule as he was now a foot away from us sitting behind me.  We were happy to not worry about him and enjoy our meal but his friends started talking extremely loud with him so that the booth in front of us could also easily hear the conversation.

The first thing his friends asked him was what he thought about the newly mandated covid rules to which he replied he didn't plan on complying with them because he talked to his staff and they all felt safe. Afterwards they continued to yell and be completely disrespectful to the other guests as they cussed out our Mayor and the policies he implemented to keep Anchorage safe.

We had maybe taken 3 bites each of steak before we couldn't deal with the vulgarity, rudeness and yelling so we asked for our food to be boxed and the check and left. I feel bad for the other guests and the wait staff as besides that sour experience we enjoyed the few bites of food we had. Sadly  we probably won't be coming back and I feel obligated to lower my review and tell my friends and all guests to visit other places around town.

Can seem a little quirky with the dim lighting but you wont care once you bite into that burger. Located downtown, cant miss the Eifel Tower sign. Trust me, try the burger and you wont be sorry.

name: Anastasia Beaverhausen
text:
Had reservations for 7pm, and requested a booth in the back.  This has never been an issue before today. We arrived at 6:55 and were told that the table was cashing out and it'd be just a few.

text: My first time here during the mandates by the mayor banning indoor dining. The food was reasonably good.  However we were ordered ground beef in our salad and received shredded which included an upcharge.  We also were not informed that using a credit card would result in a credit card fee. Although not unreasonable at 3% (standard rate charged by credit card companies to the business) this is the only place we had encountered the charge and there were no signs or information regarding this charge provided before or during our meal.  We only knew about it at the end of our meal when we saw it listed on the receipt.  While we want to help out local businesses trying to stay alive through all this, correct orders and full cost disclosures are important as well.

resp.text: Hi Victoria, First I apologize you did not get the right beef on your salad.I would like to offer you a credit if ok with you.  The credit card charge, although new, is posted on a sign at the entrance in the lobby and on the bill at the bottom when you receive it.  I will have the managers make sure they post in more places though to help out with letting customers know.  There are A few other restaurants that are charging the 3% - including two other Mexican restaurants.  I think we all are looking for ways to be able to compete and stay open during these times.  Again, I apologize for the issues.  Tj

resp.text:
Hello,
The manager brought this up after you had left and although we thought Covid would be over by now, we were giving the coupons away to customers to come in and enjoy the discount for dine in only.  The server who accepted your coupon the first time did not let the manager know it was for a to go order which it states on the coupon is for dine in only.. but accepted it anyway. Unfortunately, lack of communication on our part led to this..  we decided tonight that they can be used for take out, just not delivery.  I apologize for the confusion and would like to make it up to you..  could you please message us on Facebook and I will  make arrangements to make it up to you.  Again, I apologize for the confusion, we are all just trying to keep our doors open through this terrible ordeal..

I placed that order as I left work(downtown Anchorage). I arrived at Lowes(old seward & O'Malley), about 18 minutes of travel time. I walked in & got the item off the shelf, because I didnt get the confirmation that it was ready yet & when I walked up to online pick up... it was already there waiting & I received the email right as I walked up too. Less than 20 minutes for an online order is quite impressive. If every place was this fast, I think more people would just shop online & then go pick it up. name: Ty Kon
text:
Sure it's a "hardware" store, but that doesnt explain why the staff is so incredibly rude. Let me share some encounters with their staff: 1) Went to get copies of a key made. Was told, in no uncertain manner, I could not have extra keys made due to the particular key being labled "do not copy". After many attempts at explaining that the key I had indicated was not my post office key, but the key to my vehicle I got an "I'm not sure if we can do that." Eventually I did get a copy of my key. It doesn't work, but I got a copy. 2) While shopping for garden supplies with and for my mother, I ventured to ask an employee where to find sprinklers. She gestured wildly around while maintaining the kind of eye contact one makes with something they are about to kill. I said thank you and wandered off to find my mom and tell her we were on our own in our quest for lawn hydrators. We went to the outside portion of the garden center and were perusing flowers when we hear someone start yelling "hey you, what are you doing" so naturally I try to avoid looking around. The employee I had asked for sprinklers comes over and starts to tell me that I won't find sprinklers out here and why did I come out here if I was looking for sprinklers. I said thank you for your help earlier and that I'll grab a sprinkler after I find some plants to add do the yard. That was incorrect of me. So I followed this srange person inside to the aisle where the sprinklers were and then had a lightning round for lawn care. I don't think i did well because I was given a sprinkler that was broken. 3) Landlord installed a fence. Volunteered to stain it if landlord had stain. He said we did, and we did, but it had been frozen and was very much past useable. So for due diligence (and to make the landlord happy) I took it in for a professional opinion, and hooboy did I get one. Trying to get help at the paint counter is...well it's a pain. The particular individual at the counter, was not a human. Someone went and woke up some poor bridge troll, probably to pay off some ancient debt, and he was not happy. I'm a generally polite person, so I say "Hello, I was hoping..." "Hope in one hand." was the response. I say "ok, could you tell me if this stain is any good still? My landlord..." "If you have to ask, it's no good. I'm not even going to look at it. Next." I say thank you for your time (because I'm polite) and walk away. "Your gonna pay for that right? Cant pay for it if I don't price it." So I'm no longer feeling polite and tell him as much followed by a stop me if you can statment. He comes toddling out from behind his counter all ready to give as much chase as his little legs can give, and finally sees the can I have. "We haven't carried that for a year. Where did you find it it?" Still advancing towards me, as if I had stolen some holy reluc of Lowes. I respond "In my damn garage" and walk off, full stride, because I'm pretty sure I heard the pitter patter of little feet chasing me to the door.

So if you want a surreal experience, or enjoy being talked down to, Lowes is the place for you. Otherwise, go local.

name: Mark Haller
text:
I wish there was a zero star review, it is a more appropriate rating for my experience with Kendall Ford of Anchorage. I will start off by saying the two ladies I worked with in the service department were courteous to me. But beyond face to face courtesy, the entire process with their service department has been atrocious. I am completely unsatisfied.

In August 2019 I purchased a 2018 Ford F150 with 12,000 miles. In September the truck left me stranded on the parks highway when the motor completely died at less than 19,000 miles. I had it towed to Kendall Ford on my own dime which was $180 dollars. I never received compensation for the tow. They were also unable to provide me with a loaner until about two weeks after that.The short block was replaced by Kendall and returned to me 2 months later. It put a huge strain on my day to day operations.

After the repair I brought the truck to them for it's first service since the work. I asked them to look into a noise on the motor as it sounded off. Also I was experiencing an issue with the doors not latching/locking properly in cold weather that I discovered has a recall and asked to be scheduled for the work. They charged me and performed the service (oil, lube, etc) and investigated the noise expressing no concern which I found hard to believe. They stated they would contact me for the work on the door latch recall. I went on my way feeling assured the work would be done and motor was fine.

Shortly after the truck completly died AGAIN and had to be towed back to Kendall, the motor wouldn't even stay running. They wouldn't initiate the tow, I had to go through Ford roadside service. This time their lot is so full that it was actually towed to another ancillary lot because they're so backed up on service work. Because of the faulty door latches my vehicle was broken into and I had a few thousand dollars in equipment stolen. Without this vehicle in service my business also takes on a loss.  Kendall Ford offered me nothing in terms of a loaner, rental compensation, or any help what so ever to make any of this situation right. They stated I had to wait 1-2 weeks for a diagnosis on the issue. I am currently waiting to see the results from diagnosis with no vehicle.

I have never felt more let down by a company on my whole life. Our family has worked for and retired with Ford and this treatment goes to show that corporate greed is winning the battle against customer service. I will never recommend my friends or my family to do business with this establishment in any capacity unless they would like to feel completely helpless and disappointed.

resp.text: Mark, we regret to hear about your recent experience with us and would like the opportunity to discuss this with you. Our Service Manager, Mark, will be giving you a call shortly to address these concerns. Thank you and we look forward to speaking with you.

name: derek murphy
text:
I went to buy a used diesel truck. This was a very high pressure salesman. Constantly pushing new trucks with insane finance terms (96 months!). I have excellent credit and didn't need a new truck so I was in no hurry. I had to remind them of this many times.

They finally found me a great truck and I had to negotiate extremely hard to get a fair deal on my trade in and the new-to-me truck.

They were dumfounded when I asked to see the service records for the truck because he mentioned it was a certified used vehicle. He intially refused to give them to me because of previous owner's info is on it. I had to threaten to walk away for them to get any records for me. The one's provided were written on a sticky note! I told him 'not good enough' and finally received something official looking. I was then told that this was unusual and against policy (really?).

Finally I drove away with my truck but didn't make it 2 miles (literally) before check engine light came on and the engine went in to limp mode and died on the side of the road. I was stranded. So I called the dealership and they paid for the tow and gave me my keys back to my trade-in and I walked away. I test drove this vehicle twice to ensure it was in good working order.

Aside from paying for the tow truck, giving me keys back, giving me a verbal "sorry", I received zero follow up from the original sales manager who sold me the truck.

I will never recommend Cal Worthington Ford to anyone. They have terrible customer service and it's easy to see they didn't care abouy anything but the sale.

text: Hit or miss customer service and buyer beware!! I purchased a tablet on 5/2 for my daughters birthday. We opened her tablet on 5/12 and discovered a used device. It had obvious signs of wear and tear, scuff marks on the front screen and scratches on the back. I found it odd that it was fully charged and oddly placed in the box  facing away from the dirty cushiony part. I went back to the store where the rep questioned me like a liar.  He asked why would I just now be bringing it back if I purchased it on 5/2. Basically got the tablet in advance for my daughters birthday which was on 5/12. So yeah she wouldn't had opened it any sooner. The rep agreed to look for another one and basically says we are all out. He did not care nor did he have any solutions for me. I asked if he could order another one so i could pick up from the store and he says nope. He was so uninterested in helping it was ridiculous. I demanded a refund for the tablet and warranty and at least got my money back. Customer service here is hit or miss. DO NOT BUY ELECTRONICS FROM HERE. Even with a warranty you can only send it off for repair. So if there is no damage but its used you cannot get a new one. I think the supplier they are buying from is shady and sending them USED PRODUCTS or they are restocking USED RETURNED ELECTRONICS AND SELLING AS BRAND NEW. Either way I will not be buying any electronics from this store again.

name: john king
text:
Update: I've been wearing these new pants made out of a fire hose type materials and I love them. A ultra lightweight feel and I'm able to move in ways other pants wouldn't allow without ripping the crotch out. My other pants I owned previously have a nice spot on a hanger in my closet.

Interesting story. I was approached by a random larger man like myself and he asked me if I had been wearing Carharts all my life which I have been. He asked me to give Duluth trading a try and if I didn't like it I could simply return it. So I went to the location on old Seward and was amazed by the overall selection of quality products. Met by a very nice person at the door and helped by a professional acting employee for fitting. I fell in love with the pants I bought for work and now have something that moves with me instead of against me as I move. I'm definitely a believer in the company who actually makes clothes to fit us naturally bigger men or women. Prices are comparable to the other type of work wear I'd buy so my budget is the same as before.

text:
Visited here today prior to their grand opening. Wow!!! Every retail store should take notes. Super friendly staff immediately upon entering the door. Spent about 45 minutes walking around and we were constantly approached asking if we had any questions or needed help (in a good way, not pushy or annoying). They have a lounge area with free coffee, free bottled water, couch, tv, and computers to browse on. I am serious. Sweet!

We were informed they also have the only Duluth Trading clearance section in the United States. They just opened and the clearance room was packed full of all kinds of good stuff. All of their gear and apparel is really high quality and really reasonably priced. If you have never owned anything from Duluth, you are missing out. Their clothes are indestructible and comfortable.

If that wasn't enough, we checked out with just a dog toy (coming back for the grand opening) and the cashier applied a $10 coupon to our total, just because. Thanks! Also, check the bottom of your receipt. They have a 1 year return policy.

Super pumped to have a Duluth Trading in Anchorage AND it is done right. No longer have to wait for the long shipping times to Alaska. Bravo guys!

Every single item was suppose to be on sale from the shirts to the soaps to the socks I got with a difference of $18.58, so no telling how many people have paid more then they should have... We called the store back and they stated to bring in the receipt and what info from the website says and they will take care of it... We also called corporate and the customer service had closed already bit the women stated no matter how you buy threw Duluth website or store front the prices are the same. I am very disappointed at this hotel. The heating was not working properly the two night stayed there in March. My lotion bag went missing after I used it in the morning. I called again few hours later, another receptionist said he will look into it and called me back in 3 minutes stating that he didn't find it. Talked to the manager in the next morning,  the manager and two housekeepers said they checked the trash and didn't find anything. The manager kept asking me if I left it somewhere else and she said she believed in her housekeepers; sounded like I made up the whole story.(which I did not make it up!) She said I am sorry but didn't seems sincerely. Also one of the housekeepers left a comment stating that's crazy.
My friend and I did not ask for any compensation. We just wanted to get the problem fixed or get my lotion bag with all the items in it; however, we did not appreciate their attitude towards this situation.
I would not recommend to stay at this hotel.

name: Amanda West
text:
The website was misleading as to the quality of the hotel. The hotel is old and worn and not family friendly at all. The rooms are tiny. They have old wall heaters that keep the room either freezing cold or boiling hot. They advertise fresh fruit on the website and have pictures of bowls of fresh fruit on the breakfast bar and all they had was grapefruit from a bucket (and we stayed for a week). The breakfast area only had one table that is suitable for children to sit at and it only sits 2 people all of the other tables are high bar type tables with barstools. The first night we checked in the hotel front desk person was curled up in a chair by the fireplace, she didn't even acknowledge us until she was done playing on her phone and then just said "oh are you checking in?" She was dressed in black sweat pants with white writing up the side of them (Very unprofessional). The parking is not behind the hotel, it is in a public parking lot around the block. Our room had a dirty wash cloth hanging over the shower. When we turned on the shower the water came out ugly brownish orange. Our television didnt work and when I asked the lady at the front desk to have it fixed I got an  "I dont know how to fix it" response from her. I realize we were staying in an old hotel but the website portrays a classy and quality hotel. This place is old and worn and could use some upgrades but has potential.
So after meeting with the manager I am going to edit my review from 2 to 3 stars. The manager was on vacation at the beginning of our stay and the service was a bit lax due to that. There was a significant difference in service after her return.  I would still say this hotel is better suited for singles and couples. And it could certainly use some upgrades but it has potential as a romantic getaway for couples.

name: Jason Kittle
text:
My wife and I stayed at the Historic Anchorage Hotel and booked their "Romance" package. The package was to include a Jr Suite, a bottle champagne, a round trip carriage ride to Orsos restaurant with $60 coupon.

Checking into the Hotel we were given actual keys. We thought it was all part of the historic charm but still thought it odd. When we finally was able to get to our room and my wife had a very difficult time turning the key to open the door. Once we were able to unlock the door I had to shoulder open the door because it was stuck in the frame.
The room was spacious and had a decent view but it was very cold and i was unable to find a thermostat or a heater. Also found that the deadbolt on the door was not working properly and we could not safely secure the door overnight. We went downstairs to report the door and heat issue. To the front desk's credit (I think her name was Jennifer) she immediately changed the room for us and joined us to verify the new room had a functioning deadbolt.

We were disappointed to find the new room was not as nice and had no view out the windows except for the rooftops of the building below. Looking around the room I immediately found a couch cushion was placed incorrectly onto the couch. Fixing the cushion I found a large amount of crumbs and dirt under it. I also found the cushions to be extremely dirty and in need of a good steam cleaning. I did not want to think about the rest of the furniture that needed cleaning. Also found the bathroom door knob was loose and ready to fall out of the door.

Overall, I see a hotel with great historic charm and potential but there is a serious need of maintenance and a good cleaning.

Next time I will stay at the Hilton next door.

FYI... never got the bottle of Champagne, apparently the hotel no longer has a liquor license. I suggest that they quit advertising it.

text:
Just so you know getting a five-star review for me is very difficult. So if you've earned a four-star review count yourself lucky. The wait staff was super friendly and attentive. He answered all of my questions happily. He recommended an appetizer that was off the charts delicious! Highly recommend the tostaditos! Super delicious and huge! I also got the Tijuana taco which was pretty good but stuffed so full and so sloppy I couldn't eat it like a taco and had to eat it with a fork. I also ordered the fajita supreme with both steak and chicken. It was pretty delicious came out sizzling and amazing only thing is they forgot the mushrooms which was the reason why I got the supreme in the first place. However I didn't realize they forgot mushrooms until we were boxing things up to go. I'm sure they would have made it right if I would have said something.
I did specify the ranchero beans versus the refried beans for the fajitas and they came out refried. But that's not a deal-breaker. I've been to gallos A few times before and they make excellent margaritas too. not this trip but on a previous trip I ordered the taquitos and they gave me the flautas instead only problem with this is that I'm allergic to gluten so I was not able to eat that. They tried to make it right and sent out another plate of flautas 😂

text: Ryan upgraded us to a corner suite which was much appreciated for our two night stay. The price, location, and space was great for our home base while taking in the hot springs and northern lights. Free parking (with outlets!) right outside was convenient. Great eating options near by. The mattress and pillows were a little hard, but I slept well overall. Would recommend to others needing an affordable, comfortable home base while exploring interior Alaska.

name: Norman Tweet
text:
I should note that I was staying here in March of 2021, in the waning (but still active) days of the COVID pandemic. So there was no breakfast available (and if I'm not mistaken it's a cafe, not continental, so you might have to pay for that). If that's important, I'd suggest calling the hotel to ask before you make your reservation.

My other major complaint was the small, cramped parking lot (which admittedly does have plug ins for your car if you're here in winter). I was driving a truck, so there was very minimal room to maneuver. They do have an overflow parking lot, but it's two blocks away so that could be very inconvenient, especially if you have lots of luggage.

Although I was traveling by myself, the hotel gave me the option of staying in a two bed room or waiting till a single was available. I chose the former, since I didn't want to wait. The room itself was clean and fit my needs adequately. The bathrooms don't have tubs, but shower stalls, so that's something else to note if it matters to you (it didn't to me).

All that being said, the rooms were excellent value for the price ($65 when I stayed, although again the Pandemic could be a factor). And it's in the downtown area, so close to many things in Fairbanks. Next time I'm in town, I will definitely consider staying at the Bridgewater Hotel.

I was in here, one time of many, and as i was paying in self-checkout I realized my milk was leaking. Staff was very accomodating in letting me know i was free to exchange it for a different one.

I turn around to begin the trek back for an unruptured milk. A fourth there I hear a loud commotion, but continue. Halfway there I see smoke pouring from the kitchen, but I press on. I reach the milk and hear screams, but I am determined. On my return I hear that all shoppers need to leave immediately over PA systems, but am hopeful for my milk. I reach the front and find my cashier in the chaos, but am unsure she remembers my exchange of purchase. I raise the new milk up, fresh from the danger zone, "i exchanged my milk."

She said, "I remember, you're good to go."

5/5: exchanged milk out while the bakery was on fire.

text:
Pretty average considering the price.

The rooms are spacious but the amenities sparse, and no view in most. The window AC was just powerful enough to cool the rooms in July. The quality of the room furnishings was average. Housekeeping was intrusive, they would knock and enter immediately, without announcing.

The breakfast, if purchased with the room, is not a buffet. Instead, a voucher is given which can be used to get an entree from a limited menu.

On the plus side, the staff was friendly, the location was good, the view of the lake from behind the hotel was amazing. The seaplanes were fun to watch, but they did make a lot of noise in the morning.

name: eleanor morgan
text:
The Anchorage Lakefront to me is amazing I guess maybe more because I'm just going through a struggle in my life battling cancer for the most of my adult life I've had a lumpectomy had a full-on mastectomy I don't know why I chose reconstruction I wouldn't recommend it to anybody especially not after radiation the lakefront is giving me a place to sit reflect with a beautiful view cuz now I'm battling stage 4 brain cancer towards the end of 2017 the doctors detected a brain tumor on my front left alone they said it was 9 mm so used to joke around with my friends telling him don't mess with me I'm packing a 9 mm cuz you got to find humor I try to find humor in everything.
But I'm not here in Anchorage for my tumor having severe belly problems and that's been going on for about a year I am behind on my MRIs for my tumor we were monitoring it every three months it has been it has become hard to find escorts for I live in the small town of Juneau Alaska.
And it's not that my friends and family don't care they do they care deeply a lot of people don't have the words so don't know what to say and I understand that but I wish they would also understand to that I don't always have the right words and I don't always know what to say...
I guess I forgot to mention my stage 4 brain cancer has on operable they said there was no cure they said was no treatment they said I could probably have four to six months to live.
But is you know the doctors and teams work together we had done or I had agreed to do what it's called the gamma knife treatment gamma knife is a straight shot of radiation a very intense strong shot of radiation straight to the tumor and so I'm going to say again my tumors on my front left elope.
the doctor said with the gamma knife treatment it could expand my life spand a year maybe two even if it worked at all.
So I'm blessed to be here I hope to pass the message on to other people battling cancer or any other life-threatening illness I can't find a reason to give up for I hope you all don't either there's a lots of worries there's a lot of things that are scared me there's some things that I wonder is it just all in my head they say what's the temp is funny because well I guess that's where my illness is is in my head so to speak since we are talking about a brain tumor .
I guess back to the question at hand the lakefront is beautiful here ever get the chance to make it to Anchorage Alaska I recommend you stop by and see but I've seen some beautiful sunsets while I've been here and I've seen some beautiful sunrises I've been lucky enough that the weather has been decent hasn't been raining silver casted now I hope it doesn't rain on me tomorrow I guess I shouldn't say me I just hope it doesn't rain tomorrow I have no appointments tomorrow have a clear schedule are a lot of people are traveling some people are out of town some of my friends don't have cars
but I know at least I will see a few I traveled a couple of days ago with no escort this is my first time traveling since my brain tumor without an escort but I have a really great friend here named Bobby Joe who is going to check me out a day surgery she'll spend it 24 hours after that with me I believe is how the doctors are going to want it to go so for that I am truly grateful.
I wish you all peace joy and happiness don't hold things to Heart find a way to find forgiveness learn how to let go and let God.
I'm sorry it took me the time to vent some of my illness here but we got to vent somewhere right.

text: First pros: friendly staff lovely rooms great location. Cons: No room service and the staff have no idea about it. We called three different places starting from the food service number listed in the hotel directory. Second, they have window mounted AC units. This would not have been a problem except in summer blackout curtains are a must. This rendered the ac unit ineffective. Causing it to be on all night and not cool the room at all. The hotel itself is very warm, (understandably so) but the AC unit will only work with the curtains wide open. I would definitely stay in the winter though, and the airplanes are not too loud considering how close to the airport it is.

text: I know I've reviewed this before but since I frequent the place, I'm writing my most recent review.  Although it's my favorite hangout, I still give it 4 out of 5 stars.  The reason being, it's not a great place, it's a good place. It's just a burger place for me but they obviously have other things on the menu.  Not exactly fine dining but nice pub food.  The place is really for travelers and older wealthy float pilots picking up on young servers.  Occasionally you get the folks off the street on spenard coming in drunk.  Most of the people eating at the bar are tourist just eating and drinking there.   The bar is extremely huge (it's connected to the restaurant part).  I personally go to hear live music which they seem to have quite frequently in the summer.  Although I heard that football will drive away the live music and the last thing I want to be around is obnoxious football fans, so I don't know how long I'll be going there.

name: Emily Taylor
text:
The rooms are in serious need of repairs.  The heating system should have and air purifier and humidifier added to it.  The air is terribly dry.
The beds are better than many other hotels I have tried.  The down comforters are wonderful unless it is one with a hole - then the stuffing gets all over.
The carpets could use a professional cleaning - even under the beds (they do move.)  Also, the last time I stayed the garbage containers were still full from the previous guest.
I haven't had any personal trouble with the staff.  They seem very family friendly.
The windows do not seal out the cold.  My window was covered with ice and mold due to the continuous moisture on it.

Amazing, beautiful, and diverse city!!

name: Robin Dern
text:
I’ve been a Jitters customer since the late 90’s and in my 20 years supporting this locally owned business I have never been disappointed. I’ve raised my children on their toasted marshmallow steamers and their lemon cookies and banana bread are guilty pleasures. What I love most is that this is truly a community gathering place. You are bound to run into someone you know or make a new friend if you so much as smile. They host art openings, concerts and have a conference room in the back for meetings, parties or events. The large fireplace is a cozy spot to plant yourself in front of in the winter, in the summer they have tables out front. And on days when you don’t have time to park and walk in, their drive-thru fits the bill. The have games, WiFi and plenty of tables making it a great location for work or study as well. With few hang out options for teens in Eagle River, it is wonderful to know that they are welcome here as well.

Update Summer 2020 - Iced everything is worth visiting their drive-thru even on the hottest of days. Thanks for the lemonade soda and iced green tea Maddie...delicious!

Update Fall 2020 - They have Egg Nog (because, don’t let anyone know I said this, Pumpkin Spice isn’t for everyone). They also have a special this week called the Funny Bunny. I gave it a try and it was very yummy! Maddie took care of me again...we talked about binge watching Criminal Minds and registering to vote (which everyone should do) in my 4 minutes there...she has customer engagement down!

We'd give the food 5 stars! I'm not a very frequent fast food customer, but I might have a hard time resisting this if I lived close by. Everything was hot and fresh. The bun was grilled on the inside, which I love and the burger and fixin's were tasty. I guess the only criticism would be that it was super messy to eat, but that didn't deter me! The fries are made from actual, identifiable potatoes, and seemed fresh from the fryer.  Yum!

They also had a full ice cream/soda fountain/milkshake counter. We had no room left to try one this time, but will make a point of it next time.

The service was not as good as the food, unfortunately. It was fairly slow, and the workers we interacted  with seemed sort of grumpy and annoyed for no apparent reason. Maybe it was a hard day.

We'll be back if looking for a burger next time we're in town!

name: Jeremy Swartwood
text:
Imagine fries that taste like dry hollow soft and stale paper towels.

Imagine a building that looks like the location of a post apocalyptic movie.

Imagine the slowest service you can.

Imagine disgusting buns for burgers.

No need to imagine, just go try Wee B's.

Unsure why they are still in business. Maybe they are just a money laundering front?

They're like the run down bad tasting version of Tastee Freeze.

name: Joe Bradley
text: Just not the same after the owner passed away

name: Nolan Oliver
text:
Simple, straight forward American food. The decor hasn't been updated in decades, but neither has the standards so you get the same no frills, qualify food they've always served. Their burgers are some of the best in town, and Anchorage has some excellent burger places. Staff is always friendly and helpful. Make sure to try their shakes.

There is a drive through, but it's not fast food. Expect to spend 10-15 minutes.

text: I came here expecting some of the best burgers and fries... and left disappointed so disappointed I only ate a few fries and two bites of my burger. name: Shane Mecham
text: Great local burger joint.  Fresh cut fries, great burgers in lots of options.  Great shakes.  Even when busy, food is pretty fast.  Staff is friendly as expected.

name: Becca Hill
text:
DELICIOUS! Everything from the fries made with real potatoes, beef patties that taste like a true American burger, crisp lettuce, juicy tomato, and a good bun makes this our new favorite place to eat.

I wish we would've gone into the restaurant instead of through the drive-thru because inside they have a couple old arcade games we would've loved to play, but next time we will be going in for sure.

The speed of the meal is slower than "fast food" but you definitely can tell your food is all freshly made to order and not just patties sitting under a heat lamp drying out. I would 10/10 rather eat here during every car trip than stopping for McDonalds.

name: Colin Elmer

name: Jerre Hudgins
text: They have tasty food, friendly staff, and a humble yet comfortable atmosphere.  They even have a couple of arcades and a pinball machine for that retro look I miss from back in the 90's.  The pricing seemed reasonable, too.  I would check the place out.  My only minor gripe was that the lounge and the bathroom were a bit unkempt but it was around lunchtime but still.  Anyways, definitely check them out if you're in the area.  They even have buffalo and elk burgers.

name: Nicole House
text: This USED to be the best burger joint in town. I don't know what happened, but my husband stopped by to get us supper the night before last and I can GUARANTEE I won't be going back again anytime soon. The fries were cold, the burger patties were cold and dry, my super cheeseburger didn't have any tomato on it (but my husband's did, so I know they weren't out), and they didn't give us the 4 sides of burger sauce that my husband asked for (and was charged for). In addition, they didn't even give him a reciept (when he requested one he was told it would be in the bag). No thank you.....

It costs like $4 for a chicken sandwich or $5 - $6 for a 1/4 lb. burger (with real burger, not frozen costco patties) If you get a soda and the cheese fries and the 1/2 lb burger I can see it being $10 but I have never gone to Red Robbin or Chili's and paid less than $18 for my food w/out my drink. name: Nicholas Baker
text:
First off, don’t take two stars as a reflection of the food. The Bakery serves really good and tasteful food, the staff is extremely caring and attentive, the restaurant is clean and really gives that hometown cafe feel. But...
The food is extremely overpriced after having moved down the street. I usually get the corned beef hash which is $13 and you get enough food to fill most people, today I got the Volcano omelette—which was really tasty— but for nearly $17 I expected a OMELETTE that would fill me to the brim and put me in a food coma shortly after. To my surprise I received everything that the omelette entailed UNDERNEATH a blanket made up of probably 2 eggs. I spoke with the waitress and explained that I was happy with the taste of the food I just expected: 1. An actual omellete and 2. An omelette worthy of the nearly $20 price. She replied that I wasn’t the first customer that day to say the same thing and she gets that complaint on the regular.
I understand that the expenses of Alaska—food costs, rent, etc— force restaurants to charge customers double when compared to lower 48 prices. But, from when they were located next to Taco Bell to now the food sizes have been cut dramatically while the prices have been increased drastically. Choose to either keep the prices and make the food worthy or lower the prices and keep the food the same sizes.

text:
My girlfriend dropped off my Escape Saturday morning (I'm full time Guard and this was drill weekend)  to have one thing fixed and two things looked at, in that order: there was a knocking coming from the front suspension and after that was fixed, and if there was time that day, IF THERE WAS TIME, could they look at my cooling fan coming on intermittently and my rear wiper not working.

I relayed these instructions carefully and concisely to the person who answered the phobe, named Mike.

At four thirty, a half an hour before they closed, I still hadn't heard anything so I called. I was told they were about to tear apart my rear door/hatch to look at the windshield wiper. I was pretty happy, obviously that means they had fixed everything else. When I asked about the other items, they said nothing had been worked on and we're getting quotes.

This obviously upset me. Instead of following my request to fix the front suspension knocking, they decided to spend all day drawing up quotes for work I didn't want and decided to actually start working a half hour before closing on the last item on my list!

This is also upsetting because both my girlfriend and I work full time, and now we only have one car each. This was literally the only day in two weeks we could coordinate having the Escape dropped off for work. It also meant my girlfriend was stuck waiting around northern lights until I got released for lunch so I could bring her home using our other car.

Instead of fixing  what I asked, and they admitted it would only have taken a couple of hours, I paid them $200 to babysit my car all day and fix nothing.

I've had fantastic experiences at the Eagle River and Bragaw Midas', so I foolishly assumed all of their branches had that level of quality.

I'll continue to utilize the other Midas'. I will NEVER go to this one again.

name: Tahnee Seccareccia
text:
I'm not in the habit of giving 1 star reviews, but I was super dissapointed in my experience with this AT&T store. I was looking to switch from Verizon (as a 10 year customer) to another major carrier. Most people spoke highly of AT&T's phone service. I had looked online to get pricing options, but I wanted to speak to a knowledgeable rep who could answer my questions and guide me through the switch process.

Boy did I pick the wrong store to go to. I didn't have an issue getting someone to help me, but I question if the man who helped me has any sales/customer service training. To start he seem distracted and  inconvienced by my visit. I definitely didn't feel like he want to sell me a service and /or product. Then I told him the reason for my visit and that I wanted to switch and share a plan with someone who has AT&T to save money on our bills. He was pretty flippant and told me there wasn't really a point in switching over from Verizon to save money since they only had specials after the third line was added. I tried to probe more about possible promotions for buying a new phone and coming over and he really just seemed done with trying to help me. And reiterated that it didn't seem like a good reason and I wouldn't have any savings so what was the point (yes, he actually said this). His attitude and lack of service was pretty incredible. As I left, I pointed out to that he never once asked me how much I paid for Verizon, because if he had I would have said I paid more than he quoted for AT&T and therefore would have saved money switching. He was nonplussed and just shrugged his shoulders and said okay.

I left the store and promptly took my service to GCI where I was treated with respect by a courteous salesman who actually took the time to walk me through the benefits and options of switching to them.

They started wandering around i thought looking for the part but that was not the case.  2 minutes go by and they're both nowhere to be found.  Without saying a single word to me.  They vanished.  I expressed my disgust by putting all the other items I was going to purchase back and left the store. Upon leaving I saw the blonde lady helping someone else on the computer. I considered returning to say something to the managers, i'm willing to bet that the managers don't care which is why this behavior exists in the first place.  I've had better customer service with TSA.

text:
Two stars because of customer service. I ordered two chicken strips meals and two chicken sandwich meals from the drive thru. I realized that they got the order wrong right after I started to drive away. So I got back in the very slow, very long drive thru line to let them know. Whoever I talked to on the intercom told me that they just put a new batch of chicken strips in and that they would be out in about 4 minutes. Told me to pull around front and they would bring them out to me. 20 minutes later while parked out front I had seen no sign of a single employee. I did see more and more cars pulling around front to park so the could also wait on their order. Because the lobby was locked closed because of COVID I decided to get back in line at the drive thru. The long, slow line. Once I got back to the intercom I was told that they would be bring them out to me in about 2 minutes. Asked if I could pull back around front. So I did. Another 15 minutes later and employee comes out to tell me he's really really sorry. That is going to be another 10 minutes, but he'll put some extra strips in the box. So I waited. Exactly 16 minutes later he comes out with the chicken strips that I ordered over an hour ago. In the meantime all the original food I ordered was now cold. All I got for my trouble was 4 extra chicken strips!!!
Definitely won't be going back to abbott KFC. It without be quicker to drive to the other side of town.

text: The magic wand Car Wash is a great place to get your ride cleaned up. text:
Professionally run, well equipped and reasonably priced hostel. Biggest complaint is probably that there are only 2 bathrooms for the 12+ people in the group housing options. Wasn't a big problem for me but I am usually up super early. If I got up with everyone else it might have been a bigger issue.

I stayed in the gazebo which looks really cool (and is cool looking in person) but gets very hot (more like a greenhouse/solar oven). I would not leave much besides clothes in the gazebo during the day because of the hear.

I appreciated the large kitchen and zippered/netted "porch" next to the gazebo as I could sit in there and relax without melting or getting eaten by mosquitoes.

There are several things close by. Downtown is 10 minutes by car

name: Mr. Fixit
text:
Three Bears is new.  Opened in December 2017.  The store has a bunch of different things inside.

1. A convenience store that has candies, drinks, clean restrooms, hot dogs and nachos etc. See photos.

2. They also have a great Liquor department.  Bear, wine, hard stuff and more.  A huge selection.  See photos.

3. Grocery store.  Great selection with great prices.  A meat dept (no prime rib), frozen foods, coolers and camp chairs.

4. The outpost is great.  Opens at 11:30 daily and closes at 8 pm.  A great place to gear up for the hunt or get that thing you forgot.

5. An Ace hardware store on the north side.

6. Gas station out front with Diesel and regular.  Good prices (3.12 for 87 octane).  RV refuelling area and heating oil and propane sales.

A great place to stock up when out and about exploring.

name: Paulness
text: This review is down a star thanks to one store employee who feels it's his duty to convey his beliefs in a passive/aggressive conduct.  First, the store is in the middle of Healy, which is pretty much in the middle of nowhere.  So prices are going to be a lot higher.  This store has almost everything for the locale: a hardware store, outdoor supplies, convenience area, and groceries. But the main reason I wont  support them again is because the attendant at the outdoor section/gun counter did not agree with potential customers wearing protective masks during the era of COVID 19.  He might have been able to make a sale on a firearm that day, but instead let me know that I was not "awake" because of my choice.  I choose to wear a mask, it hurts no one else and doesn't infringe on anyone else's rights.  Why he, a clerk that may be knowledgable in firearms but is nothing more than a hourly-waged saleman, feels he needs to demean me for my choice is indicative of the attitude in this country.  So for that alone, I will from now on  stock up on my goods in Anchorage,  Telalkeetna, Fairbanks, Wasilla,  etc, to have plenty of items on hand to preclude using this store.  If I need to get gas, there's another gas station next to 49th State brewery and a Tesoro up the road.  But I wont stop to purchase anything here again.  It may be petty, but the great thing about being an American is I can choose where my money goes and whom to support.  It wont be this place.

This store carries a bit of everything. Needless to say, its a one stop shop. Facility is clean and well kept. Customer service is great. Prices are what you should expect from a store located 100 miles from a major population center. They have a sporting goods store in the rear so last minute hunting and fishing items. They sell all types of fuel. During busy weekends expect a line at the pump. Thier fuel prices are comparable to the rest of the state. When planning your trip, if you can skip the Chevon in Cantwell you can save 15 cents a gallon by using Three Bears.

You will find a lot of the food products are Kirkland brand.

text:
Tesoro "Hub of Alaska" is one of those golden gas stations in Alaska that provide nearly everything you need to get you from Full to your next Empty.  You'll find these gas stations at the end of the road systems and in the middle of no where.  I'm thankful for the employees and owners of these gas stations to make our family trips more comfortable.  I know the tourists appreciate the leg stretching and souvenirs on those long bus rides.  Keep up the great work!

If you're looking for a bible then you'll find a wall of them near the restrooms.

If this review was helpful please click the Like button.

name: David Sanders
text: Stopped here during a road trip to Chicken, Alaska. Great photo opportunities as it sits in the center of Tok, Alaska. name: John Thain
text: Came here for a new key fob for my car. Pricing was fair and staff was friendly. However, the install took a very long time, over 40 minutes. Eventually a manager had to step in. He discovered that my car had a dead battery, and that's why the key wouldn't work. He hooked me up with a new battery and did a very good job installing it. I've installed a few car batteries myself, but I could not have done a better job. I'd come here again for a new car battery. They gave me some discounts/coupons for the trouble. In short, the store manager was great, but the staff could use more training.

text:
I have been to this store a couple of times. The first time was to purchase a new battery for my car. The second time was to replace my cellular phone’s battery. Prices were fair. Service and the work were exceptional. The only con was there were a lot of people waiting in line both times I visited. However, the wait time wasn’t too long since there were a few staffs working as fast as they could behind the counter.

I had great customer service experience both times. Staff were courteous, knowledgeable, and know exactly what needs to be done to get me taken care of. My car battery purchase was smooth. We got the right battery and it works fine. I was able to bring back my old battery and got my core deposit refunded without any problem.

I came in the second time to replace my phone’s battery. I scheduled my repair online a day in advance and got $10 off. I came in the next day and a very knowledgeable staff checked me in, went through all the checks on my phone within minutes, and told me they would give us a call in about an hour when it’s done. Twenty minutes later, I received a call that my phone was ready to be picked up.

They also offer so many products in the store. They have every type of batteries under the Sun. My favorite are Werker Industrial batteries. They last as long as other brands but are a lot cheaper.

name: Margaret L Wiltfong Tovrea
text:
Value Village interior looked inviting and well organized.  Friendly folks at the front end -- so nice to hear a welcoming greeting as you come in the door!
I needed a wool blanket, but wasn't able to locate one today.  Kind of a unique item, so I wasn't particularly perturbed that they didn't have one.
There were a couple of lovely fur coats on the "coats"racks; probably some more I didn't even come across on other racks.  Fun to realize this place can have gems like that!!

name: paul bledsoe
text: It's a great place to go if you are looking for cheap parts for a project. Example: I was putting together a vacuum chamber and I needed to find an appropriate chamber. I found a food storage container that was set up with a one way valve in the lid! It was designed for use with a vacuum packer and was so perfect! Not only did I find what I was looking for I found it on the cheap!  Thank you value village! I give them 4 stars for the wait at checkout. It was ridiculously long. There were employees scurrying about but none that would take up a register and help with the long line of ready customers. I would have walked out but I needed that vacuum chamber bad! All in all 4 outta 5 stars. If it doesnt need to be fast I'd recommend value village.

name: Randy Jackson
text:
This evening my wife went to this facility for a night with friends. At 12:30 she went out to her car to leave and found out that she was boxed in as there were three rows of cars. She the called the facility to ask if they could find a way to get someone to move so she could get out. They said they were unwilling to help and that she should “just go in reverse” or wait until 230 am or if someone moved.

I called the facility to see if we could get it taken care of. Spoke to young female who said that was the case and that she would send me to a manager. I then told the manager the exact same story and she handed the phone to the head of security. I then asked the head of security if I needed to explain the situation for a third time, he said yes since he was just given the phone. After telling him the situation he abruptly hung up because he had to catch a flight. I called the facility back and said I didn’t appreciate being hung up on, she said a fight hard started in the facility which led him to hang up the phone.

Clearly not the greatest service, Also probably not great that a fight occurred at the facility.

1) To be treated rudely.  2) Hair all over from previous guests.  3) To catch covid from the front desk agent who doesn't wear her mask 90% of the time.  4) To catch covid from the many guests lounging in the lobby not wearing masks.  5) To catch covid from the unsanitary self-service coffee area.  6) Housekeeping hounding you to check out 75 minutes prior to checkout time.  7) Maintenance barging into your room without knocking while you're in the middle of undressing.  8) A general manager who doesn't care.

name: Chuck Bradley
text: Embassy Suites is a very nice hotel in Anchorage. It is the most expensive hotel in Anchorage as well. Enjoy staying there wish it was not quite so costly. They have a decent saltwater pool and decent jacuzzi the warm-up after those cold days in Anchorage. The bartender was very nice and extremely busy trying to keep up with all of the orders the night that we stayed there, New Year's Eve. But he did a good job. Those times that I can get a better rate I will definitely stay at the Embassy Suites again.

resp.text: Thank you for your excellent review. We appreciate that you stayed with us at the Embassy. Please return to see us again soon.

text: Nice clean rooms and comfy beds.

text: Hotel was very nice. The lobby was large and inviting and the staff was very friendly. There was a restaurant and bar there with options to tide you over if you don't feel like going out. text: This would be a 5 star but inspite of a great breakfast, the line foe it was way to long and alow moving. Under staffed big time. Other than that, great hotel, great rooms, comfy beds and great amenities in the rooms including mini fridge and microwave. Im sure pre-covid this was an amazing hotel.

name: G Lee
text:
Our card keys wouldn't work to open to our room multiple times.  Finally, one of the staff got us card keys that opened the door.  The room is spacious, there is a long table in the room allowing up to three people to have a meeting, workspace, or working with their laptops.  The comforter was nice and thick with a very comfortable bed.

We were here for a New Year's Eve event.  The food was subpar, the halibut overcooked, the beef had an odd flavor which I didn't care for.  The breakfast buffet the omelette was nicely done.  But other things for their breakfast buffet could use improvement.

name: Evelyn Posala
text:
PROS:
As we walked into this hotel it felt warm and inviting. The staff were polite and efficient...answered any questions we had. The free snacks/drinks in our room & snacks+2 drinks from their hotel restaurant in the evenings was a plus. Our room set up was neat, living room on one side with a tv and kitchen area with a small island that can fit 3 people (includes microwave & fridge). The other side had the bathroom and our room with 2 queen size beds and a tv. Breakfast was mediocre but the lady that cooked my omelette was kind and welcoming! My husband loved the equipments in the fitness room and said it was by far the best he’s ever seen out of all the hotels he’s been to and he’s been in a few fancy/expensive hotels. We slept well so the bed was definitely comfy. Location is great as there are grocery stores, restaurants and gas stations nearby.

CONS:
The sofa was rough and also uncomfortable, we had to put a pillow behind our backs in order to sit comfortably. I’d definitely replace that. The microwave is outdated but works. The view of the mountains was beautiful but ruined by a very big building, traffic noise and small businesses behind the hotel. The towels were old and rough which needs to be replaced as well. One of the windows was missing a screen. The windows don’t have a safety lock so you can open it all the way and a kid can accidentally fall out, we were on the 3rd floor. Walls are thin so you can hear your neighbors chatting. The pool was too cold and jacuzzi was too hot (like burning HOT) but the kids overall had a blast.

My husband and the kids loved it especially the experience. I loved the experience as well! The staff were awesome and I loved this little get away we had but would love it if they fix the cons (other than the view of course). Thanks!!!

resp.text: We appreciate that you chose to stay with us at the Embassy. I am glad you enjoyed your getaway overall. Thank you for taking the time to write your detailed review.  Please return and see us again soon.

The hostess told me to sit at dirty table and was helping other guests while I sit at the dirty table. I had to ask for water and utensils. She helped everyone else while I just sat there. name: Mahana Petersen
text:
I've stayed at the property over the past several years. Each time it seems to gets worse and worse. The parking is insufficient. The breakfast fluctuates on quality. Service as far as room cleaning and timely delivery of extra towels or bedding leaves much to be desired. The last two stays involved unclean showers. They've also taken away some of the better cable channels. As a Hilton honor member I get free Internet but it's slow and spotty.

It's pluses are larger rooms than the newer hotels and location in midtown which is why I give it 3 stars. For a family, you can pack a lot of people into the room. But if you book using points, don't expect any perks like early check-in or late checkout. And if you don't want to have to park across the street  (which sucks during the Alaska winter) then plan to be back at the hotel by 5pm to grab a spot.

text: I had a horrible accident in 2017... My workman's comp insurance caseworker recommended neurovision and dr. Liu. I cannot possibly tell you how much this doctor in this clinic has helped me in the past 2 years...the pain I was in from my cprs in my lower leg was extreme.. I was having suicidal thoughts because the pain was so bad after I had a long series of injections with dr. Liu the pain it's just about completely gone...they are the most caring staff and caring doctors I have ever met in my entire life and I would recommend neuroversion to anybody that is in extreme pain.I thought I was going to have to have a spinal stimulator  or a pain pump at the very least to continue on with my life...but I didn't need to.. dr. name: Renee Whitley
text: I go through alot of pain but Dr. Liu, and Dr. Greg really works with me and are awesome people and I also love the staff are awesome as well.

name: sophia cruikshank
text:
They have done amazingly awesome with finding non-narcotic solutions to pain even after surgical procedures...he was able to keep me up and moving with my family which counts for so much when you have more then one toddler at home. .especially after hernia surgery or having massive dental work done. My body is allergic to most opiates and the fact that he could help with nerve blocks and other things was a god send.  They are simply wonderful people...who have kindness and consideration for families. .as well as compassionately given care that takes into account a patients needs as a whole in life..my life centers around being a mom and caring for my kiddos..not just my own needs.. his help has made our life better as without it I'm sure we wouldn't be doing as well as we are right now.  Being in pain takes away from not just a patients life but also the lives of their loved ones. Thanks to Dr. Lui and Dr. Gail Combs my family has a healthy and active life style as a group with me leading them through camping hiking and fishing/hunting trips which was something prior to seeing him i thought we would have to give up. They do their best to take care of me so that i can be 100% for the people who need me the most daily. . And we as a family are always appreciative for the care they have provided us.

My hands would swell up... daily from the conditions that make joint pain an awful reality to face... nothing is worse then not being able to close your hands in the morning... Which was a daily and seasonally intensified response to Alaska's cold and damp climate...with his injections and other treatments we have managed to keep the swelling down and my body in motion. . I respect a doctor who is not all about throwing more medications at a problem that is causing pain daily. . Because he listens when i talk to him...he and Ms.Combs are able to find a solution that best suits my needs. . And that doesn't cause harmful addictive consequences to my life. I have to say i have been impressed since day one because we had been everywhere and had nightmarish moments in other offices when it comes to injections for nerve blocks and trigger points but dr. Lui is gentle and honestly you dont feel anything at all besides a bit of pressure while they are pushing the medication in to the tissue. A bad injection is a terrible thing because the pain that follows can be felt for weeks. I dont have to worry about this with him doing them because he has the most gentle steady and gentle hands.
I absolutely reccomend him if you are trying to get help without using opiates as they will find a way to treat pain...without them as much as possible..and in our world of modern medicine we need more doctors like them as they are not concerned with just your physical symptoms but also whole body wellness...mind body and soul must be at peace for us to heal...his office goes out of their way to treat patients with pain like people..
And their massage therapist is amazing as well. . He can make your entire body relax through trigger points and that is the most amazing relief i have ever gotten in addition to the other treatments.. as nerve damage can be torturously painful.

Pricing varies:. For each item there is a pre set dollar figure range, within that range it is the employees discretion in how the item is priced.

Let's say (hypothetically) women's hoodies range from 6.99 -29.99, somewhere in that range you will find the price.  Sometimes you see a really sweet deal other times not so much.  This is pretty standard at most thrift stores.

I like the people here, especially Angela(or Angie if your her friend)she has a warm and friendly customer first attitude and I really appreciated that. Thanks for making my shopping trip an enjoyable one Angela!

Like the 120 bucks for western boots?  (I dint care what brand they are! ) Come on people,   let someone find a treasure they could not otherwise afford and you're still gonna make 100% profit. text:
I have had this place cancel 3 orders in a row from Grubhub. First the driver called to say they were only open for breakfast (but dont open on GH until 615pm). The next time was because the driver"s card wouldnt work, but apparently they WERE open and delivering (this was yesterday). I wasnt hungry anymore by then so I preordered for today. Waited in anticipation of a great meal for 22 hours only to be called by Grubhub 10 minutes after my food was due to arrive and told my order was canceled because they arent open.

Tried to call the first time, next morning to catch them during breakfast and find out the situation. No answer. Tried to call today after the 3rd cancellation, 3 times. NO ANSWER. Even tried to call the Millennium Hotel to get ANY information. No answe .

Website states open until 10 today yet I cant get anyone on the phone.

Look. It's fine if you dont want to join the delivery movement, but for GOD'S SAKE take your listing off of Grubhub if that's the case. If you ARE open, maybe get it together already. Doesnt matter how great your menu is if you arent willing to feed people or answer your phone.

I'm OUT.

and I never even had a chance to review the food. I'm truly disgusted by the utter lack of professionalism this business is displaying. I would choose McDonalds over this place. At least they deliver when they claim to.

Normally you could just show your military ID or veteran status on your driver's license and you get a military discount.

But even after setting up the account and finding the card and waiting for the cashier to type my name in three times wrong and then handing her the physical card to swipe they still couldn't find my information. I was been recommended to go over to customer service to correct my information.
10 out of 10 would recommend going there.
