My friend arrives on Saturday only to find out the part was not the right one and the staff even after hearing that this was our only hope, flat out refused to allow him to take the part or have one of their staff do it. They told him to get on a waiting list and they may have got to it by next week.

Our friend had no choice but to come back to Anchorage without a part I have never seen such disgusting customer service in my life and I am shocked by their unwillingness to help when we have basically no money to afford a brand new one and they were all we could afford. I know companies have policies in place to protect their liability but after all this is still Alaska and we are used to strangers helping strangers in times of need I guess the workers at Knik Salvage are too busy and forgot where they live.

name: Robin Dern
text: I’ve relied on the excellent group of caregivers at Providence for years to take great care of me and my family. From imaging, emergency room visits, surgeries and extended stays in their state of the art NICU, there is never a time I haven’t been unbelievably grateful to have such an incredible health care center to depend on. They’ve mastered medicine but also compassion, which is sometimes not the case in healthcare facilities. I’ve never had to wait long for any service and my questions are always answered thoroughly and with smiles. Today I needed a scan and was fortunate to have Dylan taking care of me but most every staff member there has made me feel completely comfortable. On a side note, I’ve spent a lot of time in their cafeteria and gift shop, both unexpectedly impressive. The gift shop has a cadre or dedicated volunteers who work there along side the regular employees, which is always wonderful to see. In fact, there are many volunteer opportunities that Providence has created to allow the community to help those who might be in need. They also have a Subway, pharmacy and a couple of coffee shops in the building. When you are there for extended periods, having these services really makes a difference. They maintain a beautiful chapel open to the public and plenty of quiet places for visitors who need a moment to sit and reflect to find on each floor. Providence is proud of their employees, the services they offer and their presence in Alaska, and well they should be.

Then the front desk girl tells me it’s no problem, I can go to providence express care for my labs. So I drive down there, abs they’re also closed. I don’t think you people could be more incompetent if you tried, it’s almost impressive. Thanks for wasting my entire morning.

name: Tiana Escalante
text: Dr was waiting for test results for a test he didn't order. I was not allowed anything to eat or drink while this Dr waited for a test he didn't order. I had to leave the ER to use my cell phone so I wouldn't be on the street tonight because I'm from another city. I left a note on the bed saying what I was doing and to call me at my number if I was needed. I came back into the ER and was told I had been discharged. The pregnant nurse came out and said they tried to call me. The nurse didn't use the area code though I told her 3 times that she needed to dial the area code. She was rude and said we don't have to dial an area code. After she walked away handing me bogus discharge papers that say my temp was 98.3. I took my temp about 15 min after finding out I had been discharged and it is 99.5. I took pictures of the thermometer in my mouth and the result. I went to the front counter and asked for the lady there to call me. She called and my phone rang. I would have been left very ill on the street with no way to get back to my city if I didnt ask for the social worker to come back. I will die before I ever come to this ER again. I'm on medications that weaken my immune system. I'm making a complaint so no one has to go through what I have. Incompetence at its worst is what I experienced. Except the social worker was very helpful and competent.

text: Do not trust them . I will NEVER go there again !!

name: Florence Bailey
text:
I was recently diverted here from on-base care because Labor and delivery was full. From the very beginning, service was swift and I was taken to the Labor and Delivery triage unit immediately. The nurses there were amazing, friendly, personable, knowledgeable and treated me with the most incredible care. I arrived because I was having early contractions at 23 weeks. After a few hours, I was transferred to the Mother & Baby unit. The nurses there were equally as kind and gentle and treated my situation with such delicacy. I decided then that I would love to have my baby here.
Later on, I was diagnosed with pneumonia, which was he cause of the contractions amongst other things and was transferred yet again to the Progressive care unit.
It seemed that no matter where I went, the quality of care remained consistent and at its highest. I was constantly monitored and made sure that I was as comfortable as they could possibly make me.
I was later transferred again to the Mother & Baby unit once my condition was stable enough and it was there that I remained for the rest of my recovery until discharge. My whole stay was a total of 5 days and I would definitely recommend this facility to others.
It's standard of service is as comparable to those of Hopkins and Dartmouth.
I was thoroughly impressed! Hoping to have my baby at providence once I'm full term.

name: Rebecca J. Wetzler
text: My family became acquainted with Providence Hospital in 1970 when we moved to Alaska and my mom was sick 3 times that first year. They took care of her well then, and in all the years since as I and rest of my family have received services, I know of only 2 less than favorable care among probably hundreds of visits over 45 years. That's an excellent record!!!

name: 713buddy
text: I don't normally do this, however based on my recent experiences at Providence in Seward Alaska, I feel the need to do so.  There is a doctor there at the clinic by the name of Jeanette Nienaber who is without a doubt the most sincerely helpful,  genuinely personable,  completely professional health care provider I have ever had the pleasure of experiencing anywhere ever period, and I for one am so tremendously grateful to have found her! She takes her time talking "to you' not down or "at you", she listens patiently, explains things clearly and completely, and has simply the most wonderful manner. If ever you need to address any health care issues in Seward Alaska, this is the provider you want to visit and trust!  I personally feel blessed to have discovered her!

name: B W Huminski
text:
Recently my son was born at Providence. I have nothing but positive things to say about the nursing staff. They were polite, caring, and compassionate in dealing with my wife.

Having a baby especially our first was a joyful, but stressful time. I didn't enjoy the lactation consultants that kept coming by our room while we were in so called recovery. The were unprofessional and couldn't have been more rude towards my wife telling her if she couldn't breastfeed then she was failing our child. We were discharged on a Thursday with no real tips on how to get our son to latch, just if we didn't we were bad parents. The first night he wouldn't eat anything. We went to our pediatric doctor Friday morning concerned for his wellbeing. He has lost 18% of his birthweight. We got on a program as described by our doctor, and their lactation consultant, by his Monday morning check up he had gained the 18% back and more.

He is now a healthy baby boy who continues to grow and thrive. There is good and bad with every place you could go. Overall it wasn't the end of the world, but they could do better.

name: MissJess
text: My daughter was born here and was diagnosed with anchondroplasia. I was pleased with all the services provided.  I feel like the nurses went out of their way to help me and answered all my questions. The doctors on the other hand were a little overwhelming due to how rare my daughter diagnosis is. They were trying to give us so much information all at once, I was only catching like 1 out of 5 things they were trying to explain to us about achondroplasia. But as soon as my spouse and I explained to them that we needed some room to breath, they backed off and sent just two people in to explain everything instead of 10 different doctors throughout the day. Good place.

name: Laurel Marsh
text:
We have had positive experiences at Providence with pediatricians, and many other doctors and staff. For those individuals, we give 5 stars. We have also had positive experiences with various practices affiliated with the hospital. We are thankful for their good care.

We leave a negative review regarding our experience with OB Triage. At 40 weeks pregnant, I showed up fevering and tachycardic, with complaints of unusual uteran pain two nights in a row. Not once was an OBGYN sent to my bedside. An under-experienced midwife and staff were given far too little supervision, and our family fell through the cracks. Proper protocol was not in place that could have helped protect me and my baby. I was told I had a "little stuffy nose" and was sent home to rest. I had presented with significant markers of maternal infection and never should have been discharged-let alone twice. I suffered a traumatic birth, a severe postpartum hemorrhage, and my newborn was diagnosed with meningitis. Hopefully the hospital has made necessary changes so others do not experience similar trauma. We will be delivering our next baby with Regional.

name: Tyler Cunningham
text:
Huge selection of options, I've tried a few. My only comment is Id like the filling cooked a little more.

The breakfast crepes get things like raw onions and mushrooms that do not get pan fried before they go into your crepe. I do enjoy some sauteed mushrooms and onions in my eggs, but not raw crunchy onions...

I had a Bavarian the other day had things like sauerkraut and bratwurst. A bratwurst just seemed like it was pulled out of a microwave and sliced. When I think of bratwurst I want something pulled off of a grill, or again sauteed in a pan before going inside my crepe.

So usually you cannot go wrong with a dessert crepe, but I do not feel totally satisfied anytime I try one for a meal. I always feel that the inside ingredients have not been cooked together, they have not been sauteed together, they're just individual items pulled out of the refrigerator and thrown into a crepe.

name: Des Walch
text: This is my favorite breakfast location in Fairbanks by far! I want to be clear though that this is not exclusively a breakfast location at all. I just happened to go for breakfast is all. First off, they have a very large menu of all kinds of crepes. I was actually taken aback a bit with the unexpected variety that was available! They have a breakfast crepe menu, but I instead opted for a savory a savory ham and smoked gouda crepe to start off with. I followed it up with an amazingly delicious dessert crepe consisting of a creme cheese filling with blueberries and sliced strawberries. It was really good! The chef even came out personally to see if I was ready for the dessert crepe to be started before making it, so it was timed perfectly after I was finishing my ham and gouda crepe. This restaurant is in my top two places to eat so far in Fairbanks. Unfortunate, I haven't been able to go back since. They had to close temporarily for a maintenance issue with their heating. I'm getting hungry again just thinking about it as I'm writing this review though.

resp.text: Thank you so much for that great review Des. We appreciate your support.  Our maintenance issue is resolved,  so next week we will be open for our normal business hours.  We hope to see you soon and have a great day!

name: Ryan Alverdes
text:
After having some pretty disappointing food on our trip to Fairbanks (no disrespect, Fairbanks, but I hope we just didn't find the good options), we came here for dinner on our last full day.  It was simple, but kind of perfect.  It wasn't just the contrast that made it stand out, either.  I started wondering how I could start a place like this back home, which I will admit to doing a couple times in the past, but it isn't a regular occurrence.
Honestly, we were cautious in Fairbanks.  We wear our masks everywhere, not because we are worried for ourselves, but because it is the socially accepted right thing to do right now.  We walked into several places and felt unwelcome, mostly related to this.  We felt more welcomed here than anywhere else we went, and that meant a lot.  The food was excellent, as well.  As I said, it is simple, but it is done right.  The ingredients are fresh and balanced, and so is the menu.  The options range from vegetarian and healthier to more indulgent.  It was not a difficult decision to go back the next day before our flight home for lunch, and we won't make another trip to Fairbanks without stopping here.

resp.text: Thank you for that great review Ryan! It makes us very happy that you enjoyed your experience with us so much. We really appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again,  next time you come to Fairbanks. Have a great day!

text:
This place is excellent. The moment I stepped foot into the building I was greeted by happy staff - the cook and cashier in particular. They welcomed me and told me to ask away if I had any questions.

I ordered the creme brulee crepe with strawberries & blueberries ($8.50) and got my order to go. I sat down and admired the interior and its surprisingly vast amount of seats, brightly colored walls, and happy music. The room next to me was filled with happy locals munching on their crepes and playing board games or reading books. There was no lack of energy and it seems like this is the perfect spot for a date or hanging out with friends.

Just before my order was ready the cook hunted me down and asked if I wanted whipped cream on my to go crepe - which he advised against if it wouldn't be eaten in the next 10 minutes. I took his advice and skipped on the whipped cream.
It was very kind of him and He seemed to really love his work and value his customer service.

When I finally did get a chance to break into the crepe I found it to be so beautifully wrapped and dainty with its fruit pieces on top. I gave my husband the first bite - which went from "okay thanks" to full on devouring half of the thing as fast as he possibly could. He LOVED it.

We will definitely be coming back here to try all the other delicious creations on the menu. A big thank you to all the staff who made my day with their sweet food and even  sweeter smiles. :)

resp.text: Wow! Thank you for the great review! Reading this makes all our hard work and efforts totally worth it! Once again thank you so much and we look forward to seeing you again!!!

text:
Delicious, affordable, fast, friendly. This place delivers on all the promises of a restaurant. Service is exceptional. Place is filling up on a rainy Friday morning and I can hear lots of yummy noises emanating from the rest of the people here.

I had the mushroom, egg and cheese breakfast crepe. Lightly seasoned in an Italian style. Very good texture and flavor. Certainly filling.

Also ordered the Cuban coffee which comes in a tiny espresso cup because it's so strong. Free refills so you can play with how much sugar you put in (muy azucar=muy authentico) and find out just how Cuban you are.

Dessert crepes look amazing. I may ignore my contentment and lose myself in the decadence.

name: Klara Kautz
text: This was the worst motel/hotel experience I've ever had. My partner and I just moved and purchased a new bed. Unfortunately, the delivery of our new bed was delayed a day and we found ourselves with only the floor to sleep on, so we decided to find a hotel for the night. When we arrived at La Quinta, we told the folks at the front desk as much and asked for a room. I had also called asking if they had a room with a big bed available. They said  yes and when we arrived, I mentioned I was the one who had called about ten minutes prior. Even with all of this information and the rainbow Pride masks my partner and I were wearing, the homophobic receptionist put us in a room with two queens instead of a single king bed. Even if they were somehow confused, maybe because they lacked a well-rounded and cultured upbringing, they should always ask to clarify rather than assume. Rather than argue with the likely bigoted and unaccommodating receptionist, we decided to cope and squeezed into one of the queen sized beds because it was at least still better than the floor, I guess. When we woke up, we found breakfast was what a first grader might expect from a school cafeteria. In fact, I am certain the small cup of odd tasting, sour orange juice was the same stuff they gave us in elementary school. The $2 breakfast and awful customer service have left us certain to look elsewhere going forward. In the future, we know to check in with the local LGBTQIA+ community to know where to take our queer dollars. What a shame a restful nights sleep could be so soured.

resp.text: Klara, I would first like to thank you for taking the time to leave us feedback about your recent stay with us. I'm extremely sorry about the miscommunication about the size of mattress you and your partner wanted. I want you to know that this wasn't intentional and our front desk clerk must have misunderstood. Also, I can assure you that our front desk staff are not homophobic. We are sincerely sorry that you got this impression. We welcome everyone to our hotel and strive to provide our guests with the best experience possible. I'm very sorry that we failed to do this during your stay. Please know that our entire staff is aware of your review and would love another chance in the future to show you what  the La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham here in Fairbanks is all about. Our staff looks forward to exceeding all of your expectations and provide you with the value and service you expect and deserve. Thank you Klara and we hope to welcome you and your partner back soon.

text:
This hotel appears recently renovated, has nice asthetics and complimentary breakfast and WiFi. The rooms are comfortable and it has a laundry room and modest gym.

I can only give the hotel three stars, however, and that was thanks to the intervention of the general manager. In short, my room was frequently not cleaned or only partially cleaned (some trash not taken out, or towels not replaced, etc) and on one night a member of the hotel staff attempted to enter my room at 1 in the morning to see if it was occupied, only being stopped by the latch on the door. The ensuing thud woke my dog, wife and children up and was obviously disconcerting.

After the ordeal, the general manager was kind enough to compensate me for my troubles by giving me 2 nights free at the hotel. I don't believe my experience is universal and I was just unlucky. That said, I wouldn't recommend it to my friends, but I can't say it's a bad place to stay the night when everything is operating as it should.

I'm glad our general manager was able to make this right for you and your review has been shared with our team. We do hope you give us another chance in the future to show you what we're all about. text: Finally!!! Having traveled over 40 years for work in 32 states and staying in motels most of my life, La Quinta, has nailed it. Pets stay FREE! Finally someone recognizes my ENTIRE family and does not FINE me with a fee.. The rooms and grounds were very clean, a place for smokers outside ( I dont smoke). A nice park like area for my dogs to do there business that is cleaned of past animals. The rooms, you nailed it. Multiple Cords next to the bed for my phone and tablet. USB ports as well as electrical outlets on top of nightstand. Tv, micro, mini fridge as well as a decent tv. Beds were very comfortable and a large bathroom with tub. Large lobby and free breakfast. I have been in some of the worst and fanciest motels across the country and while of course this is not the Hilton or the Ritz, it is not supposed to be, however this is the very highest end for the business and on the go vacation minded traveler. The staff were great as well. Corporate gives me options on where I can stay, when on business and vacation with my family, La Quinta will be my first choice. Thanks again.

I love this place!! The bread, the food, the drinks, the service and atmosphere. It's all amazing and I have never had a bad experience out of all of the times I have come to eat here.

They take all of the COVID precautions. You have to wait outside/in your car until your table is ready in order to adhere to social distancing. Everyone is properly wearing masks.

Everything was amazing! Love that Cactus Flower (fried onion); I had the Road Kill with baked potato and green beans. All excellent! Couldn't finish my meal I was so stuffed.  My wife had the top sirloin with salad and mac n cheese, and my daughter enjoyed chicken strips with mac N cheese. And ate at least 3 dinner rolls.
We all loved our meals. Worth checking out! It's  now one of our favorite restaurants.

Only 1 issue, the higher corporation management took away the huge song selection and line dancing. You’d think since it’s been in the single digit temperatures for the past 3 weeks in Anchorage, that the beer would be cold, but no-the slow waitress kept serving me warm beer. That was a waste of $7 because after 1 sip, I couldn’t drink anymore...
The salad came out with pieces of lettuce hanging over the sides of the bowl.
My steak meal was over seasoned with salt...
My wife liked her chicken fried steak, but her side dishes were also very salty...

Our worst experience in a very long time at any restaurant. Good bye Texas, we won’t be back...We’ll stick with Cattle Company & Outback From now on...

text:
Contrary to popular opinion...I was not a fan of the Texas Roadhouse. The overall experience was disappointing but not "never visiting again terrible".

For the most part, for food was fantastic...the bread rolls were exceptionally good and taste very good with the honey cinnamon butter.
However, the chicken sandwich was a major disappointment for the meal. It was very hard to eat and the chicken was very dry.

As for the service, it was good and we had no problems with our visit.

The atmosphere was another story. It is very loud and for most of the meal the music was too loud. When a birthday comes, the music cranks up in volume which is quite annoying.
Also, the line dancing seemed forced and didn't add to the experience.

Overall, I'd go back...but will be aware of what to expect.

This was my first time at a Texas Roadhouse and it was awsome.  The service started when I first walked in and it continued until I  was at the door at the end of our dinner. We ordered the onion for an appetizer and I got a fancy drink that I don't remember the name but it was delicious.  I ordered the Ribey and a side of ribs with onions and mushrooms and a baked potato.
It sounds like a lot of food and it was so I packed 2 to go containers.
Since I didn't eat all of my dinner I had room for desert so I ordered the apple pie w/ icecream.
It was all cooked perfectly and I will make sure to eat there again.

text: Received a gift card for Christmas. Texas Roadhouse is not a place I would normally go, but I thought I wouldn't let the card go to waste. I am livid that I had to pay for this "dinner" that I would otherwise never want. I checked this gift card online (unearthed the pin which obviously was never even checked) and the Texas Roadhouse website says the card has a balance of $50. What a rip-off! name: Steven Exelby
text: It was so nice to go to one of our favorite restaurants.  We haven't done much sit-down in this time of pandemic.  Everything we had was great.  I had the fish and chips.  The slaw and seafood chowder that came with it were terrific too. And of course,  Glacier Brewhouse bread pudding for dessert.  Thank you for a very nice experience!

name: Amy Morrow
text: This place had fabulous service when my friends and I went! Extremely delicious food and beautiful atmosphere! I would give this more stars if I could!

name: Brian Knisley
text: Staff was friendly, prompt, and courteous. Food was excellent. Only seating at 50% capacity for Covid reasons, which added to the relaxed, almost cozy atmosphere of the restaurant. Definitely will go back and recommended!

name: Angel Gonzales
text:
Glacier Brewhouse is a nice restaurant, with good customer service. The ambiance is there, and I like how you can see the chef's cooking. The food is good, but not as good as the prices are high. However, their non-alcoholic drinks are amazing!

They are definitely taking COVID-19 precautions by requiring reservations, wearing masks, sanitizing, sanitizing stations, and social distancing between tables.

name: DAVID PEASE
text: Awesome atmosphere. Open kitchen so you can see the chefs preparing your food. The will fill growlers. Burgers are sooo flavorful, but my personal favorite is the ahi tuna. Perfectly seared with the best wasabi aioli on rice.

name: Kim P.
text: This was our first visit here! Our waiter was fantastic and gave us great recommendations on what to order. We split the Mac and cheese appetizer and holy yum. It is the main reason we will be returning! Best Mac and cheese we’ve ever had! My husband got the jambalaya pasta and loved it. I ordered the herb crusted halibut. Wasn’t bad but I’m not writing home about it. We’ll be back for the Mac and cheese!

name: Cassidy McCaslin
text: They serve good quality food and the servers are very warm yet professional. I don’t find it the most exciting restaurant, but it is a nice place to go to have a nice  dinner or breakfast with friends and family.

name: Executive Thrillseeker
text: Ate here yesterday and what a time we had.  Jane our server from the get go was extremely welcoming And helpful from items on the menu to recommending things to do during our trip.  The beer flight was great as was the double dip chicken sandwich, calamari, and seafood chowder.  Will definitely return during this trip.

name: Melody Willis
text: Such amazing food! The seafood tower is awesome! Drinks are bomb. Definitely delicious.

name: Jennifer V
text: I don't eat steak very often. I just had the best steak I've ever had in my life here at Glacier Brewhouse. Awesome service, great atmosphere, strong margaritas (sorry I don't drink beer) can't wait to go back

name: Michael Tierese
text: We just had a amazing brunch from glacier brew house, this is not our first time here and like always they have impressed. We had a amazing bread pudding that melted down my throat. Thank you to our server Scott, not only was he an amazing server but a great problem solver also. Thank you again.

name: Emily
text: Delicious seafood!  Everything was delicious, beautifully served and generous portions.  Excellent service!  Packed and busy without feeling too loud or uncomfortably crowded.  It was a congenial environment.  Prices reasonable for the high quality food and generous portions.

name: Shah Pez
text: Local haunt which is always busy!   Great food selection,  and the olive oil they leave on the table is a great quality extra virgin olive oil with that bit of natural spiciness.  Make a reservation or plan on waiting an hour to be seated.

name: Donna Case
text: New years eve my family 👪  of 3 was able eat 5 star food for under 100$ I woud say that is a 5 star rating in itself. The food was phenomenal 😋 🙌 😍 👌 A1 The ribeye amazing. The burger was even better!!!

name: tessie estes
text: Amazing beer, appetizers and main dishes with quick and great service.

name: Gretchen Christensen
text: The staff was friendly and attentive, I sat at the bar went on Sunday to have build your own bloody Mary was wonderful.  Also had a cup of seafood chowder I suggest getting the bowl was amazing.

name: Malinda Patterson
text: This place is fantastic! Our beer was delicious and the halibut that I ordered was incredible. The service was also very good. Only positive things to say about our experience here! I highly recommend it.

name: Weston Iannone
text: Great food and drinks in a more formal/sit down brewery atmosphere.

name: Erin Maines
text: Glacier Brewhouse has become a favorite of mine for drinks and dessert in downtown Anchorage. I'm a fan of their oatmeal stout, but they have plenty of cocktails and wines to suit every taste. Their desserts are large and rich, so I usually order one to share. Their peanut butter pie is amazing 😍 Laid-back late night spot perfect for a couple of drinks with friends.

name: Alexander
text: What saves this review from 1 star is the fantastic waitress we had aside from that there was a lot of waiting. We called 5 mins before heading to the restaurant for reservations and a table but was told there was no waiting time three times, 5 mins later when we arrived we there told to wait and waited over half an hour for a table. Later between sitting and getting our appetizers there was another half hour wait. After our appetizers it took almost 40 minutes to get our entrees. In fact everyone in our party noticed two other tables seated after us get their entree and desserts before we even got our entree. And they didn't even come at the same time, one person in our party got theirs 5 minutes after the rest. After spending over 2 hours waiting we skipped dessert since our parking spot was only for two hours. The waitress was very nice though and the halibut and rock fish were good. Wish I could give a better review but the amount of waiting was too much.

name: Ron Jensen
text: Very Alaskan themed.  Nice atmosphere and fireplace.  Alder wood cooked steaks and seafood with wood cooked vegetables and sides.  Lots of in house crafted brews.  Try the sample tray.

name: Remo Dela Cruz
text: Mediocre at best for the price you pay. The staff was pretty attentive although they were sort of off their game in the beginning. Tried to get a table next to the fire place but initially had a little bit of a hard time in getting the staff to do so. Food definitely has some room for improvement. Nonetheless, the interior looks nice and well-decorated.

name: Mark Antilla
text: The rotisserie chicken was good.  It was an interesting flavor that tasted like ham.  The fries are slightly spicy but taste good.  The smokey atmosphere smells great.

name: Jason Williams
text: The food was awesome.  I got the 16oz Ribeye and my wife got the Flat Iron.  Both were cooked perfectly and very tasty.  Also got the cornbread that was also very good and the very delicious peanut butter pie for dessert.  Very good meal and pod service from our waitress.

name: Mark Hamilton
text: One of my favorite restaurants in Anchorage, definitely my favorite downtown. The food is amazing! I've never left there unsatisfied. The only caveat is that it's pricey: but you get what you pay for. I wish I made enough money to eat here every week.

name: Steven Smith
text: Place was packed and wait was over an hour, but we opted for the bar area which had lots of seating.  Even though they were packed, the server was attentive and friendly.  Food was good.  We were pleased. :-)

name: Margarita Z
text: Tasty meal and very cozy place. The steak is perfect! You should be carefully - some dishes are space.

name: Julie Winter
text: Our Lyft driver said this is the best food in town. Locals and tourist, huge alcohol selection with entire menu for whiskeys. Huge beer selection and decent wines especially by the bottle. Fresh fish was so fresh and steaks looked delicious too. Save room for the peanut butter pie as it was "life changing". (Quoting people next to us and confirmed with our own order) get the salmon dip before you order. It was good enough to lick the bowl.

name: NOS
text:
Best seafood I've ever had. Anchorage offers surprisingly high quality seafood at a very reasonable price (partly because there's no tax) And I'm comparing to cities with strong seafood culture like Boston, Seattle, and Honolulu.
Despite the very good dining experience we've had at this place, I couldn't give it five stars because their steaks are always overcooked and cooked unevenly. You have to ask for one or two levels lower to get the doneness you want (e.g. their 'medium' is actually medium-well or even close to well-done). I really hope they address this issue because it's a waste of the high quality beef they use. Nobody wants dry aged Prime grade steak well-done!

name: David Maddison
text: You’re going to track me down and thank me for telling you to come here to have the bread pudding - there is a god! This thing was amazing - the bread, the custard, the candied pecans 😍 service was super friendly and we had plenty of recommendations for great beers.

name: David Maddison
text: You’re going to track me down and thank me for telling you to come here to have the bread pudding - there is a god! This thing was amazing - the bread, the custard, the candied pecans 😍 service was super friendly and we had plenty of recommendations for great beers.

name: Craig Aitchison
text: Great service! Fantastic bread pudding!

name: Doug Williams
text: The food is great, and the staff is always friendly. They need to bring back the 7 layer chocolate cake.

name: Matthew Muir
text: Former title holder of best fish and chips in Anchorage. Now decidedly mediocre. Everything else pretty good. Good drink menu.

name: Doug Williams
text: The food is great, and the staff is always friendly. They need to bring back the 7 layer chocolate cake.

name: Jennifer Chase
text: Glacier Brewhouse is always good never had a bad exp one time service was a bit slow but other than that it's awesome.  It's on the expensive side but you get what you pay for.

name: Mark Kirven
text: Pretty good, it took almost an hour for the food to come out.

name: Wendy Z
text: The crab leg is very good, but a bit pricy, $69. Environment is good, service is nice.

name: Ryan Arave
text: Glacier brewhouse is definitely one of the best places in Anchorage. I've always had great service, and If you go make sure you get the calamari!

name: Bob Chan
text: A very cozy restaurant in the heart of downtown. Service and was relatively quick and good. The food was also very delicious

name: Rod Langevin
text: Wonderful atmosphere, great food and tasty beer. I love this place. I only wish they had a restaurant closer to me so that I could visit weekly. I liked it so much that I went twice in two days.

name: pramod mallya
text: Had the Chilli lime shrimp and a blond ale. Was decently priced. And love the ambiance and atmosphere.

name: Kristina Scholtz
text:
Smoked Salmon dip and stout beer for lunch as pictured .
Amazing service.  Sat at the bar and charged with the bartender.  Very nice.  Had me sample beer until we found one that worked for me. I managed to take a while on that one! Lunch menu was varied and locally sourced.

name: Casey Tobia
text: Great atmosphere... great service... great food

name: Mytink Seventytwo
text: 1st time there. Food was great. Rosemary potato bread with fig butter n chive butter, Bering Sea Red King Crab dinner. I would go again

name: Niles Laschober
text: Shout out to the cooks and lead Chef. Always great food. Even if it’s a type of food I don’t normally care for, I’ll give it a try because I know I will not be disappointed. Good beer and wine selection and their mixed drinks are on point. Nice warm atmosphere with the big fireplace in the center of the restaurant.

name: Melissa Tuttle
text: Awesome service!

name: Bridget Coolick
text: Fun and bustling lodge-type atmosphere to grab a drink, eat a tasty appetizer and meet other tourists. Great service.

name: Alexis Fay
text: Really beautiful restaurant and brew house downtown. Excellent selection of beers and good sized menu. The star of the show for me was the seafood chowder. Don’t miss it. We also had a nice wood fired pizza and dessert.

name: Rick Nobers
text: This is my favorite restaurant in Anchorage.  Great location. Busy but good service. Like the decor. My waitress recommended the seafood chowder and Rockfish plate. Both excellent and worth a go.

name: Alexander Medvedev
text:
Amazing place to eat. Best selection of alcoholic beverages. Food always amazing and great service. Easily top 3 in Anchorage Alaska.
1 star short for Making reservations and being stuck sitting with those that walked in.
All times we reserved always had half hour to hour wait for our "reserved" table.

name: Craig Aitchison
text: Great service! Fantastic bread pudding!

name: Caz Bevan
text: This is very pricey for what it is. $49 for a salad, shrimp and grits, and one beer. Before tip.

name: Ryan Grzes
text:
Great location and Great food / beer.  I had an alder wood smoked prime rib and paired it with some barrel aged stout beers.  Both were excellent!
Prime Rib was perfectly cooked and the beers were aged nicely!

name: B W
text:
Had to send my steak back twice because it was cooked incorrectly, and our appetizers arrived after our entrees.
Rudest manager I've ever dealt with. Didn't catch her name, but she's the 350lb platinum blonde.
There are definitely better places to eat in downtown. Save yourself the headache.

name: Brittany Worden
text: Food is very very good and definitely worth a stop in to try, the service however is slow and it averaged about 10 minutes to get a drink that you ordered. I would be willing to stop here again and hope for better service.

name: Sheila Snell
text: I love their shrimp and grits, potato nachos, and jambalaya.  Great place and my favorite.

name: Kenneth Mills
text: Amazing food, great service, good beer.

name: Mike MacEachern
text: Great place! Service was excellent, and I can't even describe the food. Definitely have the seafood chowder! The hefe was good enough for two points, plus a growler. Price was very reasonable, too. Between me and my wife, had 3 hefes, the mushroom pizza, the sausage pizza and the chowder, and everything was excellent. Looking forward to our next trip to Anchorage to come back again!

name: Donald Gerhart
text: The Brewhouse was good, but I expected better. The steak was fatty and not exceptionally flavorful. The wait staff were attentive as well as beautiful. However, the service out of the kitchen was poor. It was obvious that the manager was trying to get things moving, but not succeeding.

name: Matt Boron
text: This is a great place to go. Good craft beer and great food. It is always very busy. Reservations recommended. A must do in Anchorage.

name: B D
text: Nice atmosphere with Alaskan decoration.  Love the big fireplace! There is normally a wait but it isn't bad.  The staff is friendly and attentive. They have a variety of items on the menu.  The seafood options are good however nothing outstanding.  It is a solid place to take visitors.  You will find a lot of tourists eating here during the summer.

name: Norman Payne
text: Great food and drinks. Not the cheapest place, but you definitely get what you pay for. I recommend making a reservation for so you don't have to brave 1 hour waits.

name: Lerner Sarno
text: Every single dish I've tried here is amazing

name: thehuston
text: These guys always go above and beyond. The food is always delicious. They try very hard to make the food fantastic and it does not go unnoticed. Great job as always.

name: Zee Cale
text:
King crab, halibut and salmon are really fresh and tasty
Great ambience
Service is great,
I ordered seafood chowder, but it didn’t come with the dishes , so when I was about to leave,
they noticed and gave me a small cup of seafood chowder to go for free!
Recommended

name: Don Bracchi
text: A lively spot with excellent food and attentive wait staff. The seafood chowder was one of the best I have had. Beer choices are brewed on the premises. Quite expensive but might be worth the splurge.

name: James Davis
text: One of the best meals I have ever had. Alaskan salmon is truly amazing. Staff were great too!  If you want a great Alaskan fish meal - this is a great place to check out!

name: Brianna Moxlow
text: Wonderful and beautiful restaurant. My family loves coming here and the service is amazing. Only downside is the high prices.

name: Jason Tomberlin
text: One of the best casual restaurants in Anchorage. The service is always fantastic, the food is very good. They have a full bar and local brews. I have a favorite dish, jambalaya fettuccine, my wife tries different dishes and has never had a bad one.

name: Sierra
text: Best restaurant in all of Alaska by far.

name: Nancy M
text: Seafood chowder + potato bread = ❤

name: Daniel Jedlicka
text: The service was a little slow. The portions were huge and had unique flavors for Anchorage.

name: Andrew Scott
text: The salmon and halibut is in my opinion the best in town. The wait for seating can be up to 45 minutes during peak times, but they give you a buzzer, and during business hours there are gift shops to browse through that contain Alaskan rarities such as mammoth tusks, locally hand crafted specialties, Alaskan gold nuggets and  Alaskan made jewlery. A bar with menued seating is available if you are alone or if your group is willing to sit with the crowd. Small plates are available as well as pizza and soup of the day. The kitchen is open so you can see your food being prepared. There's a fireplace centrally located, and a private room to the back for large gatherings or meetings.

name: Daniel WInters
text: Excellent food, friendly environment. Great spot for tourists visiting Alaska.

name: baby white
text: Yummy yummy in my tummy

name: Aditya Salunke
text: Loved this place. The Raspberry wheat Ale was one of their best drafts I've had so far. The clam chowder soup is excellent. We had Salmon and Halibut for our main course entrees and both were excellent. Service was good. Nice place in Anchorage to enjoy a meal. However waiting times are high. We were made to wait even after we had our reservations.

name: Henry Diaz
text: Sat at the bar and while one particular guest was there, it felt as if my wife and I were not. Bartender hung out, leaning on the bar talking with this other guest while we waited patiently for another drink. As for the food, my wife's salad was good, however while mine was good, it was more like an appetizer than an entre. We eat out more than the average person and this was far from being worth the drive from the south side of town.

name: Doug Stucki
text: Always good, an Alaska favorite! Just walk by and catch a waft of the alder rotisserie and you'll get a glimpse of what's in store. Perfectly cooked steak with just the right amount of alder flavor makes for an amazing lunch!

name: Adam Lewis
text: Great atmosphere with tasty food and good beer. Right in the middle of downtown Anchorage, so quite convenient. Not your typical brewhouse. It is a bit pricey, but a fun place to go.

name: Leland Jones
text: This is THE place to go if you come to Anchorage. Been a handful of times and the service never lets me down. For the BEST experience, reserve your seats before hand otherwise you may have to wait a while. If you could walk right in from a reservation then they will not let you down! Great food, great atmosphere, and MAKE SURE you get the Penut Pie! 6 stars!

name: Chuey Margu
text: The GB has always been our go to date night restaurant, Every visit is enjoyable and the staff are great. I recently wanted to try something different and was probably one of the dishes I ever disliked from the restaurant which was the seafood fettuccini, the pasta was hard and didn't have much taste to it either. but I will not give them any lower stars just from one dish I did not like. I do recommend the calamari, the crab legs, any steak dish or the chicken. all great dishes. the fettuccini did fall short. keep up the good work GB.

name: Xiang Cui
text:
Overrated place. We ordered the Alaskan crab leg and very disappointed by the size, considering the price. Same priced crab leg we had in Fairbanks were much better.
Also the wait time was ridiculous. We came at a low season, but it took at least 40 minutes for them to bring the food after we ordered. The waitress was also probably too busy to even ask if we wanted our chowder served first — so we waited until 9pm to get our food on the table!
Overall, the food is not bad, but I’m sure you find better restaurants in the area.

name: Rob Stapleton
text:
I called fo reservations for a group of 8 and the Brewhouse is closed for brunch on Sunday Jan 19 for a “Crew Party.”
No brunch, no bucks!

name: Reece Williams
text:
Pizza And Nachos look like they were made by an 8 year old. Domino's is better. Nachos are made out of Lay's Potato Chips.

Other food was pretty good. The Burger was WAY TOO expensive. Beer was nothing to write home about.

The Maple Butter and Bread was good though.

Matthew was a great waiter.

name: Lea Hancock
text: Fantastic service from our waitress. Food was excellent! We had the calamari for an appetizer. Highly recommend you try it. I have had calamari all over and this was simply the best. Their Caesar salad is delicious. I had the Chile Lime Shrimp salad and my husband had the seafood fettuccine. We were not disappointed at all. Dessert we  had the cheesecake. Highly recommend going to Glacier BrewHouse. I really wish we could remember our waitress’s name because she was so sweet and definitely took care us.

name: Tim Morin
text: Great atmosphere, great food and even better beer!

name: chris botner
text: Good quality food. Their desserts are as good if even better

name: Jim DeLung, Phd
text: I travel all over North America, and this is one of my favorite brewery/restaurants. Killer music playing overhead while I dined on local sockeye salmon with Wild Turkey barrel-aged Oatmeal Stout.  This place uses local food and beers to cater to residents and tourists alike. Sit at the bar and get recommendations from Courtney!  Make sure you tell her I sent you...

name: Clay Leslie
text: Great bartender, good beer, good bourbon, and good food.  What else could you ask for?

name: Wenny G
text:
Good food nice atmosphere, but not much on the menu
I think I would only try maybe 1more item on there if I went again.
Drinks are very small and kind of expensive for what you do get.

name: chris botner
text: Good quality food. Their desserts are as good if even better

name: Jennifer Hemphill
text: Pretzel appetizer with beer cheese was not very warm and the taste was off. My tomato soup was good and so was the blue cheese salad. My friends fish and chips were not good at all and the oil needed to be changed. More of a tourist trap than an Alaskan favorite. Most people like their beer, burger, and pizza.

name: Steve M
text: Everything was good the prices were just right and my partner's halibut was fantastic. I had two cheeseburger and was not disappointed. Their Oktoberfest beer was very good.

name: C E
text: We popped in here for lunching whim.  We tried a flight and found that all the house brews were good to great.  The food came fast and was good despite a good sized crowd occupying the restaurant.  The interior is spacious and rustic.  Is a great reasonably priced option for lunch.

name: Critics of The Universe
text:
Beer, Food, Service, Atmosphere is great. During peak time, its about an hour wait (during peak time, its not worth it). There are plenty places to go near by. Call for a reservation.

Update: whats up with this hipster bottle water and tiny water cups? Their food taste has dropped some points... chef changed? Management changed? New owners?

name: David Enzel
text: This is a good and very popular restaurant. They have their own beer which I enjoyed. I had the Amber. The menu is big and varied. They have salmon, halibut, pizza and meat. I had halibut and it was good. The place was busy and the staff tell me it's busy every day. It's also very loud. The kitchen is visible and the cook working there would shout orders for the whole dining room to hear. This isn't a place for a quiet evening. But it it is fun.

name: Paulness
text: This a more upscale brewpub located in lovely downtown Anchorage.  The prices here are pretty much on-par with prices across the state: relatively expensive compared to anyplace outside of the state.  The food was good, not exceptional, but it was extremely fresh.  The beer is good, too, but again, not exceptional.  The restaurant is clean and with a nice rustic/Alaskan design.  Our server was ok, she just handed u menus, told us one special, and was acting like she was trying to rush us.  The server next to us, didn't catch his name, was awesome.  He did a great job of recommending different course and beverage pairings to the patrons he had, and they had a good experience with him.  Not so much with ours.  But we had a good meal and a few decent beers.  If your in town and you have a fistful of dollars that needs to be spent, this isn't a bad place to do it. I'd come back again, but I'm not dying to get back again.  There's other options in town too.

name: Mark McElroy
text: Yes. This is the place -- with, frankly, some of the very best wings we've eaten in Alaska (or anywhere else). Especially on a wintry day, a perfectly respectable hot pizza, a good sandwich and fries, and a shared plate of wings ought to warm you right up. We love the lodge-inspired look of the place. Tip: try to snag that seat near -- but not right in front of -- the fireplace!

name: Zach Savage
text: If you're not from Alaska then prices might seem steep (but then, everywhere is), but if you realize you're​ in Alaska, then this is by far the best food I've had in the state and rates up there in the country. Great service, cool atmosphere, excellent food, good beer. If in town, definitely stop by, the kids menu is three course and under ten bucks!

name: Jeannette G.
text:
Always a must when in Anchorage.  This is a favorite among locals but it is obvious that most of its patrons are tourists during the summer season.  This was my second time at the Brewhouse.  The last time I was here it was really late at night and all I had was a bisque and a beer.

My recommendation is to call ahead for reservations.  Walk-ins can wait up to 1 1/2 hours.  For quicker service, steak-out the bar area, it is first-come, first-served and some of the tables can accommodate up to parties of 6.

On this visit, I found myself sitting in the bar area again.  Nonetheless, my experience was still good.

As an appetizer, I ordered the 1/2 lb King Crabs and although they were $28, it was a decent deal for other comparable places.  My entree was the lime shrimp.  Both dishes were quite satisfying.  I paired my meal with the house IPA, which made for a well rounded dinner.

name: Rhonda Ouellette
text:
Promptly seated & orders taken, even during busy FUR Rondy time. A reservation was essential and the food was delivered hot & with a smile. This is a great spot to eat & there was plenty of staff  on hand to handle the influx of the season.
Hats off to the management for knowing how to schedule for that.
The wait staff were busy, however they never let any food sit in the window waiting to be delivered.
Keeping up with a great kitchen staff is also essential  to a fantastic dining experience for every person in the room.
Hats off to all employees from top to bottom you all shine.

name: Nyssa Jones
text:
Went for Sunday brunch as I have many times before and went with the Traditional Eggs Benedict; I love a good Eggs Bene.
The good: it looked really good, the hollandaise was on point, the Chipotle and Smoked Gouda Grits were excellent.
The bad: one of my two eggs was undercooked, whites still clear, the food was never warm even served but I understand it can be hard to serve this dish "hot," there was way too much ham for the dish and it looked and tasted like store bought deli ham (water logged and all) and it wasn't even seared or tossed on the grill, and lastly, the English muffin was soggy, it looked like it might have had 3 seconds on a hot pan or in a toaster.
It was totally disappointing and really, serving undercooked poached eggs is a health risk.

name: Gregory Hartley
text: Certainly a tourist favorite, but worth considering for locals looking for a special occasion meal.  Busy, but browsing the gift shops around the place make the wait more enjoyable. Entrees were quite good, and splitable portions help cut costs. My wife loved her shrimp salad, but I took a star off for rock fish that did not impress. The real star was dessert! Seriously wonderful choices all hand-crafted with love. If I go back, it'll be for that Bourbon Pecan Bread Pudding or divine creme brulee!!

name: Cassandra Pickering
text: It's a very nice building in Downtown Anchorage we had a server name Matthew who was horrible didn't bother offering up any suggestions when asked my friend asked for some ice because the water was warm and he walked by and he slammed it on the table and slid it over to her and just walked off never stop just continue going somebody else but our food as he's walking by the table he just says anyting okay you need anything and he walked away and never came back the food was okay I wouldn't order the fish and chips it was overly breaded for the size of the pieces you got the slot was pretty good not sure if I'll be returning

name: tbear44
text: We sat by the fireplace, very nice. Food and service  were great.

name: Angshuman Mojumder
text: Anchorage has quite a few places that make their own beer. And some of these properties have popular restaurants running alongside. This is one of them. Had the seafood chowder and the king crab legs. Both very satisfying and local to this place. Also got the salmon special. Solid dish and perfectly covered salmon.

name: John Wilkie
text:
One of the few places where you can make reservations. Great place to take someone out for a nice meal and beer when they come to visit. You can't go wrong with the menu, and I can tell you from experience that the swordfish, steak, and burger are delicious. This is kind of a touristy place though, so prepare for touristy prices.

If you are new to Glacier Brewhouse beers, get a flight and try a bit of everything.

name: frank h
text: I don't eat out much but they really put forth the effort ,really good food presentation. I feel they make everything from scratch. Always busy, recommend calling ahead

name: Audrey Stachmus
text: The beer, food and service were all excellent. The smoked salmon club and the ahi tuna were both delicious! The prices are also decent for Alaska.

name: Eric Leonard
text: Awesome place to eat and also has cool gifts of Alaska.

name: madmusial
text: Food was good but very expensive. Portions seemed reasonable for the cost. Staff was helpful but not particularly accommodating. Would not recomend for large groups.

name: Sarah Jeter
text: Travis was an awesome waiter, food was delicious. Got a New York sour by asking, omg that drink needs to come back. Above and beyond service!

name: Dan A
text: Very good food. I have enjoyed everything I have ordered here, and I always look forward to the next time. Parking can be a pain, and the wait can get long if you come during evening rush, but that is a testament to how good it is.

name: Logan T .PhD
text: Just stopped in for lunch, but the warm and friendly staff made for a great dining experience. Their Marzen beer is light and refreshing and the salmon is flavored on point!

name: Matt Derr
text: Always good!

name: Chris Rac
text: With the restaurant being one of the best in town, I was severely disappointed.  We waited 27 minutes for starter bowls of their beer cheese soup.  As soon as our plates came out, we asked for the check since we didn't want to wait another 30 minutes after asking for it.  Wife's food was cold upon arrival.  However, neither her flank steak nor my double dipped fried chicken sandwich were tasty.  However, the place was so busy, the servers were completely checked out of providing a memorable experience.

name: Jim Avery
text:
We had the wood-fired pizza and it was wonderful, as always.  There was a one hour fifteen minute wait for a table, so we sat at the bar.
I doubt there is a decent restaurant in Anchorage that doesn't have an hour plus wait  on Friday evenings. Reservations are accepted.
The food is worth the wait.

name: Garveydis Productions
text: Mike the manager and Marina our server were amazing! Food was great!

name: Parker Helble
text: Had the wings as a small meal. Yum! Flights are cheap, and all the beers we tried were great!

name: Rita L
text: This place is just ok, not that great... but there's also not that many options around :( it's usually packed and they're pretty busy, so expect a little wait time for the food. Otherwise friendly staff and probably a popular spot in town.

name: Walbert Schulpen
text: Nice local brewhouse. I tried to order an outside brand but only own brew is sold. Food is good too.

name: Amy Guimond
text: The beer was really good. But this place was hopping... Impossible to get a table on the multiple times that we tried to go in, and very loud. The first time we went we wound up finding two seats in the very small bar area and were able to get beer there, but it was pretty clear that the staff was overwhelmed with how busy they were because it took a really long time to get service. We went back a few days later to try to eat there, but the wait was an hour and 20 minutes... They called their sister restaurant  (orzo) who was able to get us in immediately and served the same beers, so that is really a place about their customer service... not sure that I would try to go again if we return to Anchorage. But their coconut beer is fantastic.

name: Cherish Jordan
text: Good food, great beer, wonderful atmosphere.

name: James M
text: A bit of a wait for a table but I was able to sit at the bar pretty quickly. The staff were friendly and helpful, I ordered the fresh caught Halibut and it was superb. I tried a couple of their brews and was very pleased.

name: Pat Roberts
text: No need to dress all fancy, this is Anchorage, come as you are and enjoy a good beer. The Brewhouse is a great place to unwind and enjoy a good meal comfortably. Go for the flat iron steak 👍🏻.

name: Lindsay Stewart
text: So amazing! The brussel sprouts were cooked so perfectly. My steak was exactly the way I like it!!! Highly recommend this place!!!!

name: Steve Ketchum
text: Great food, beer, and service... always busy is the only negative thing I can say about it, but now you know why.  I go here every chance I get.  I've tried something different everything I go, and nothing has been anything but delicious. Love this place!

name: Pat Roberts
text: No need to dress all fancy, this is Anchorage, come as you are and enjoy a good beer. The Brewhouse is a great place to unwind and enjoy a good meal comfortably. Go for the flat iron steak 👍🏻.

name: Stefan Morin
text: Came here for an early anniversary dinner, and we were very impressed with the quality of both the food and the service.  Absolutely would recommend this restaurant to anyone!

name: Scott Tousignaut
text: what a wonderful place great food, great drink and nice people

name: Glen M. Allen
text: Really good food preparation and presentation. Might have to wait awhile to get seating... worth the wait. Fair prices for a quality meal and refreshments. Parking can be a bit of a problem...

name: Steve Ketchum
text: Great food, beer, and service... always busy is the only negative thing I can say about it, but now you know why.  I go here every chance I get.  I've tried something different everything I go, and nothing has been anything but delicious. Love this place!

name: Andrew DiRoma
text: Pricey but worth the price of the food. I had the filet and shrimp and calamari and everything was amazing had cheesecake afterwards and house brewed root beer

name: Drew Klaus
text: VERY spendy but the food is SO good, great menu !!  Busy here every time I've gone. Expect to wait 45 minutes for a seat on the weekend. Still haven't found one of their beers that I like.

name: James Nichols
text: Wasnt real impressed! I ordered the New York Strip steak and could have used a chainsaw to cut thru it.  The place was packed and very loud so it was hard to here anyone in our weeding party.  Maybe the wrong food selection because I had some Shrimp and that was very good.

name: Mel G
text: Rockfish was delicious. Mojito got me eff'd up. Pretty good service at the bar.

name: Tena Storgaard
text: I have eaten at this restaurant several times,  the staff is very friendly and helpful.  The halibut tonight was excellent.  This place is always busy.

name: Marie Toothman
text: Great visit as always!  Took a new friend here to show off this Anchorage MUST !!

name: Shelby T
text: Everything is amazing as always. We set a reservation for 8, and arrived five mins early and were seated immediately. So that was nice. Food was hot and delicious, and for how busy it was, we waited an appropriate time for every thing. (Drinks. Apps and main course). We ordered the salmon dip to start. I LOVE smoked salmon anything and this dip did not disappoint. It was a good amount for four adults to share. Both me and my friend ordered the seafood Alfredo. BEST PASTA DISH I have ever had. Like ever. And a really decent portion of both pasta and meats, totally worth the price. My husband and my friends husband ordered the flat iron steak. Both done to their desired temperature and equally delicious. If I didn’t want to order that pasta over and over and over, I would totally order the steak. And we topped the evening off with three desserts. The peanut butter pie, which I found to be rich for my personal taste but everyone else loved it. The cheesecake, again the raspberry sauce was very overwhelming for me. I think I’d try it again Bc the actual cake was good, I’d just get the sauce on the side. And lastly my personally ordered dessert. Creme brûlée. AMAZING. It was so perfectly sweet and the carmelized top was nice and crunchy. I will definitely be ordering this again. And like most of the evening, the portion was decent for the price. Overall we had a FANTASTIC night. And will definitely be returning in the future. I cannot recommend this restaurant enough. We have patronized about 5 times and never have a bad time.

name: Susan Overman
text: $34 for a very plain, flavorless petit steak. A little salt, pepper and garlic powder would go a long way

name: Gerry Pennington
text: Had the special (seafood ciopinno)...not good. Fish was way over cooked, dry and tough. No shrimp, sauce was super thick, three mussels and they were tiny. So disappointing...especially for the price. And the service was at a snails pace. Hour and a half to get our entrée.

name: Carmen Cheney
text: One of my favorite places to eat in Anchorage. Best seafood chowder in the world.

name: michael acheson
text: It's okay, even good at somethings. There's better...

name: Carla Sessions
text: My husband and I passed through Anchorage twice in our travels.  We loved this place so much we came back 2nd time through.  Delicious food and good service.  It's busy and a little noisy but well worth that inconvenience.

name: Bryan Blakstad
text: Find upscale dining

name: Lawrence Whitsett
text: Great beer, food and atmosphere.  Burger was just slightly to charred, otherwise I loved it.

name: Megan Rowe
text:
We went on 4th of July and it was packed. Took about two hours to get our food. The folks next to us were about to leave from waiting so long. Then, the food had hairs in it and I got a bit of food poisoning from my salad. Maybe when it’s so busy like that they could just turn people away?

But, everyone was super apologetic about the wait. We didn’t say anything about the hairs because the staff seemed really, really stressed out. And we just wanted to leave.

name: Matthew Hennigan
text: Great, attentive service. Delicious food and drinks. Good atmosphere. Will definitely be back. Our server, Amy, was fantastic.

name: CorreyHope Kustin
text:
Make a reservation!! Steep prices but one of the finest places to dine in ANC.
It's where Alaskans meet Alaskans but more for a special occasion and tourists. I don't think many Alaskans can dine here on a weekly basis.
The brick oven sets off  a nice smell and gives the brewery a nice cozy feeling.
I am not a fish eater but I did enjoy the   braised Beef Sliders, they were mouth watering and just the right amount of spice, beware the jalapenos. My next course was the flat steak and their special garlic mashed potatoes. I could have had 2 more helpings! I didn't have room for more than 1 bite of the peanut butter cake.
Staff tried very hard to get the service together for our large party.

name: Rick Derthick
text: The menu selection is first class. Quality is first class. Service is first class. Atmosphere is first class. There is a reason why this place is always crowded.

name: Easter Sunday Chaga
text: Awesome service, amazing food, and a really great atmosphere.  Top choice for downtown town plans with an Escape Room in the building!

name: Brad Tombers
text: I go here several times a year and never have a bad experience. Always order the calimari!

name: David Burdett
text: Been coming to Glacier Brew since 2006. Food and drink is always outstanding however dropped a star tonight just on the service. Our booking was not registered when we arrived,  and our server was a little off her game also. Seemed a little disinterested and never even asked if we wanted further drinks after our first round.

name: Steven Dristy
text: Great food, great beer and great atmosphere! As stated by others, the prices are steep, but you get what you pay for! The cajun halibut was cooked perfect, and I enjoyed my dinner. This was a business dinner, but I think I need to bring the family here.

name: Catherine Kenney
text: Loved it!  Chrizo, reindeer burger with jalapeno aioli, fresh jalepenos and fresh salsa.  I am so full!  Flavor explosion in my mouth!   Compliments to Chef!!

name: nicholas jackson
text: What the hell happend to the food here. ? We were there for our 1st year marriage anniversary  the service sucked the food change. And I order the same thing everytime.? New chef or lack of training in the kitchen.  Blah! Horrible experience poor tourist. Take care Brew house your off our list.

name: Grace Hawkins
text: Our waiter Mark was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. The food was impeccable!

name: Landis Loftin
text: I was thrilled with the excellent service and delicious beer and appetizer.

name: Jeremy Dinsmore
text: I had a great meal here in 2011, and I can still remember it vividly. This was the only time I'd had bleu cheese in anything and actively enjoyed it. I had an awesome steak, and the bleu cheese mashed potatoes were quite good. Great atmosphere. I just wish that at the time I had been able to enjoy a beer or two!

name: Brian Forrest
text: This is a great place for some lunch! The food is always flavorful, and service is very attentive.

name: Karen
text: Great food, great atmosphere, great service!

name: Michael Musgrove
text: Great service, great food!

name: D Morse
text: Excellent service and good food.

name: Everything Amazing
text: Had the first date night in a long time, and glacier brewhouse was the perfect choice. Great atmosphere and great food!

name: Chris Hall
text:

name: J S
text: We liked this place! It's not a full service restaurant...you order at the counter and then they bring you the food. But as long as you are OK with that, the food we had was pretty good! Soups, sandwiches and salads basically are the menu, but with a pretty good variety of each. And then there is a great selection of beers! The service was friendly and efficient. The seating was comfortable and there were like 3 or 4 TVs, each tuned in to something different and with captioning on, so there was always something to look at if we felt so inclined. The restaurant is also fairly close to the freeway, so easy on-off for travelers.

text: Everything we got was so good. The pretzels are my fave and the peanut butter pie is a close second

name: Kim P.
text: We came here after it being recommended to us, as a great place to get a gluten free meal. I ordered the Stupid Good sandwich gluten free and it was fantastic! The gluten free bread was SO good. We also tried the reindeer chili that was also good. My husband got the French dip (non gluten free) and he really enjoyed it. We shared the gluten free chocolate torte and it was the perfect little sweet treat to end our evening. We will definitely be coming back as it’s now one of our new favorite places! They also give a military discount, which we were so grateful for!

name: Sharolyn Wyeth
text: Everything we had was so good. I really liked their jalapeno popper grilled cheese & my friend liked his Reuben. The artichoke flat bread was creamy & delicious & the artichoke taste was forefront- The servers were super friendly & didn't rush us. Overall, a great dinner out. Their prices weren't cheap, but weren't outrageous, either. We'll definitely be back!

name: Lauren Newton
text: Very good food. They take it to the next level. It is hard not to order too much food, because I love the appetizers and the sides and the entrees. I think you can never go wrong with grilled cheese so that is my go to order.

text: Great food but customer service was terrible my wife just had a baby 2 weeks ago and waited 3 hours for her food to arrive. She called them and asked when it was going to be delivered and they said they can bring it right now because they wrote down the wrong address, but it would've been cold and soggy. So they redid the order. I've called to speak with the manager why they couldn't offer her a discount or any accommodations because of the 3 HOUR wait so she offered a free desert on our next order then she quickly hung up.Really???

Great food and great service
We had the Hot Pastrami Sandwich and the Turkey Bacon Avocado wrap. Both tasted great. Pastrami was hot with plenty of melted cheese and  sautéed mushrooms and onions. The vegetables on the wrap were fresh and crispy. We will be going back soon.

text: I super love Bread and Brew! The food is SO GOOD! Their menu is unique and well crafted. I have enjoyed several items and would highly recommend trying this place out. I would advise ordering in advance if you are short on time and I would say casual wear is most appropriate.

name: Robin Dern
text:
This is a great locally owned business that offers up a wonderful dining experience in the midtown area. They deliver and have pick up available during COVID, and they have a fun and comfortable atmosphere which I’ll look forward to visiting again when it is safe to dine in. The staff always seems to be having a great time with one another and it makes for a very friendly and welcoming vibe. The food is excellent. My favorites are the flatbread pizzas and the soups but the sandwiches look amazing. The portions are big. A large flatbread will feed four, and it least with us, there were leftovers. I don’t know how and if they are serving beer during this time but they have a varied and eclectic selection. If I lived closer, I’d be frequenting even more often!

Update Feb 17, 2021 - Due to an expiring order at the State level they are not able to accommodate curbside or delivery service for those wanting beer. However, they are operating at limited capacity, in accordance with State and Muni guidelines, for those that wish to enjoy a drink at the restaurant.

name: Anna B
text: Had the Aloha grilled cheese with aside of truffle fries to share. The pineapple chutney on it was just the right amount of sweet for the sandwich. Also, the dressing sides with the truffle fries were fantastic...as you can see, we enjoyed them!

text: Bread and Brew is a cute enough little shop with friendly staff and a lovely atmosphere, their food however falls completely flat. My partner and I ordered two sandwiches and the incredibly disappointing "truffle tots", the entire lot was bland, mushy, and sad. The saddest part by far was the soggy, premade frozen tater tots topped with a meager sneeze of parmesan and shown a truffle before being served. I would give this one a hard pass, save your money.

Good place to grab a beverage avg get your carbs.

My daughter ordered the pulled pork tacos.
We split both. Everythink was very good but my favorite was She tried Special.

name: Bentley Walker
text:
Update below:
The grilled cheese sandwhiches are pretty tasty, but the kitchen looks dirty and the service is non-existant.  I visited during the week when the place was mostly empty and it took ten minutes to have someone take a drink order only to be forgotten.  The fake blonde with frizzy hair needs to go or else she'll take this place down with her.  Never going back.
Update:
I'm surprised the kitchen got such a high rating from health because I saw an inch of crusty tomato soup around the rim of the soup warmer.  Still can't forgive such blatantly poor service.

resp.text:
Bentley,

I assure you our kitchen is one of the cleanest in the state. We have a 96/100 from the department of health and human services. I would love to invite you back for a tour of our kitchen and to try another one of our tasty grilled cheese.  Thanks!

name: Louis Manzi
text:
Ordered sliders and with regular fries.

First things first, beer selection is great. Lots of local beers. However, when you come to a place called Bread and brew you expect all the bread and brew to be great! The bread for the sliders was extremely dry however the flavor between the bread was 7.5 out of 10. They buy their bread from a bakery in France and a local bakery. Either they need to switch bakeries or start baking their own. In addition to the dry bread the sliders we're messy.

The fries were sub-optimal and probably shouldn't even be considered fries. Think of a French fries that are 1 inch in length. Need longer fries!

On a positive note service was great and atmosphere was appealing.

resp.text: Thank you for the constructive criticism. We appreciate the input to help us further our growth. Hope to see you in again soon!

text: Great

name: Caitlin McElhinny
text: It was okay. Wanted to love it but everyone's sandwiches were kinda sloppy and lacked balanced proportions of ingredients. For example, one had almost all the meat and cheese on only side, the other two had very little sauce/condiments on them. My turkey, cranberry, cream cheese had almost no cream cheese, very light cranberry, and a ton of turkey. Which was a bummer for a $15 sandwich. Great on tap selection and good service. Would recommend trying the grilled cheese sandwiches as those seemed like the house speciality.

resp.text: We are so sorry you didn’t enjoy your food! Can you tell us which sandwiches you ordered besides the merry cranwich, just so we can figure out where we dropped the ball! We hope you come back and have a better experience next time, because we absolutely pride ourselves on great food and exceptional customer service

text: Went for lunch with my son, had to come back for dinner with the whole family. Great food great beer and great service. We will surely be back!

name: Teresa Bowen
text: While if I was just rating on my first visit it would have been higher but I stand by this one. I had surgery and am currently in a wheelchair and/or on crutches. Since this bar/cafe/restaurant isn't really set up for a wheelchair at all I used my crutches. There is hardly any parking for this place anyways, the fact that the only handicap parking was on the other side of the building made this inconvenient which for me was okay since my situation is temporary. But then it made me realize that it really limited which of my friends I could bring. Then upon entering it took at least 15 minutes before we acknowledged. Just as I was thinking about leaving a very unenthused server brought us menus and took our orders you were out of what we wanted. The food was maybe 50% of the quality it was the first time the atmosphere was waaaaay down and then when it was dessert time you were out of that also. Needless to say we will not be back. 😪

I'm a flight attendant and whenever tourists ask me where good food is in Anchorage, I'm always sure to mention this place.

text:
Not a fan of the new ordering system, and that the bar is essentially pointless now. The grilled cheese was still great, but the bloody mary was weak and not flavorful. This used to be my wife and I's favorite spot for brunch, but we probably wont be back. The atmosphere is not nearly as friendly now. Sad to see. When there's a real bartender again and not just people wandering around looking for numbers let me know. Cheers

Edit:
Hahahaha that was my bad. I've been here like 10 times but never during the week. I stand corrected on the weekday service thing, I was oblivious. I'm upping it to 4 stars, but the bloody mary was still weak lol. We'll be back on the weekend!

resp.text: Hi Austin, we operate like this Monday-Friday 11-3, since we’ve opened in July 2016. It works well for the fast paced lunch service we provide. We have full service/bartenders Monday-friday 3:30-11pm all day sat/sun! We’re sorry that you didn’t like the midday service but we hope you visit again during full service times!

name: Ron Frazier
text: 3 stars and here's why:  The sandwich and atmosphere were great, but the food was just a bit overpriced - not a surprise for Alaska, TBH.  On that alone, I'd have rated this place 4 stars.  HOWEVER, the girl taking orders at the register was an unapologetic, forgetful piece of work that not only didn't hand me a sign for my order number, but she didn't bring it out to me, either.  After 15 minutes and I walked up to ask why everyone around me is getting their food before me, and she says, "Oh, I didn't give you this."  Handing me a sign with a number without even making eye contact with me.  Then, I get my food and there's no drink that I ordered.  I walk back up to this girl and say, "Was I supposed to get a drink, too?  It's on my receipt."  She, again, doesn't look up and just blindly hands me a cup.  I wanted to reach over and shake some IQ points into her snooty, beanpole frame.

resp.text:
Good Morning Ron, we would love to chat with you about your experience and offer you a $25 gift card for your time! We truly are about customer service and want to discuss with you more in depth about your whole experience. Contact us at your earliest convenience. 907-230-9988. Hope we can chat soon! Thanks for the review, we're always striving to improve.

-Alexis (Owner/Managing Partner)

They have a fantastic GF bread/sandwich selection. They bake their fries instead of deep fry them! Oh! They are sooooo good. We've had the Bacon and Apple sandwich, the Jalopeno Popper, the Spicy Turkey, and Hello Basil- each one has been busting with flavor. I am not a fan of tomato sup and I loooooove theirs. They'll give you a cup for dipping, but I've learned my lesson, I now order a bowl. They have a modern, clean, atmosphere. It's not too large, therefore, not too load. The staff is friendly and attentive.

My ONLY complaint is that the sandwichs are just a tad small, at least the GF sandwichs are.
Sincerely,
Calin Logan
