name: Anna M. B.
text:
(Translated by Google) The price-performance ratio for the hotel is good compared to other places in Alaska and hotels or log cabins. We have been traveling here for a while and this is the first place that goes. It is a very large hotel, even with multiple entrances. WiFi is available without a password. In the room there is a refrigerator, coffee maker with teas and coffee powder. What is not there, however, is a safe.
If you pay attention to the standard, avoid the wooden huts, no matter how nice and cozy they look, even if they cost over € 200 per night. Damp, small and often without water or a toilet.
You are happy when you have a hotel room. So book many months in advance of your trip so that you can still find a suitable overnight stay. Amazingly, the air conditioning can be switched off. A miracle for America. As my photos show (e.g. bathtub), the hotel is getting on in years, but as I said it is ok and almost a luxury by Alaska's standards.

(Original)
Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis für das Hotel ist im Vergleich zu anderen Ortschaften in Alaska und Hotels bzw. Blockhütten gut. Wir waren schon eine Weile hier unterwegs uns das ist das erste Hotel, der geht. Es ist ein sehr großes Hotel, sogar mit mehreren Eingängen. W-lan gibt es ohne Passwort. Im Zimmer gibt es einen Kühlschrank, Kaffeemaschine mit Teesorten und Kaffee-Pulver. Was es jedoch nicht gibt, einen Tresor.
Falls Sie auf Standart achten, meiden Sie die Holzhütten, egal wie nett und gemütlich sie aussehen, auch wenn sie über 200 € pro Nacht kosten. Feucht, klein und oft ohne Wasser und Toilette.
Da ist man froh, wenn man ein Hotelzimmer hat. Deswegen viele  Monate vor der Reise buchen, damit man noch eine entsprechende Übernachtung findet. Die Klimaanlage ist erstaunlicherweise auszuschalten. Ein Wunder für Amerika. Wie meine Fotos zeigen (z.b. Badewanne), ist das Hotel doch schon in die Jahre gekommen, aber wie gesagt es ist ok und beinah ein Luxus für Alaskas Verhältnisse.

text: Really fun place to learn about the pipeline and dredge for gold. Everyone gets some gold so it's well worth the visit. Awesome gift show and train tour. Would definitely go again!

text: Had a wonderful time on this tour. Had a ride on the train and learned the history of dredge #8 and my wife and I panned $56 in gold 😁 which we put in our charm on a magnet. We even got a chance to hold a $75,000 gold nugget.

text: Wonderful tour.  We found about 20 of gold on average between the 3 of us. Warm water to pan in.  Nice gift shop. Very nice and helpful staff.

text: Great adventure, see and learn about the oil pipeline, learned about mining for gold, Got to pan for gold and found a few very small pieces. A fun experience, good time, and very interesting history lesson as well.

name: Joshua Hadik
text:
Took our students out here for a field trip and absolutely loved it. Very informative and very engaging. The whole crew made it a great experience for the students. Even our younger ones were fully engaged and enjoying it.
Definitely an experience that everyone should try.

name: Jason U.
text:
Fun trip. Lots of information, free home made cookies and coffee and of course gold panning. My wife and I both bought an extra bag of concentrate and it more than paid for itself. We found $96 dollars worth of gold together which paid for half the trip in a way.
Do yourself a favor and buy 1 or 2 extra bags right at the start so you can pan it all at once.

text: This is a straight forward tourist attraction that puts together a well paced.program that provides insight into the Alaska gold mining operations of the past  and provides the opportunity to try panning.some gravel to discover some flakes of gold were hidden in your poke

text: Panning for gold we found $37 worth. Had the treasure made into a neckless and matching earrings.  Excellent for gifts. Friendly staff and tour of Dredger 8 and surroundings buildings. The train ride was a informative history of gold mining. Well worth a stop.

name: Carl Tiefenthaeler
text: Great experience for all. Kids would love this, they get to Gold Pan and walk around a dredge and a train ride. The people working here are great ! You also get to see the Alaskan pipeline.

text: Interesting, knowledgeable experience. It’s a one time thing. I don’t think I would do it again but I definitely learned a lot. So if you have the money, do it.

name: Mike Schultz
text: I liked it. The panning is cool but it's got to be staged. I'm fairly certain they reuse the stuff in the troughs and just add some flakes to it. All of the gold flakes I saw were uniform in size. It's still a good experience! Cheapest cans of pop you will find too!

name: Eli Mitchell
text: Very fascinating tour. They had competent, knowledgeable guides who provided an insightful glimpse into the history of the Fairbanks area. It was very educational.

name: Ron Baioni
text: Great exhibits. This thing is huge. Our tour guide was a guy who teaches history in a high school in Fairbanks. So he knew his stuff. He was like Jamie from Mythbusters, but not as scary. They have a gold panning deal and they do the jewelry thing with it. But its not the hard sell and the stuff they have is nice and not the typical rip off prices. Most jewelry in Alaska tourist areas is a total scam, but not this place.

name: Aditi Partani
text: Amazing place. Lots of learning abt history of gold panning. You get a chance to pan gold yourself and you are guaranteed to find gold. Fun tour for abt 2 hours. Fun for the whole family. And coffee and cookies were cherry on the top.

name: Hugh Murray
text: Actually panned a little gold and then purchased a charm to keep it in.

name: Tanya Collier
text: Very fun for visitors and even living here I enjoy the history. Planning for gold is not easy! Beautiful views and it definitely teaches you the history of the gold rush in Alaska. We have very valuable land and people from all over the world have settled here. Pretty amazing. Great tour and awesome staff. The same presenters I saw 7 years ago.

name: Remona Koop
text: Fun train ride on historic site,  nice way to show history of gold dredging in area. Then we got to pan for gold. While I personally didn't do well,  some found up to $25.00 worth of gold. Then, of course, they had to try to sell you jewelry to put it in. Gift shop was quaint, in all old warehouse, but disappointing,  in that most of the merchandise was from China. Still, all in all, a great experience, and worth the time.

name: Dennis Camp
text:
The place is worth a visit to see what the gold rush years were like in Alaska. The people who interact with the visitors are knowledgeable and friendly.

The pipe line runs next to the location. The pipe line information and it's impact on Alaska for the good things it brought to the economy. It is worth a visit to the place where they have a huge gift shop.

Arrived we are in a large parking lot, parked on the coach. After buying the tickets, we went through a gate on the pipelines. You will be led straight to the big train, which goes through different stations of the gold mine. Everything is demonstrated by an employee outside. Later, the gold lingerie will be shown, so you should be careful, because you even get to wash gold. Everyone gets a bag of stones in the guaranteed gold. We both had gold worth about 50 € at the end. You can weigh it in the very nice big shop. In the shop there are toilets and free coffee and biscuits.n

Ein Erlebnis hoch drei. Hätten wir gar nicht erwartet. Es ist das Eintrittsgeld von ca. 40 Dollar allemal wert, zu Mal man am ende eventuell in dem Wert selbst gewaschenes Gold mit nach Hause nimmt. Angekommen sind wir auf einem großem Parkplatz, auf dem auch Reisebuse parken. Nach dem Kauf der Eintrittskarten gingen wir durch ein Tor an den Pipelines. Man wird gleich zu dem großen Zug geleitet, der durch verschiedene Stationen der Goldmine fährt. Es wird alles durch einem Mitarbeiter draußen vorgeführt. Später wird auch die Goldwäsche vorgeführt, da sollten Sie aufpassen, da man selbst dazu kommt Gold zu waschen. Jeder bekommt ein Säckchen mit Steinen in dem garantiert Gold ist. (Translated by Google) Nice activity in Fairbanks. It takes 2 hours. Some explanations on the pipeline which crosses Alaska from North to South. You can see a stretch when you arrive. Covered little train ride but no windows so in rainy weather, it is better to equip yourself. A musician plays some country tunes with his guitar and his violin, it s very nice to be patient before everyone climbs up (many buses when we are gone). A pioneer-like bearded man tells us the story of the region's gold diggers and the techniques for recovering gold. Then it's up to us to try the adventure! It s cheerful and everyone leaves with their little bundle of gold sequins. We can then have it weighed. Souvenir shops well stocked. Free coffee, tea, water and delicious cookies !!!

Trajet en petit train couvert mais pas de fenêtres donc par temps pluvieux, mieux vaut bien s équiper. Un musicien joue quelques airs de country avec sa guitare et son violon,  c est très agréable pour patienter avant la montée de tout le monde (de nombreux cars quand nous sommes allés). name: Nicole Emanuel
text:
I’ve eaten at Cuban restaurants in Minneapolis, in Washington DC, and now in Fairbanks, and they’ve all shared two qualities: first, each one was quite tiny & funky in terms of atmosphere, and second, they have each served some of the most indescribably delicious food I’ve ever had.
Jazz Bistro looks like a hole-in-the-wall from the street, but if the savory smells wafting from its doors aren’t enough to draw you inside, well, you should probably go to an Ear-Nose-And-Throat doctor to get that checked out. The aromas of garlic and earthy herbs and deeply savory slow-cooking meat were almost overpowering before we even entered the restaurant.
There were fewer than 10 tables inside, but over the course of our meal nearly all were used by patrons (who, by the way, seemed to be as impressed by their meals as I was, judging by how they seemed to speak to the friendly waiter). We ordered a salad, camarones (shrimp in mojito sauce) and pernil (long-roasted pork). The two entrees each came with rice, black beans (exquisitely flavored) and a light, citrusy slaw. And both entrees were hauntingly wonderful: the pork was melt-apart tender, the shrimps were in a creamy succulent sauce I wanted drink up like a soup.
In addition to the outstanding food, the service was great. There seemed to be only one waiter working (and he also apparently performs at the restaurant as a musician on other nights), but he seemed to give each table his full attention, and was a helpful and outgoing server.
There’s something wonderful about cuisines of the Caribbean, which manage to pack a wallop of flavor while somehow still being incredibly layered, nuanced and subtle. I’m definitely coming back to Jazz Bistro next time I get the craving for that incomparable island taste!

name: Matthew Lee
text:
2.5/5 (rounded up to 3/5)

Overall one of the better places in Fairbanks that I've tried but so many things felt unfinished. The waitress told me they opened 4 months ago but I still expected more.

Good:
-My salmon tasted great and was mostly (see below) cooked well
-Live jazz (we didn't stay for it unfortunately but it seems like a main draw of the place and was unique)
-Everyone was very friendly
-Lots of parking right out front
-Someone that I assume was the chef came and asked us how our meal was, that shows me someone here is very dedicated to this place and is personally passionate about its success

Not so good:
-Table layout was awkward, there's a table right when you walk in by the door
-A "microwave in use" sign in the dining area was unappealing (I've never seen that before and if you're using a microwave I wouldn't think it wise to advertise it)
-No tap water due to previous customers complaining it tasted bad, reason from restaurant was that it's an "old building" and they're working on it; bottled water for a little less than $2/each instead.
-No wine, beer, or alcohol of any kind (no liquor license yet). We were told we can bring in wine and pay a $10 corking fee and any unconsumed wine would have to stay at the restaurant. As a customer that seemed strange... Why would you be open 4 months without a liquor license?
-Entree came with choice of side, I intentionally ordered my food and didn't specify which I wanted to see if the waitress would ask me... She didn't and gave me the black bean option
-We had an unlit candle on our table. Some tables were lit, some were not
-The center of my salmon was raw but the 80% that was cooked was excellent
-Our menus were 1 sided and not in a menu sleeve. Glancing around the room one table had the same menus (but in a sleeve) and another table seemed to have something on the back of their menus. Not sure what that was.
-No dessert menu or verbal indication from staff that they had any desserts
-Waitress seemed to forget about us, waited about 10 min for a check after another server took our finished plates.
-A woman randomly started playing a violin or viola, which sounded wonderful, but seemed out of place and awkward in this setting for some reason. Perhaps she should sit and face the dining area and not stand? I'm not sure.

Overall I was happy that the food that was cooked tasted very good. There aren't a lot of nice places in Fairbanks and the cost of our food leads me to believe that Jazz Bistro is aiming for that mark.

I hope this place can tie up the loose ends and get some more consistency and professionalism across the board. I feel like with the food quality there is a lot of potential but it seemed like even after 4 months this restaurant wasn't ready to open. We'll be back in the spring again, hope to see some changes!

text: This place is great. Loved the recycling recepticals throughout the hotel. The rooms are very well thought out. Divider curtain between the bed and couch area. Dining table is on wheels to allow it to be stored out of the way when not in use. Coffee maker brews 2 cups at a time. Tons of outlets in most of the lamps and at least one usb outlet. Absolute black out curtains which is super helpful during the summer in Alaska. Everything you need, including dishes and a toaster. We stayed during covid-19, so breakfast buffet was closed, as well as the pool. But they delivered a nice brown bag breakfast to our door in the morning. Staff is outstanding! Especially the gentleman who checked us in on the afternoon of June 27th, 2020. He's a huge asset to your organization. Definitely don't let him go anywhere!

name: Brian G
text: Amazing price in the high season due to the pandemic... Room was extremely clean, and smelled amazing...the Front of House Manager went above and beyond when we checked in...I had forgotten my toothbrush, he offered me every other item I may have needed just in case I needed it when I asked for a toothbrush...we will do our damnedest to stay at this location everytime we visit Anchorage... Cannot recommend this establishment enough.

name: Danielle Christescu
text: The staff here is FABULOUS! I felt welcome and comfortable as soon as I walked in the door. This hotel is super clean and modern. I'm actually going to change my usual passing through hotel  from the Hilton downtown anchorage, to this one. Both Kiki (day shift) and Leaa (night shift) at the front desk were so personable, super sweet and helpful, I hope they both get some kind of recognition via the company.

text: Elegant environment to eat in. Order was placed quickly. Food took a reasonable amount of time to get. The portions were larger than expected. I loved the sub I got. The kids got a dinner salad and a pasta. They all filled up and had left overs. Took a minute to get the check and even longer to pay. Still worth it. I will give a second chance to bill paying.

name: Angel Gonzales
text:
Humpy's is an Alaskan classic restaurant. I have lots of memories coming here with my mom because she loves their halibut. If you want some delicious seafood, this is the place to go. Not into seafood? Don't worry! They have more than enough food for you, too! The food is amazing.

To top it all off, they are taking all of the COVID-19 precautions to keep their workers and customers safe: from wearing masks, to digital menus, sanitizing and social distancing tables within the restaurant.

resp.text: Angel, you are too kind!  We take pride in our food, service and cleanliness, ESPECIALLY with COVID happening.  Thanks for the great review and we will see you soon I'm sure!

text: Food is ok! It’s just bar food. What hurts the food is the prices, yes I get it downtown rent isn’t cheap. However there are better versions of their menu all over downtown anchorage. Halibut sammich? Fstreet. Anything grilled? Simons and seaforts. Drink? Mad Myrna’s. Music? Bernie’s bungalow. Any who, their fries are good, and fairly priced. Otherwise it’s a overrated dump. I only send people I don’t like here.

name: Cindy Main
text:
Bonnie was our server. She was awesome. High energy, enthusiastic and just really, really nice. This place was so much fun. We started with drinks and the pretzel appetizer which was delicious. We just hung out talking for quite some time.  Bonnie was very attentive checking on us making sure we all had drinks. We finally ordered. My son in law had the cesar salad with chicken, my daughter the fettuccine Alfredo, my husand the hot turkey sandwich and me the meatball sub. Wow, it was all delicious. The meatball sub had a little spin to it meaning not your traditional sub. It was more like a calzone shaped into a sub. It was huge and amazing. I could only eat half.

They had live entertainment which was incredible. The female singer had a serious voice. The band was very good.

If i ever make it back this way again, this would be a definite "go to" place.

I ordered the Humpy's Fettuccine- honestly not a fan you can tell it's homemade which is great but it needed a little something more... Also got the Pretzel sticks and beer cheese and those were very good. We enjoy their fish very much! Great service and staff!

Our server was very nice and helpful though, 5 stars for her.

name: Dean Atkins
text: I'm sorry to say that we were disappointed. We walked in to a completely packed house. We were told to seat ourselves. When we asked how, they said just cruise back and forth and wait for someone to get up. We literally had to hover around the tables and wait for a party to begin to get up. We were then told to go and hurry and sit at that table before someone else did. Well we're now sitting at a dirty table. While they did come and clean it up quickly, it's just not the experience we were expecting. Being in Alaska, we wanted to experience real Alaskan seafood.  We ordered the Alaskan King Crab meal ($54). It consisted of (1lb) two crab legs that were somewhat watery and mushy. More disappointingly however was the Scallop and Salmon fettuccine ($27.50). The Scallops were there, but the Salmon does not come as a steak as you would expect, rather it is minced Salmon that is just in the sauce. It appeared and felt like they collected up all the scraps from other salmon meals prepared that day and just tossed them into the sauce. The scallops are whole, I'm not sure why the Salmon wouldn't be. In the end, we spent $100 on a mediocre meal that I feel I could have gotten for much less money at Red Lobster.

text: Drinks better than the food, but it's a bar that we found ourselves coming back to -- so, good service and no complaints.

name: Manuel Colon
text: Walked into a full house and was drinking and eating my meal within 15 minutes. Had Humpy's fettecini with Italian sausage and a great longboard lager. Great food great service.

name: kirsten scharber
text: Great local spot with a buzzing atmosphere, some of the best food in town and live music some nights.

name: Mary Epchook
text: A group of coworkers and I had ordered in and dined in at Humpys. The servers were attentive to all customers which I noticed and appreciated. Everyone liked the food. Thank you! I thought the decor was cool and colorful.

name: J S
text:
Weve been to Humpy's before, some years ago. Four stars is pretty generous. I'd describe this place as OK, but basically over-rated, based on my experiences.

We were visiting during Covid restrictions, and the host was sort of curt about the whole thing, not at all patient or clear about what customers were expected to do nor not do. We definitely didn't feel that he was glad to greet us, which is basically his job.

Our table server, Justin, was the high point of our experience. He was friendly,  efficient, and timely in his service. Keep up the good work, Justin!

We were not happy with bar service. We ordered (aside from appetizers and full dinners) a couple of pitchers of beer for the table. We always try to order local brews and try new things. The first pitcher was fine, but the second was vastly different from the description on the menu, to the point that everyone at the table thought we'd been poured the wrong beer. When we wondered aloud about this, the bartender was defensive and a bit condescending, telling us that the beer we ordered did have the characteristics described.  Regardless of whether we'd been poured the correct beer or not,  in my experiences with fine dining, most restaurants would offer to bring something different, to make it right and please the customer.  This bartender did none of that; he just basically said that was what we ordered and walked away.

The food was ok...I'd give it a "C." Food is subjective,  so I don't expect everyone to agree, but I found the acclaimed halibut fish tacos to be too sweet, to the point that the fish was overwhelmed. My husband's horseradish crusted halibut seemed a bit better. Still, we'll try somewhere else the next time we're in town.

name: Helen Walicka
text: If you want to just have a drink don’t bother. They’re too busy selling meals to the cruise ship passengers. Girl behind the bar was frantic for no real reason. Also very dark and dingy inside.

name: Bridget Coolick
text: Fun bar and restaurant with a lot of personality. Really good fish tacos!

name: Remo Dela Cruz
text: Good drinks and decent food. Also has a live band that plays a variety of music depending on the day. Paid parking is available behind the bar for $4/2 hours.

name: Master Decker
text:
During summer and Fur Rondy, they are packed.  Expect slower service but good food.

In their not so busy times, service is TYPICALLY well above par.

If your like me and my son, their menu leaves A LOT to be desired.  There's more fish on the menu and if you're allergic to fish it's quite difficult to eat anything here.

This has been brought up several times, and the normal response is "well, we've got burgers.".

But their fries are cooked in the same oil as fish so you can't have those.

This has left us with going there once every 2-3 years.

name: David Sanders
text: In my opinion...best place for beer-battered halibut in town! Great entertainment and brews. Located next door to the Flattop Pizza and Pool.

name: Jennifer V
text: I've been coming here for years it's definitely one of my favorites. Had a long flight from Nebraska to Anchorage and have been looking forward to eating here for months. I got the horseradish halubut with grilled veggies and wasabi mashed potatoes. Friend got the hamburger. We were not disappointed everything tasted great. The only bad part of the evening was that we sat too close to that back door so the cold breeze hit us in the legs every time someone came in and out, which was often. Server was just ok hence the loss of one star. But that won't deter me in coming back.

name: himanshu chaudhary
text: Good beer and staff

name: Thunder Lizard (ratdude6)
text: Good food, service is hit or miss just depends on who your server is. Don't really like how minors cant go after 9PM however the atmosphere is always great.

name: Jason Hunt
text: I really liked it here. Good food and the menu included some vegan options that is hard to find for my wife sometimes. I will definitely be coming back at some point.

name: Cayla Armatti (readlistendream)
text: Humpys is one of my favorite pubs in Anchorage. They have a great selection of beers and ales. They have the best seafood selection in Anchorage, wonderful appetizers,  everything prepared to order, all seafood local. Live alternative style  music nearly every night, casual and friendly staff. Also outside seating if you prefer.

name: Atila Đurik
text: Nice bar, live music, tasty food. It's a little bit pricy, but it's in Downtown.

name: Gerard Ellis
text: 8-25-16, had the halibut & chips for $24. Halibut was excellent with awesome batter, fries were good with my black butte porter $6. Wife had the halibut with crusted horseradish special $24. Interior old school bar setting, outdoor patio with heat in the back.

name: Yuva Natya
text:
Amazing food!
Must try!
It’s super crowded.. but worth it totally!

name: Shopping Bag
text: Humpy’s is an Anchorage tradition, but it’s definitely showing its age after 20+ years of operation. The food, however, is consistently tasty and the service is mostly good. If you’re there in the summer, they have a small outdoor seating area. Seafood and American fare done right.

name: Mr Bacon
text: Service was great. Food was good, but not great. Nice atmosphere

name: Lori Kroening
text: The burger made to order was spectacular.

resp.text: Thanks Lori!  We do like a good burger!

name: Joshua Demain
text: The food was good but the company was unbeatable. Two amazing women who I'm totally blessed to be around. And there was a dinosaur? And pirates and mermaids? I mean... If not for the cod, do it for the atmosphere.

name: Robo H
text: Food was fine - When we got it.  They said to seat yourself.  No clean table, so we sat at one that needed to be cleared and began talking.  Waitress literally huffed as she walked up.  I said I was sorry, but there were no cleared tables anywhere. She said FINE.  Go somewhere else.

name: Marc Murray
text: Everyone knows its great

name: Nicolas PC
text: Nice atmosphere bar, nice decor, good fish ships 🙂

name: Thurston Thistle
text: Great oysters, minus no house sauce. The menu is limited, tough choices.

name: Andre Alexander
text: Spacey and delicious 🖤

name: Jeanna Dockter
text: Asked him about a job and he said come during the week I was hoping to be working by next week

name: Ryan Grzes
text: Good prices and great food! The local craft beer selection was also excellent! I had a reindeer burger and it was excellent! A stop in here is a MUST I think for anyone visiting Anchorage.

name: Aaron Meier
text: I wish i could give this place 6 stars

name: Jim Ketcham
text: Great choices on the menu and excellent selection of microbrews.  3 of our group of 6 went with (locally caught) fish and chips, which was excellent and all were happy with their selections. They happily provided malt vinegar on request, as well. Perfect!

name: Matthew Bates
text: Great burger and beer.

name: Samantha Thornton Delicata
text: Great selection of beers! The night my husband and I went they also had live music playing hits from the early 2000’s (talk about fun). The only reason I left off a star would be for the service, our server acted annoyed when we ordered drinks and food. We ordered the pretzel appetizer which was good.

name: John Noland
text:
Good food and friendly service. Groups larger than 6 were seated on the heated patio on picnic style tables.

I'm not a beer drinker so I just had water. Wine wasn't listed on the menu and I didn't see a wine list. However, our friends had the pale Alaskan brews and were very complementary about their selections.

name: hailey kinsey
text: It's Humpy's! Alway's great beer and cocktail choices and the food is delicious. I highly recommend their salmon dip.

name: Terrance Knight
text: wonderful place

name: Janet James
text: Loved the  steamed clams! Wish they served more bread with them tho. Excellent service! Great place to eat out!

name: Twitchy Scene
text: The first time I came, this place was great, but tonight, the guy at the door was rude and didn't listen, we had to tell twice that my partner and I were our daughter's parents, once before he asked and once after. You really shouldn't have rude people working the door if you want people to stick around. I've worked in food in a city with a populous of 700k people, it being a busy night is no excuse to be rude to potential customers.

name: Fabiana Kirtley
text: They have an amazing portobello mushroom burger and the fries that it comes with are to die for! The nachos are pretty good as well. They have live music and outdoor seating in the summer time.

name: Richard Beal
text: Anything involving halibut is great. The Firehouse Chicken sandwich and burgers were all very good. Just know that seating is based on finding an empty table and grabbing it.

name: Craig
text: Rustic atmosphere and great location are the two primary draws to Humpy's. In the summer it even has outside seating, not that you see much except a parking lot behind the City Center. Service has always been great. However the prices for what you get are on the moderate side. Nothing really pops out from the menu, pretty same fare for the price at any of the other restaurants around Anchorage.

name: David Burdett
text: Awesome place. Awesome food. Awesome staff. Excellent range of beers. Do yourself a favor and visit this place. You won't be disappointed.

name: Malachy Moran
text: I absolutely love Humpy's. I don't drink but my wife tells me they have a really good beer selection. I like the fish and chips personally. Heard they have a Trivia Night too!

name: Derrick VanOrd
text: Great food at a great price. Nice atmosphere as well

name: Tramain Krns
text: Amazing food. Worth the price. Will definitely be back next Anchorage trip!

name: Terrance Aldridge II
text: Humpys was great!  Bacon burger with mushrooms was awesome!  Atmosphere was really laid back service was great!

name: Lea Hancock
text:
We have been here a couple of times and love it. We love the laid back atmosphere. Our favorite dishes are the cod tacos and king crab cakes. Their king crab legs are very delicious as well. We usually have very quick service and we are in / out in about 45 minutes. The beer is a good too.

The only negative thing I would have to say is NOT against the restaurant or our food but our waiter kept forgetting about us. He forgot our appetizers, he forgot our wine, he didn’t give us refills, and we were there for almost 2 hours. I don’t know if he had took a hit of the wacky backy before coming to work or what but he seriously forgot everything. It could have possibly been because there were two pretty girls in the both down from us that he was very interested in. However, I took family from out of town here and he did not make a great impression BUT THE FOOD DID when we finally got it.

name: BigBrainBrotha ThirdEyeZoodotcom
text: Great food. Great staff. Great music. Tell James I sent ya

name: Carmin Beck
text: This place is decieving from the outside. It looks kind of like a big dive bar with food but don't believe your eyes. The food is absolutely delicious! It is seat yourself and there is outdoor seating in the back with both picnic and high tables. All the staff were friendly and helpful. The food was delicious. I highly recommend the cod and chips! Also they had a great beer selection!

name: Cassandra Yeh
text:
Many local people recommend this restaurant.

LOVE the beer selections!!! The staffs are very knowledgeable and they give good recommendation~

We ordered...

Alaskan King Crab Nuggets - So crispy outside, the dipping sauce is very flavorful, just can't get enough! Huge portion of fries too.

Blackened Alaskan Cod Salad -  The fish just melted in our mouth!!! All fresh ingredient~ Love it! However, the salad is $21? I thought the fish in Alaska should be cheaper right? I guess not....

They have a stage in the restaurant, live music in the evening.

name: Juanita Ybarra Rains
text: Never disappointed. Affordable local cuisine served with great customer service. Always satisfied!

name: Deb Mchone-Towsley
text: no service, bar tender stood there looking at us, waitress walked right by twice.. we left and its really a shame because we went right over to glacier brew house and had the crab i was craving, a 200.00 tab, walked right out the door!! wont be back!

name: Ana Owczarzak
text: Great beer selection and atmosphere - we stopped in for karaoke night and the place was rocking. Awesome patio area with picnic tables outside and dark, dive bar atmosphere inside. Beer selection is stellar - boatloads of great options from Alaska and elsewhere. Had fish & chips and a friend halibut that we're just OK, which was a bummer knowing the quality of the ingredients.

name: Shane Mecham
text: Good food, lots of great drink options,  tons of beers on tap.  Halibut chunks are a go to.   Halibut tacos are great.   Seat your self style place,  can get busy,  but worth the wait.   Family friendly,  but defiantly more focussed on adults.   Still great even after all these years.

name: Drea Jo
text:
Good salmon chowder. Recently returned. We sat at a table for several minutes before being greeted. Not a busy night. The booth was broken and my friend almost fell.  The service just wasn’t around. Got in the cab to head back to the hotel. The cab driver stated he keeps hearing his customers say it’s not as good as it use to be.
Need better customer service and to fix the broken booth.

name: Latifah
text: I had the bacon cheese burger it was good. Well cooked. Not too rare not over cooked. I am not a fan of beef bacon but this is the only place I will eat it from. Crispy and juicy. Worth the money. My 2nd favorite item on there menus

name: Carl Davis
text: Fun place with great food selections and live music!!! First time stopping while in town and had an awesome time.  Prices were very reasonable too and if you like dancing this is a great spot!!! Look forward to swing by again when in town and recommend checking out if you haven't already!!!

name: Jonathan Phares
text: Crab rolls, Alaskan king crab nuggets, halibut fish & chips, and the list goes on. We were fortunate to walk past and enter Humpy's in the couple hours between disembarking our cruise ship and getting into our RV rental for Denali. Weren't we lucky! So, so good. The kids are every last morsel off their plates before I could steal another bite! Will go again next time we're in Anchorage

name: LM Cox
text: GREAT STAFF!  Food, overcooked ☹.  Go for the beer and you won't be disappointed. They also have a pay it forward wall, wish it was to feed the homeless... but it's for specific people.

name: Andrew Robyn
text: Outstanding seafood, and a wide selection of brews. You cannot pass this place up!

name: Edmund Ausman
text: Always a great time. Great food, awesome staff. 5 stars plus!!!!!

name: Michael Perez
text: The food and atmosphere were awesome! Service was pretty good even with a packed house

name: A A
text: This place is excellent and we will be back for sure. The wife wanted to go several times during our trip! Food was good as well as the staff and atmosphere. My wife claims they have the best Bloody Mary's shes ever had!

name: Amanda Leurquin
text: Great halibut and fried food! Lots of beer to choose from. Love the music entertainment at night too! Great experience.

name: Matthew Bigman
text: Great location to sample Alaskan style pub food and local beer. Self serve seating can be a bit tricky to learn, come early if you have a big group. Portions of food are generous and delicious. Decor is homey, some of the seats have seen better days.

name: John T
text: Great food, great, fast and friendly service, cool atmosphere, a long time establishment in Anchorage. Our new go to restaurant. Our kids loved it too! We got fish-n-chips, salmon chowder, and king crab nuggets. Highly recommend!

name: Angeline Whitman
text: Just a great place to eat, visit, drink, whatever. Go there, experience it yourself, and offer your own review. I'm sure no one will be disappointed.

name: Storm Huffman
text: Always a pleasure going here. Great food and tap selection. Really excited for them opening their brewery.

name: Erika Barrington
text: Service was great, but food and atmosphere are just ok.

name: Hokulani Fritz
text: Over rated! I was disappointed. Maybe it'll be better next time.

name: Mario Westphal
text: Nice atmosphere. I had the Alaska Amber, some crab nuggets and their reindeer sausage soup. All very delicious.

name: Dan Stomm
text: Casual, relaxing atmosphere with an intoxicating presence that whispers fun. My wife & I had the halibut basket. It was perfect for 2. Sitting on a mountain of fries, the big, juicy , flakey nuggets of halibut were dipped and fried. Yummmy. We'll be back. Might save room for one of those delicious looking desserts next time.

name: Mari Rueter
text: I LOVE HUMPY'S! It is definitely somewhere that represents Anchorage well and even Alaska. They have wonderful food, a great atmosphere, and amazing staff who are very attentive! I go here at least every few months with my family and friends to eat out. It's also a great place to grab a drink. Some bars can be uncomfortable to go to, but this place is always a friendly and safe environment.

name: John Nace
text: Reliable quality and a friendly staff make Humpy's a local institution. Don't miss the crab roll.

name: Andrew Van Ness
text:
This place is a fun bar to go to and the menu has a good selection of food. As the name suggests, the restaurant serves a lot of fish options. There is a good selection of beer.  Our waitress looked like she was college-age, and was very helpful with drink selections.

We didn't eat while we were here, but when I head back to Anchorage, I'll likely try some food.  Walking through the restaurant, we could see plates being served, and the food looked good.

name: kristina elshoff
text: Cool little local watering hole with a surprisingly interesting menu. Laid back atmosphere and nice beer selections

name: S B
text: Place was not too crowded when we went in during a weekday afternoon. They had some of the best clam chowder I've ever eaten!

name: Can ACIKEL
text: Huge menu, good beers.

name: Denise Steve
text: Service was mediocre. Soda beverages tasted old or flat. Server said they haven't had any complaints. Well at least someone letchya know

name: Lydia Johnson
text: I used to go to Humpy's about every other week but it just is not as good. Went the other night for The Office theme pub quiz. The quiz was fun but the food was lackluster. I ordered the Firehouse Chicken Sandwich, used to be my favorite. This time it was so bland! How can something called Firehouse be bland? I would have been happier with Wendy's. I think it will be a while before I try this place again.

name: Child of Fenrir
text: Jalapeno, bacon, cheese burgers are my favorite type and they nailed it.   Great waitresses and cooks.   Love the menus they put out and they have things on them I have never tried.   I look forward to going back there soon.

name: Glen M. Allen
text: I really enjoyed my evening at your establishment! The food selection and quality is great. The atmosphere is very comfortable, friendly and relaxing. The employees were all easy to converse with and seemed to really enjoy there jobs and pleasing your customers...all smiles around. They all seemed in an upbeat mood and quick to see to your every needs. The food is great and the beer choices are many and of excellent variety's as well as quality's. Everyone seemed happy and content all around... Your staff is to be complimented and a well done to all. Good job!  Thank You, Glen Allen.

name: Matthew Brooks-Miller
text: If you're lucky to have live music. Awesome. Live music fairly regularly. EXCELLENT blackened Halibut and Salmon. All the time fun.

name: Dorothy Massey
text: Can you say YUM!! Had the halibut & fries basket & wasn't disappointed!! The staff were great & even paired a brew for me!! Awesomeness!!!

name: Pam g
text: Friendly staff, super tasty food, and fun bar style atmosphere.

name: Kevin Luckey
text: Good eats, not a bad atmosphere, a bit on the expense side though.

name: Paul Nath Sr
text: A must do experience for all this is at its best in all aspects of entertainment,food&beverage staff is well trained and helpful

name: Kurtis Quig
text: Very good food the halibut was very good i didn't taste any other fish that tasted that good inside of Anchorage

name: Ania M.
text: Spot to check out, food is ok .

resp.text: Thank you for vising and for supporting our local business. We would love feedback on how we can improve!

name: MaryAnn Hurlbut
text: Really great.  Good food and great people

name: Neal Slagle
text: We stopped in for a few beers and some food while traversing the downtown area. It's location is a big plus if you're into the downtown night life. Had a good time, and food was pretty food. Live music on Saturday was an enjoyment. The bar seemed more lively than McGinleys which is just around the corner, which is nice too if you're looking for a quieter bar scene.

name: Monica Ivory
text: Was very good food, service, go early before the crowds, a little too moisy

name: Nick Kokotovich
text: Great food, environment and service.

name: diane diangelio
text: i thoroughly enjoyed this establishment. great selection of beers, great atmosphere, and great staff. keep up the god work!

name: Meriwether Lewis
text: Cozy little place, rustic atmosphere with good food and great service

name: Suraiya Knudson
text: Super fun, the live entertainment was amazing.  I ordered the Caesar Salad,  but my chicken was a little dry and tough to eat, but it was ok.  Next time, I would love to try new menu items.

name: Where in the World Is Kate
text: Worst muscle in some crazy sauce, I've ever had.

name: John Gates
text:
best fish I've had in a while.
Great beer selection

name: Gustavo Frances
text: Maybe the spot once but food was ok at best. Fish and chips was ok, not well battered. Good service and beer, but not great food.

name: Bill Kennedy
text: Good food... great beer selection and they are open late!!

name: Eyes
text: Used to love this place. Service had steadily declined the last few visits, but tonight was the last straw. Probably the worst service I've had in Anchorage.  Server "checked" on us from across the room. Had to chase her down for the check and had to take the check to the front just to pay.... Humpys, you lost good customers who took guests and family to your restaurant all the time.

name: Nancy Minnick
text: Fun place with good food and drinks. Friendly staff and good service

name: Cami Pena
text:
Such a fun atmosphere! I would bring anyone here - great beer and awesome food. Booths, tables, bar and seating outside. Lovely place!
I brought my son and niece as well, there was a kids menu and coloring sheets - Staff was fantastic!

name: Ted Booth
text: First was good but vegetables were raw and cold instead of steamed.

name: CorreyHope Kustin
text:
Come on down! Where do you want to have fun? Here at the Alehouse. This is where the Alaskans come to enjoy a bite and a beer. Don't come to late because they will run out of beef.
Especially if you are lucky enough to witness the Kodiak Challenge. This is when someone consumes mass quantities of reindeer sausage, crab, and can finish it off with a brownie. Winners are mentioned in the hall of fame, and have no shame shoving it down!
I was there this past witness and experienced the reindeer sausage contest and watched with a quivering belly the well known champion down his sausages.
This place can guarantee fun and good food.
They have contests and bands almost every night.

name: Peter McDougall
text: Busy bar serving cruise ships. Talks beer but focuses more on pushing food to tourists off ships. Bar staff frantic, made me quite uncomfortable. Felt better out than in. Either hopelessly understaffed or incredibly inefficient, we were pleased to leave

name: Thomas Botteicher
text: Always awesome food and service. No trip to Anchorage is complete without a trip to Humpy's.

name: Tsarina Of Alexandrovsk Alaska
text: Great service good food for you and your family till 9pm, then its adults only. Catch the game gather with friends. Humpy's great

name: Stefani Rhett
text: Food is great. The place needs a smidge of a touch up and service was ehh.

name: James Morowski
text: Had a great time with friends here. This is a very busy place so it takes a bit longer to get food. Go there knowing that and enjoy yourself its worth the wait.

name: Carl Holzhauer
text: Good service, good beer list,food is less than impressive

name: Dakota Rhine
text: The food was excellent. My wife had the Alaskan cod fish and chips and I had the crab roll. Portions are HUGE. They had live music (Friday Night) and we got there in time to get a good table. The waiter was a bit rude but got better as we ordered more drinks.

name: Dave Tanchak
text: It's a very busy place full locals so we thought the food would be really good... if you like you seafood deep fried then you will like this place.. I had the King crab but I could tell that it had been around for a long time (not fresh).. and when you are paying $50 for it it should be!.. or don't serve it!

name: Gary Fritz
text: Food was good and the service was attentive and accommodating

name: Jonnie Dolan
text: Went for open mic night on Father's Day. I love the house band and I want to be just like Lisa when I grow up. What a great night!

name: Brantley McManus
text: The pan seared halibut was delicious a little pricey but very good

name: Xavier Collazo
text: Humpy's has a great atmosphere for hanging out with friends if your looking for decent bar food, great drinks, and live music(when available). The only thing i don't like about it is the limited side they have by the stage. It can get pretty crowded when there's a band. Otherwise it is an awesome place to relax and enjoy your time.

name: Hemigod
text: The service is always hit or miss with this place.  The food is usually always the same quality and it's pretty good.  Most of the bartenders make a good drink.  Get a window seat and you'll probably see something entertaining happening outside.

name: David Harper
text: We stopped in for lunch while in Anchorage. It was a bit loud due to the music, but not terrible. We shared a bowl of the reindeer chili which as pretty good and a crab roll which in my opinion was pretty poor. They say it is similar to a lobster roll, but only reminds me of the bad ones I have had. It is more of a seafood salad mix on toast in which you really can not taste the crab since everything is minced very fine. Beer and service were good. I would likely try the place again, but would avoid the crab roll.

name: Elaine Lott
text: Humpys food has gone downhill. They need to change their cooking oil.

name: Terrenna Giles Brown
text: Atmosphere was good. Live music not to loud, good songs. Got mixed seafood platter. Cod, halibut, calamari and fries. Very good for the money.

name: Colby “Cheezee”
text: I thought the food was good. And the service was great. I only have it 4 instead of 5 because of the tourist prices.

name: Marcel Jussaume
text: Great craft beer selection, good menu, Reasonable prices, attention but not overbearing staff.

name: Iowachick
text: The staff is excellent and very friendly, great food and a fun music venue. Sunday night Open Mic is great, don't miss it!!

name: Gideon Crowell
text: Always good food, beer, and service.

name: Mark Wilson
text: The crab cake sandwich was amazing and the fries were perfect.

name: Sierra
text: This place is great and definitely worth stopping at if you're in the Anchorage area.

name: Adrienne Keck
text: Fun place. We actually love to go here for breakfast. The halibut Benedict is the best.

name: Izaak Philip Bruce
text: Nice bar, good drink selection.

name: Justin Williams
text: Fun environment,  good music was playing, good beer, and the crabby patty was epic

name: Brian l
text:
This place has only improved over the years. I was regular when I was in my 20's. i was such a frequent customer that my favorite server knew exactly what I wanted before I even sat down and she would bring me my food right away. The only thing she had to ask me was what beer I wanted that day.
As a former employee, I do have an ax to grind with one of the managers but as a customer, I can only say good things. I am always recommending Humpy's to visitors who ask me a good place to eat.
If you go, try to have Bonnie as your server, she is the best.

name: Edie Polar Bear
text: The food was over rated. $16 for 6 shrimps. No thanks.

name: Audrey E
text: Always too crowded during tourist season. They have live music too

name: Tom Stolze
text: Fun atmosphere, good food, large portions.

name: Brian Booth
text: Inside outside seating, fish and chip were recommended, the Halibut was delicious, fries were good.the wife had Chicken Fettachini, it showed up missing the chicken, by the time the chicken was served, we had just about finished the meal. Waitress was asked for a extra glass of water, never received. I do not think the waitress listened to 10 % of questions or requests. Not very Impressed

name: Dawn McBurney-Hibben
text: I have  never gone here for  breakfast  before, and it was delicious! Lots of menu choices, and ample serving sizes. I would definitely recommend this  place.

name: Kateri Candee
text: Food was ok. Service was terrible. The server acted as though us coming in was an inconvenience for her. My guess is she had to wait on three women and wanted to have guys instead so she could try for a bigger tip. First time at this place and it will be my last.

name: Bonnie Glaze
text: Probably the best 'dinner' food we had on our whole trip! And the local alcoholic beverage selection is plentiful! Great and friendly service too!

name: Elisha Waugh
text: Great live music and delicious food. What's not to like?

name: Robert Mcgill
text: Really nice place and friendly service. Would recommend it without reservation.

name: Kyle Hampton
text: The beer is plentiful and they work to incorporate Alaskan ingredients into their dishes. It has standard pub fair; you can't go wrong with a burger, whether beef, halibut, or reindeer.

name: Kirk Byron
text: Always a good choice  good variety  good food. Several beers on tap

name: Jennifer Walsh
text: Ok , I'm a little disappointed right now .. but last night after work me and a friend and my son decided to go eat at humpys like we do every year for st Patty's day . text:
SLOW SERVICE, UNEVEN QUALITY OF FOOD
I really want to like Humpy's, but every time I go, it's something else.  I have lived in Anchorage for 20 years and have gone to Humpy's hundreds of times.  Throughout all that time, I can honestly say that I have NEVER had good service. Period.  Slow.  Forgetful.  Usually nice, personable, and even entertaining servers, just not very good at their jobs.  Food has ranged from deliciously perfect to inedible.  How does one plan around that?  They have good bands and a fun atmosphere.

We've been visiting Humpy's more since H3 has been performing on weekends.  The atmosphere has been very nice, with lots of familiar faces and no drama.

A couple of side notes:
We love the kalua pork nachos, but they ran out of chips on one occasion.  Not a big deal for me, but might be a big deal for others.  The beer-battered halibut and fries are great to share with a cold beer and friends.

It didn't dawn on me how convenient it is that Humpy's is close to other nightlife spots so you can hop around to find what you like.

name: Scott Carter
text:
Gives off a "local bar" vibe that you may or may not enjoy. Darker on the inside, and cleaning obviously doesn't take place on the higher portions of the restaurant. Cobwebs and dust grace the random knick-knacks, decorations, and old draft handles along the walls.

Despite offering their own beers, our waitress tried to steer us towards another brand of beer when I asked for her input. Nothing on the menu shows pride in their brews like pairing options or even a description beyond the name "Humpy's Pale Ale." I did end up ordering one, and it was very forgettable, which I was disappointed at.

The market price for crab was a bit high when compared to other places in the local area, so ended up getting the reindeer burger and halibut/fries. The fish and burger were so-so, but the fries were actually really good. The berry crisp was AMAZING and definitely worth it.

name: Shelby T
text:
My husband and I spent the morning running around downtown and decided to grab lunch while we were out. We randomly picked Humpys, and man are we glad we did! We’re from the NE, we know food. And having been in Delaware the last 5 years, we know seafood too. This was one of the first places(since arriving in August) where we both loved what we ordered. I ordered the crabby melt and substituted the fries for their smoked salmon chowder and my husband got the crab roll and also the chowder. The chowder.. was AMAZING.  just so good. It may even be my new go to when I’m craving comfort food. And my sandwich was equally delicious. So much flavor. I did not try what my husband ordered but I’m assuming since he downed it in 5 mins, it was also good lol.
It is a cool and unique atmosphere as well, very dive bar meets eccentric Alaska. It was fun. Good rotating beer section as well, if that’s your thing.
But it was our waitress who really added the finishing touch and made this a great experience. She was kind and helped me decide between two items I was stuck between, had all of our food out in great timing and even chatted with us a bit.
Overall we had a wonderful visit and are so glad we chose to go here. I would definitely recommend Humpys for a nice casual evening out with your spouse. But maybe leave the kids at home for this one.

Expect a longer than average wait for your meal on a Sunday morning.  They have a build your own bloody mary bar in it is quite popular.

name: David Huntley
text:
Editing my Review:

I've now decided that this place gets a 1 star, reasoning, it used to be a great place to go and eat with your friends or even hang out at. Now its just a Novelty place, a place where someone out of town can say, Hey I've been to Humpy's. The food was HORRIBLE, yesterday 03.02.2019 was out 19th Wedding Anniversary and my wife wanted to eat at her favorite place, which is you guessed it Humpy's. We arrived around 4:30pm which is 30 minutes before the evening specials would take effect. We ordered her food, and the kids their food while I decided to wait the 30 minutes to order the Filet Mignon for 28.00 bucks.. After ordering it, I still had to wait almost 30 minutes before the so called Filet Mignon came out, it was the most HORRIBLE piece of meat ever, even Golden Corral's steaks taste better. I asked for Medium Rare and there was no pink what so ever, 80% of it was FAT. There was no flavor at all with this thing.
Another thing I disliked about this place was the service, used to be an upbeat super friendly establishment but now horrible, we ordered extra cherries so my kids could split them, the waiter brought 4 in my daughters drink, so I asked again for more cherries so they could share. He brought 2 more, I had to ask other staff to get a box, or even the bill. Man this place has sure gone downhill, its no wonder it was or might still be on the chopping block. This reviewer was not happy and if I had my wait probably would not even go back, you are not missing anything by not going here. There are so many other places that would better serve you and have better tasting food.
We will go back? Probably, again it's my wife's favor place to eat. However will order anything like this again? Not from this place, I explained to my wife we can go back but I will watch them eat because I'm for one not eating there again....

text:
(Translated by Google) This restaurant was recommended to us by a local from Anchorage. It really seems to be a cult pub. Because we were there just before 12 noon and got the last table. Later, until dinner, everyone is in the queue and waiting for the table.
Highly recommended are the fish and chips and the cot fish and chips for $ 14.95. We travel a lot in America and like to eat fish and chips, but we have never tasted such delicious ones. Fresh, spicy, crispy and with a really delicious remoulade. The beer costs as everywhere in Anchorage about $ 7. However, there is a bar called "Pioneer Bar" in the center, where all beers cost $ 5.75 and some even $ 3.50.
The waitress in the Humoys was very nice.
Free wifi without password, which is already very generous for Alaska.
Every evening there is music by another artist. So, in turn, see photo with the plan for July, for example.

(Original)
Dieses Restaurant wurde uns von einem Einheimischen aus Anchorage empfohlen. Es scheint wirklich eine Kult Kneipe zu sein. Denn wir waren um kurz vor 12 mittags dort und haben den letzen Tisch bekommen. Später bis zum Abendessen stehen alle in der Warteschlange und warten auf den Tisch.
Zu empfehlen sind die Fish and Chips und zwar der Cot fish und Chips für 14,95 $. Wir sind viel in Amerika unterwegs und essen Fish and Chips gerne, aber so leckere haben wir noch nie gegessen. Frisch, würzig, knusprig und mit einer wirklich  leckeren Remoulade. Das Bier kostet wie überall in Anchorage ca. 7$. Es gibt jedoch eine Bar Namens "Pioneer Bar" auch im Zentrum, in der alle Biersorten 5,75 $ und einige sogar ab 3,50 $ kosten.
Die Bedienung im Humoys war sehr nett.
Kostenloses Wlan ohne Passwort, was für Alaska schon sehr großzügig ist.
Jeden Abend gibt es Musik von einem anderen Künstler. Also abwechselnd, sehe Foto mit dem Plan für Juli z.B.

name: Ryan Stafford
text:
Outdoor seating!

TGI Friday's a great place to eat dinner.  They have plenty of booths for large families, tables for small groups in the bar, and outdoor seating for those warm sunny days.  Nearly anything you can think of is on the menu here and I believe all the food tastes good to great.  Sadly the food isn't always correct or cooked the way you'll like it.  If the burger is cooked medium well and the cheese isn't melted... draw your own conclusions.

name: Tex Lonser
text: Came in with a coupon. Same one I used last week. Now they dont accept them. Say there are signs posted in the entrance. The entrance is under construction and you cant get in to see the posting! Still, no coupon for you! Manager was rude too. Feel free to use it if you can.

name: Jim Avery
text:
Interesting decor. They have daily  value specials.
In addition to the TGI menu, they offer local  selections called "Alaskan Flavors".

name: Yidder Stitch
text: If I could give this restaurant negative stars I would. First off the menu was off by stating certain items came with the meal. Secondly they tried to charge me for all of these up charges. Then when I called a manager over to do his job he apologized and said they we’re closing the TGIF at that location and opening Bear’s Paw. Instead of simply comping those items, because the menu was wrong, and ruining my Christmas dinner with my family! I will never eat there or soon to be Bear’s Paw! More to come because, I will also be making more comments to the BBB.

name: Crystal Klein
text: Sat on the bar side, great service.  Tommy kept the drinks coming and checked on us often. We took full advantage of the half-price appetizers.  Food and drinks were great! Can't wait to go back, too many tasty choices to get in one trip.

name: Sarah Allyn
text: Langostino lobster is not a lobster at all but more closely related to a hermit crab. It tasted like a hermit crab, too. The staff was wonderfully accommodating, though.

name: Kyle Green
text: Food was TGI Friday's good for dinner service. The service we received was excellent. Our waiter, John, did a great job checking on us and making sure our glasses were kept full and our needs were met. We stayed for quite a while, past John's shift, and after he left we experienced no check-ins (even though we were told someone was going to check in), and something rambunctious going on could be heard very loudly from the kitchen several times as employees jeered on someone.

name: Christopher .Jordan
text: Declining service and food. It used to be super great. But over the years I feel it has declined. Once they couldn't figure out how to do our check for like 45 min. But they ended up comping my meal. I noticed that they dont have "Jack Daniel's" burger or steak now it's just called "whiskey" burger. They over cooked my friends steak multiple times. No medium rare allowed or something. I do still love the servers though they are very nice though. I haven't given up on one of my favorite restaurants yet.

name: Jerre Hudgins
text: Food was tasty at a fair price and the staff was friendly and reasonably nice.  There is a good selection of different things to eat and is located in a busy part of town so you can stop by there if you have business in the area.  Everything was average but the "good" kind of average.  Nothing was exceptional by any means, but there's nothing wrong with stopping there to grab a bite by yourself or with company.

name: Michelle Proffitt
text: Decent portions and good flavor. I had the 8 oz center cut sirloin. Other than a bit of gristle was really good. The side salad was delish, there was no brown/wilted lettuce which always makes it better

name: Al Risden
text: This was my first visit to TGI Fridays in Alaska, or anywhere as far as I remember. We chose it because of the proximity to the hotel in Anchorage and it's family atmosphere. Actually we didn't know that for sure but the ads seemed to give that impression. We were not disappointed. I, as I often do, chose the nachos even though they're normally listed in the appetizer section. The volume is usually satisfying because I have little self control and this order followed suit. The presentation on the plate was better than any I can remember. I almost didn't want to break up the arrangement but did so enthusiastically. I was extremely satisfied and will visit again if near one. The server was also very knowledgeable and accommodating.

name: Ryan Newton
text: I don't eat at Fridays often, I'm on the other side of town, but do enjoy their food.  I really enjoyed the service the other day when I was out with a difficult person to take orders for.  Cher the waitress and Don the GM did a great job of handling a difficult customer and did so with a great amount of tact and respect.  Thanks again!!

name: Dana Kostreba
text: Waitress was great but my $15 burger was a disappointing ripoff. Two small shreds of lettuce, a 1-in piece of onion and a 1.5-in thin slice of tomato consisting mostly of inedible core. Two stars only because the shrimp my dining partner ordered was satisfying.

name: Forrest Odom
text: My food was fine, but unfortunately the people I was with had the hardest time getting what they ordered. It took three tries to get the right steak before they just settled. First time was clearly not the right cut of meat, then the second time was right but over cooked and then the third was better but still wrong and forced them to have to get it to go so they could make there movie.  There for an hour and half to just get the wrong food

name: Moore Fam
text:
This is a very clean restaurant, has consistent food and always a friendly & competent wait staff. Good burgers & local beers, reasonable prices. They have chicken, steak, seafood & pasta dishes ranging from $13-25 for most items as well. No Mexican or Italian. Kid friendly but not annoyingly so, also has a child menu and sometimes even balloon animal artists. Business is managed well. Family friendly all around booths and tables are a good size.

Clean bathrooms, always. We come to this place every time we're in town.

name: Mamalai Telea
text:
If I can rate a negative star I would.  My server had the worst attitude. She rushed our order , mixed our order and messed up our order . She didn't offer us any appetizers , she didn't ask if we wanted any refills till we were ready to pay. She also had a different server rush us to pay out already , really ? I'll be calling in the morning to talk with a manager . Btw, they stole .22 cents as a tip. NEVER I had I ever had a bad experience with TGIF ! Its my happy place with my family on a rough day .

Ever washed your hands with your own ice from the soda you've order because they didn't bring a wet towelettes ? I did ! Thanks for the worse experience ever to the two young ladies who wanted to go home so bad.  Not that I also notice then talking about me as I watched them both look at me a few times .

Expect the call TGIF !

name: With a Y
text: I haven't been here in years, and I would probably not go back. The service was good, and prices aren't too bad, but I wasn't very impressed with the appetizers. The beer cheese was unpleasant to even look at, much less taste! And the server said a lot of people don't like it. The potato skins were bland and greasy. Sadly, I won't go back.

name: David Stock
text: Good food for a fair price. Service was also quick and attentive. My New York strip was cooked perfect. If I could give a 1/2 star, i would.  4.5.

name: M M
text: We attempted to dine at the Anchorage location on 6/22/19 at 4:35.  We were seated near the door.  After 10 minutes no server even greeted us.  The table behind us sat down after us, and a server visited that table twice.  At the hostess station there were 2 employees chatting, we told them that no server would help us.  They had no response and simply kept chatting on company time.  That's 3 employees who ignored us.  Don't come here if you want to spend money or eat.

name: Nicholas Killeen
text: I had the ribs are they were great and friendly service.

name: Jerry Baedif
text: Kind of an upscale bar/restaurant. Excellent service can always be expected. Food is always AAA+ and drinks are superb. Make sure you try some yummy appetizers while waiting for your meal.

name: Amber Gilstrap
text: Tommy is by far best server ever.. great food... highly recommended...

name: Kyle McClanahan
text: Nice atmosphere. Had chips and artichoke dip and buffalo ranch flatbread. Both were delicious and fresh.

name: Natalie Knight
text: The cooks should be respectful and wash their hands, after using the bathroom.  Not going back here.

name: Marques Thomas

name: Ryan Stafford
text:
If you're looking for a great hike in the Anchorage area then consider Flattop Mountain.

Did you know you can take a shuttle from Downtown Anchorage to the Flattop parking lot?  Search for Flattop Mountain Shuttle and you'll find it.

During the summer Flattop is home to blueberries, bears, moose, and plenty of people.  Be careful of dogs and runners around the corners.

The parking is not free, so bring a $5 bill.  Bring water and a snack with you too, no stores up here.  Finally dress in layers to deal with wind.

The top of Flattop is large enough to find a peaceful spot to rest.  You'll find a few holes that will shelter you from wind.  There is also a flag up here that many get their picture next to.

In the winter time I like to bring up a thermos of hot coffee.

text: This loop trail was a great way to start my solo hiking adventure in Alaska. With the exception of the final summit, the trail was moderately easy with steps cut into the steeper sections. The final summit, however, was a completely different matter. It was a hard scramble to the top with a choose-your-own-adventure feel to the exact route. Somehow, I managed to lose the common trail both on the way up and on the way down. I still made it to the top, albeit with a few tense moments of sliding rocks and some skinned knuckles. And the views were worth it - I will definitely repeat the hike the next time I visit Alaska.

name: Roy Conley
text: I have lived in Fairbanks for 12 years and I have visited Brewster's three times. All three times they have brought me cold french fries. The previous two times I requested fresh ones and I swear they just dip them back in the oil and brought them to me. I was reluctant to go but a friend of mine insisted saying it was her favorite place. It wasn't because of the food I sure you but because she had friends who work there. I ordered a bacon burger $14.99 including fries. They didn't ask me how I wanted it and I didn't say as I was not thinking. They brought it to me virtually Charco. There was no juice left in it whatsoever. I prefer mine medium rare. They also brought me cold fries but they replace them with warm ones quickly. The waitress was friendly and efficient I can't say the same for the cook. I swear they had cooked these patties for the lunch rush which didn't come and had left them on the grill and anticipation of an order. When finally we showed up they were well past their prime time. I am not impressed with the quality of any of their food and I make specially not impressed with the cost. I don't go out to eat to party and I'm guessing that's the clientele they are counting on. I go out to eat quality food I don't want to cook at home

name: Jennie Ramirez
text: Very cool experience! Jane sends videos to watch ahead of time since we can’t be indoors to review instructions and tells you about the history of how it came to be a tour business. They introduce the reindeer and have great stories about them all. You walk up a hill with the reindeer and then get to take photos with them. The cookies and hot chocolate is a nice touch at the end.

name: Iddet Milian-Prada
text: I could not have asked for a better morning than to spend it here at this reindeer ranch.  We spent a week in Fairbanks for our honeymoon and I knew I could not leave without visiting this place.  Reservations are a must because this is a private home/property.  The story behind the ranch is amazing and so is the work they do. Jane is the owner and she’s awesome. She knows so much about them and is interested and able to answer all questions. The tour is over an hour long and it ends with a nice sit and chat with cookies and tea. There were lots of reindeer around. Lots of opportunities and views to take pictures. Great atmosphere and hospitality. If you are coming to Fairbanks I suggest you don’t leave without coming here.

name: Chris Betts
text: I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting fairbanks who wants to get up close and personal with Reindeer. Not too far out of the city and the staff is very knowledgeable.

name: David Claar
text: Reindeer are better than people, at least that is what the song says. Come to Running Reindeer Ranch and judge for yourself. Jane, the owner,  really knows her stuff. Along with her staff, she gives you a hands-on tour that includes history, information, petting, and all the pictures you can take. During our visit, we searched for antlers, socialized babies by petting them, collected the shedding fur right off the animals, and touched the reindeer to our heart's content. The visit was both educational and fun. Maybe not better than people, but reindeer are sure fun to hang-out with for an afternoon!

name: Drina Lu
text:
If I could give it 10 stars I absolutely would! We had a blast interacting with the reindeer! Walking through the forest with the reindeer just doing their thing was so incredible to witness. Jane is hilarious and awesome, a great guide and reindeer mama. Elsa is super knowledgeable and funny as well!

Before and after the walk, they spent time educating us all about reindeer and caribou which was fascinating! You certainly get your money's worth! If you were to go in the early summer you'd have a good chance at seeing a baby reindeer.

If I'm ever in the area again I will make it a point to see Jane and her heard on another tour.

name: roxanne wilbur
text: A JOYFUL experience! Very knowledgeable on the history and the anatomy of the reindeer. We all gathered inside for a short history of how Running Reindeer Ranch came to be and how it got its name.  Then the walk with them into the forest was amazing and lovely to see them freely wandering and eating lichen in a natural habitat and running in between us. Then an hour or so later back inside for cookies, coca and more shared knowledge of reindeer. Fabulous!!

name: Mandi Herr
text: Jane and her reindeer at the Running Reindeer Ranch were so fun! My husband and I learned a lot about reindeer and really enjoyed the tour of the ranch. Would highly recommend! Glad we were able to experience this excursion.

resp.text: I'm a little confused by the review, Running Reindeer Ranch is not near a river. The Riverboat discovery is on the river and has reindeer maybe that's what you saw. My first trip to this McDonald's resulted in completely dried out and overcooked chicken tenders. I had bought two six-piece boxes. They were not edible and I ended up giving them to a lady with a dog staying at my hotel. Fido seemed to enjoy them immensely.

I gambled and opted to try this establishment one more time as I had a "buy one sandwich get one free" coupon. As it was after the dining area closed, I used the drive-thru to place my order. After ordering two quarter-pounders with cheese, I proceeded to the window to pick up my order and pay.

I handed the young lady my coupon. And after staring at the cash register, told me that this coupon was only good inside. I've been using the coupons for more than a year at McDonald's across Alaska. I explained that to her and she stared at me. I told her never mind. She immediately handed me the coupon back without an apology, further explanation, or a "kiss my keester".

I won't go back to that particular McDonald's. I then drove to another McDonald's which also had a closed dining area. However, I had no problems whatsoever in utilizing my coupon via the drive-thru.

name: Eric Collier
text: Tonight was the first time that we tried the Hot Pot experience in the Fairbanks area. We were able to be seated right away and our drink order was taken as we were seated. I would say the restaurant was at 45% capacity and we started our meal around 745pm. Over all service was great. The wait staff explained the whole hot pot process because the menu can be somewhat unknown if you haven't eaten there before. For three adults and very full bellies the bill was just shy of $80. This included a 20% tip. Food quality was fresh and you cook it to your liking. Over 16 different dipping sauces that you can fondue together to make a great meal.

name: stacey jankowski
text:
The food was delicious, the portions were good, the service was friendly and quick. I will definitely be going back for more.
I had to come back and edit my review since I have had dinner here several more times. The food is consistently delicious, cooked and seasoned to perfection. Every bite is delightful. If you're searching for a good place to enjoy a Chinese cuisine meal, just stop in here.

Very good experience!

text:
Unique dining option for Fairbanks.

You can choose either the Hot Pot or classic dining option. Try the Hot Pot! Arguably the healthiest dining out food option in Fairbanks. The wait staff are very friendly and helpful with explaining how to operate the pot if it's your first time.

I recommend getting a combo plate your first time to try a variety of the menu, then doing ala carte option during your next visits (I bet you'll visit more than once!).

The borders of the nails along the cuticles were uneven and sometimes overlapping on the skin, which causes the nails to not last as long, peel, chip, etc. You can also see how uneven the edges are.

When I checked out they told me that if I had any issues I cold come back and they would fix them, which is great, but I was only in Fairbanks for a visit, and I'd rather have my nails done right, then have to go back and get them fixed.

I will not be going back to this salon and wouldn't suggest it to others.
