Food was good, the server was nice but the food took forever to be served. Gluten-free friendly.

The bottom floor is open seating and we were able to find a spot there quickly. The indoor and outdoor seating on the upper floors had a wait at dinner time.

The yak burger was flavorful but also dry, and the salmon burger tasted great, but the quantity was less.

name: Mike Marcum
text: Superb service and food, the cask aged blood orange IPA was smooth

name: Amy Lieb
text: This reminds me of NY to crowded, in small spaces, you will be able to stand there for 10 minutes not approached. Too busy

name: Gabriel Gross
text: Staff made our visit. They recommended delicious beer, even for my wife who is not generally a beer drinker. We didn't go for the food but after looking at the menu we got two appetizers which were fantastic. Yakadillas were perfect between the two of us. They even bottled a desert drink for our flight home.

name: Jim Kelly
text: The food was surprisingly far better than I was expecting.  There's different places to eat like inside downstairs, upstairs, and a balcony with views up the port and more.  If you like beers they have several but you don't have to drink beer at all if you don't wish to.

name: Child of Fenrir
text: I got the yak burger and yak sausage.    Both were great.  Also the crab stuffed jalapenos.    Favorite beer there was the habanero mango beer.  It has a great bite.  The waitress was the one to recomend them and I'm glad she did.

name: Clayton spann
text: Very much enjoyed this place are here 2 times during our stay mainly do to outside rooftop seating. Food and beer very good I very much enjoyed seafood chowder service was mixed sometimes great other times sub par. Would certainly recommend

name: Roberta Berthold
text: Great place for drinks and food. Everything we ordered was great

name: Joseph Dutko
text: Fantastic place to eat, food is delicious and portions are really good sized.  They brew some really special beers to taste, so you have a good list to choose from on the menu.  The your servers are super friendly & quick.  If you go and want a great views ask for the 3rd floor deck seating, you'll get great views of Cook's Inlet, the surrounding mountains ranges and if you're really lucky you just may get to see Denali.  We had a very nice time there and so will you.

name: Rick Nobers
text: Several levels including the rooftop which overlooks water. I did the latter. Good food  and great beer selection. Started with seafood dip app. I did the Halibut Tacos for my entree. Very large portions and more than enough food. My service here was slow and inattentive. The joint wasn't busy.

name: Forrest Odom
text: Unfortunately they were terrible slow. I called in for pick up and they put me on hold for over 15 mins to have them just hang up me. When I called back and was placed on hold again for over 10 mins. I place my order and was told.it would be 20 to 30 mins. Out of courtesy I could tell they were busy so I gave them the 30 before I headed that way. When I had arrived it had been 40 mins from the initial order I went inside and the order hadn't even been started so I had to wait another 20 mins before I got my food. I'll still be a customer but totally let down.

name: Bob Chan
text: I loved the food and the environment was perfect! However they told us the wait would be about 30 minutes but in reality they made us wait over 55 minutes until we bothered them and they sat us. Also once we got seated no one came to serve us for over 15 minutes. Our waiter was also serving the big private room so he never came to us. I understand that a group of 4 isn’t as important as a giant group of people but there was just horrible service

name: Abigail Black
text: I love their selections of beers. They got unique appetizers perfect for a large group.

name: Robin Dern
text: Alex and Daniela helped us have another wonderful 49th State experience last night. We’ve been coming to this restaurant since it took over from the Snow Goose and it just keeps getting better. Their halibut dishes are all excellent, as is their Crab Grilled Cheese, but last night we went for items new to us. The Poke Bowl, Spicy Buddha Bowl (vegan) and Crab Avacado Toast are now on our favorites list. For the appetizer it was cauliflower Buffalo wing style...and the three of us devoured it in under 5 minutes. Alex talked me into trying an Old Fashion with Skrewball Peanut Butter Whiskey. It went down a little too easy...very good suggestion. 49th State brews in house and has many beers and ciders to choose from. So many that you might decide on a flight or to take some home. They feature growlers but also have crowlers (the can version) so that your beer will keep longer. Dessert was decadent! Their bread pudding is award winning and it is clear why. The atmosphere there is always fun and lively, they often host show and music, they have banquet rooms to rent for events and they have a great gift shop as well. On a spring/summer day, ask for a table on their fabulous patio...the views are fantastic!

name: Steve D
text: Tried several flights of local brews and all were outstanding.  Food was expertly prepared and was awesome.  Halibut and chips, Elk meatball, Elk stew were something you need to try. Great service to boot! I cannot say enough good here! This is a must visit place on your bucket list.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Steve.  Glad you could enjoy some of our delicious locally sourced proteins. Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Heven Demo
text:
Service can be slow because it gets busy but the food is great and so is the outside sitting. I personally love the poutine and they have the only pretzels I'll ever like. Their drinks are also not to shabby and I go here from time to time to hang out with friends.
The atmosphere is nice and so is the food and drinks. Just a warning that it gets extremely busy so it may take long to get a few things.

name: Bridget Coolick
text: Really nice sports bar with two outdoor patios with views of the water. The food was fantastic - I recommend the tuna nachos and crab legs. The service was excellent. We went on a Sunday, got there about 20 minutes after opening and it was already busy. Get there early if you want to sit outside without a long wait. Highly recommend this spot!

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Bridget.  Glad you could enjoy our oceanic view with or Crab Legs fresh from the frigid waters of the Bering Sea.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Connor Reynolds
text: What a great place. Growing up in Bend, I know a lot about breweries and this place definitely reminds me of home. Amazing staff and great food. THEY HAVE VEGAN OPTIONS! The impossible burger was delicious and they have a vast beer selection. I had the Far North by Northwest. They offer blankets when you sit outside and have a birthday special ($25 off your meal). Make sure you sign up online! They do collaboration brews with other PNW breweries, so I definitely suggest having one when you visit. Decent pricing for food made with local ingredients. Highly suggest getting there early. Wait time can be around 40 minutes, unless you have a party of 10 or more. If so, then you can make a reservation.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Connor. We are happy that you enjoyed our collaboration been with Ninkasi Brewing Company, we are always trying to push the limits on where we can go with beer.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Chano Williams
text: Very Alaskan feel. Great lighting. Excellent food with nice variety. Superb service. Gluten-free pizza is a win. Almost completely legit Philly cheesesteak. Outdoor dining. A+

name: Alan Chung
text:
1st time here after great recommendations from friends. The place was inviting and great atmosphere.  Staffs were friendly and very attentive. Our server greeted us promptly and the orders were placed after some great suggestions. We went with the calamari, panko halibut cheeks and crab sandwich.

Calamari came out less than 5 mins and cooked to perfection. Tender and nice crunchy batter.

Then came the lunch.  Crab sandwich tasted great and balanced flavor on fresh bread. However the issue I had was on the halibut cheeks. It had a very strong ammonia odor (with indicates the meat wasn't fresh) after I broke a piece off. The server quickly removed the dish and gave the menu for another entree. So we ended up with a meatball dish which was ok.

Though the server promptly corrected the issue. There's something that I wish he wouldn't have done.  That is to question if I knew what halibut cheek was. Even if I didn't what halibut cheek was, fresh fish shouldn't have ammonia smell.  Perhaps I have a more sensitive snout but I can't ingest something that's rotting knowingly. To be fair I only docked a ☆ due to the fish not the server.

name: A Hartmann
text: Thank yall so much. The mushroom burger was perfect. The smoky beer was a great compliment.

name: Nick Madison
text: It's a decent place for a beer and a pretzel

name: Mari Rueter
text:
I love 49th State! My first experience was at the original location in Healy, which was amazing, so I was very excited to find out they'd be opening an Anchorage location.
They have a wide variety of food to choose from, so everyone is likely to find something for themselves. I love the Alaskan twists on the dishes and I have always been happy with whatever I ordered. My particular favorite dish is the Bison Meatloaf!!!
The staff is always attentive and friendly! And the view is beautiful!
I recommend this to any visitors from out of town and locals alike!

name: Zachary Jones
text: Amazing everytime! Took my wife here for date night and they never fail.  Beer was perfect and the food was delicious!

name: beau mccay
text: good food. Chain restaurant that doesn't feel like a chain! Love this place!

name: Wendy Duncan
text: Great seafood chowder. The crab and cheese sandwich is amazing. We had the onion rings as an appetizer and they were soooooo good! All the food was delicious. I only gave 4 stars just because our service was a bit slow. Love this place and will be back!!

name: Molly Woo
text: Awesome views from the 2nd floor. Avocado fries are awesome!

name: Cas
text: Very busy, but great friendly staff. Food was amazing and nice sized portions! Hubby enjoyed the Flagship flight beer taster, while we nibbled on Yak- a -dilla as a starter which was so yummy. Either by yourself or sharing, it's a must have. Then we indulged in the King crabby grilled cheese with fries and mini chowder for dipping. 👍👍👍👍

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Cas. Glad you enjoyed the Yak-A-Dilla, we source our Yak locally from Circle F Farms in St Elias, AK.  Farm Fresh the Table, YUM!

name: N R
text: Food was delicious and the staff were friendly and helpful for the whole meal. The menu is one that there's about five or six things that you would love to try but don't want to see the bill if you do! BEER is awesome, at this restaurant and in general😋.

name: Christi Foist
text: Plenty of take-out beer options and outdoor seating. Really liked the bittersweet chocolate porter I tried.

name: Tim Hufford
text:
Still open with spread out seating for now.
Their crab cakes are delicious, but their pot roast poutine steals the show. Accompanirmes this with bitter chocolate porter, and finished it off with their orange creme brulee....which has taken the creme brulee to a whole 'nother level.
It would be pretty hard to go wrong eating or drinking here

name: Steven Carter
text: All of the staff is amazing as is their food and drinks.

name: Brandon Polen
text:
Waited a good while for 2 wrong orders, when mine finally came, king crab legs were a bit cold and soggy (past visits were great)
I didn't feel like waiting any longer for food.
Server didn't apologize for orders being wrong first time at all, wasnt attentive nor asked how things were
about 2 weeks ago.

name: Adela Eller
text: I love the Augtoberfest area. Very relaxed European feel. Great destination for a beer and pretzel when you're biking the Coastal trail

name: Alex Kreilich
text: So good we sat on the patio in 15 degree weather. Yak burger is worth it!

name: Erik Ottosen
text:
Killer food at high but not horrific prices with an emphasis on local grown everything they can, a fine theater, and a good array of beers and two top-tier house-made sodas make this one of the best brewpubs in the city.

Be aware, the downstairs bar is open seating - be prepared to hunt for a seat. If you're willing to be patient, dining room reservations upstairs are lower stress but may take an hour or even two.

name: ak art
text: One of the best Reubens in town .

resp.text: Thank you so much!!!!  We.would love any feed back.to.make your experience  5 star

name: Andrew Thornsley
text: Great views.  Food was pretty average (except for the price which seemed a bit high).  Didn't try the beer.  Probably wouldn't return.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to review your recent dining experience with us. If you could provide me with some of the items that you ordered, I would be able to address with my staff. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Terri Linse
text: Great views, yak-a dilla was delicious and the bread pudding was to die for. Halibut & chips was very good, not the town's best but up there.

name: Leonardo Riera
text:
Such good burgers. Also their Spicy buddha bowl was amazing. I would have eaten both by myself.
Outdoors sitting upstairs is great.

name: David Holmes
text: Nice beer selection. Good flavors. Bartender was very helpful.

name: Atila Đurik
text:
The restaurant has three levels with an open kitchen on the first floor and with three bars on the three levels. Every level has an own bar. Lot of workers work in the building which is always, but always full. During the summer I can recomment the third floor. If the weather is nice, you can see the Denali National Park from the roof.
From the menu I tried the Nachos (which is our favorite with my girlfriend in the city) and the pizza which was okay. They make some beer own beer which are also pretty good.
I recommend to call the restaurant and make a reservation if you plan to go during evening times. They are almost full all the time.

name: William Prior
text: Fantastic food. Excellent beers. They do collaborations. And they Brew a quad. Definitely worth the wait.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, William. Did you have a favorite beer on our visit?  If you liked our quad, I'd like to recommend our Golden Dahl, is a delicious Belgium Tripel. Hope to see you back soon!

name: Better Than Ninja
text: Awesome food, neat atmosphere, service is slow but probably because the place is so popular.

name: Heather J
text: Some of the staff are nice, friendly, good at their job. Honestly the food's over priced, the taste is just ok.

name: dan geno
text: Awesome crab grilled cheese with the best I mean best seafood chowder I've ever had..😉

name: Mitchell Lavey
text: Food and beer were average, service sub par and prices high for my dishes, see pic of $28 fish and chips. Best pretzel I've ever had!

name: Mark Kirven
text: Pizza was not good last time I was here, came back a year later to give it another try. This time I thought I would try the cheeseburger, a food runner brought my cheeseburger out with my cheese on the side and nothing like I ordered it. I flagged the server and when she saw my burger she instantly took it away before I could get a pic ( I wish I had a pic of the bacon, I have never seen bacon look so bad). Server was very nice and friendly and said she would get another one on the way and also sent the manager by. They were very helpful and determined to make everything right, but by then my wife was almost finished eating and I didn't want to have to wait on my food again and just cancelled my order. Wife said her cheeseburger was great and I'm sure I just had a had experience. The fries were very good though.

name: Tom O
text:
Nice selection of mico brews, especially the Imperial Sumatra.

Had the Halibut Burger. Similar to a crab cake.

Maybe a better choice would have been the Halibut and Chips.

Prices initially appeared to be on the high side but ultimately seem like they are in line with most other establishments in downtown Anchorage.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback.

name: Mercedes Anderson
text: Their holiday market place was super fun.

name: Stephanie Ricketts
text: The food is outstanding and the service excellent

name: Ryan Newton
text: Great food, had a large group at 49th State Brewery. My kiddo loved the kids meal and the staff was very friendly. Service and food was on point. The party we were at was great. This is somewhere is definitely visit again and recommend to others. It's really a place the whole family can enjoy!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Ryan.  Did you have a favorite dish on your visit?  I'm loving our Elk Lasagna, paired with a McCarthy Stout its out of this world.

name: Roya Rakhshani
text: Good food and ambiance.   Our server Tony was great, with good recommendations on what to order.

name: Alex Duerre
text: You can't go wrong. Beer selection is diverse and refreshing. Food options are a "community" experience; share with friends. Enjoy!

name: Brian Boehringer
text: Beer flight was very good, and the king crab legs were delicious! Service was also very good

name: Niki Scott
text: Service is always excellent and food although a little slower to arrive than previous it was definitely worth the wait. The fried chicken was killer, yak burger never disappoint and the beer, well it always hits the spot.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Niki, glad you could enjoy our locally sourced Yak Burger.  Pair it with a chocolatey and roasty McCarthy Stout to really bring out the richness of the Yak, yum!  Hope to see you back soon for more.

name: Pink Anderson
text: Probably the best place to dine in Anchorage.  Something to eat for everyone and the rooftop seating is fabulous.  Overpriced, but worth it.

name: Boyd Soule
text: Fantastic place for great tasting food and a beer. Atmosphere was perfect for a truly Alaskan restaurant. Beautiful rooftop patio and great views. Our server was a little off and not the best the day we went but we will definitely be back.

name: Rodney Gomes Ferreira Sobrinho
text: THE BEST PLACE IN ANCHORAGE TO HAVE A BEER AND ENJOY THE EVENING WITH FRIENDS.

name: Murphy Kendra
text: I love to eat out with my Husband hands down my next favorite place to eat make delicious memories and the Staff was just Perfect I swear they are Wonderfully Professional

name: Judy D travel_andbeinspired
text: This was our first time here. We needed to grab a late night bite after a flight on a Tuesday night; we chose 49th State Brewing among the the very limited options we had. I'm so glad we did. Food was fresh, and delicious. Our waitress was nice, and we did not feel rushed at all, eventhough we were the last to leave. Nice ambiance and a great place to catch a game. We will definitely return to 49th State Brewing for second, third, and fourth round🤙

name: justin schildhauer
text: Great beer and food. Excellent service. I will be returning.

name: Gregg Hazen
text: I've had nothing but good experiences here, they might even deserve 5 stars but they generally suffer from over-crowding due to their success and location. Great local brewed beers, good food (great apps), and the best view of the port and summer sunsets (as seen in photo).

name: Johnny Danger
text: Great food and beer selection. Gift shop was also dope. Service was a bit lackluster otherwise it would have been 5 stars

name: Tahnee Seccareccia
text:
This place is pretty great. The food is mostly 4 and 5 star quality. Sometimes it depends on the visit. There is a lot of space for larger groups, which is nice for downtown. They have a wide variety of food  options on the menu, including locally sourced, vegetarian, and gluten-free.

Plus, the company works hard to be an active part of the community and has really great operational practices (hiring, community engagement, stewardship, etc)

name: Sharon Dent
text: Up in Anchorage, Alaska  my husband  found a Brewery.  Great location  with great views  from the roof top bars

name: Klaus Bello
text: One of the better places to go. Top deck galore,  good food, light on the fish in the fish and chips,  and everything else grear

name: DZ TRIPP
text: Place still has many kinks in timely service it needs to work out. Brought my brother who is visiting to have some great beer and local food. Many options where out but it is a popular place so I get it. Still many good options available. If you are flexible it is worth while. Waiting maybe an hour for our food though. But the food was delicious and the beer is the best in town. Very impressed with the beer garden setup to comply with the cities mandate for outdoor only service. Uros was my server and was extremely friendly and made every accomidation he could. I would ask to have more Halibut Cheeks prepped but again I was happy with my Tuna Poke Nachos and my brother loved his Yak Burger. Thanks Uros for giving great service to my brother and I. ☆☆☆ stars for menu availabilty and food delay, ☆☆☆☆☆ stars for service.

name: Annie Feliciano Rivera
text: This place is great good food great beer and our waiter the best ,amazing place !!

name: gmo 30
text: The food and drinks are always great here

name: Jim Jaminet
text: It was very busy. Even for call-ahead pick up carryout order. However, it was good

name: Joe Barron
text:
My wife and I went here a couple of times. Great service, wonderful setting and very good food. Both times we started with the pretzel with beer cheese sauce...sooo good! They also make their own root beer, amazing! Heavy on the vanilla and I love it that way. Can't wait to return.

I also had the pulled pork sandwich with fries, good stuff.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Joe, I also love starting with the Bavarian Pretzel every time!  The salt and cheese make our Prospector's Gold refreshing smoothness just amazing.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Stephanie Randrup
text: Went there for the Mother's Day Red King Crab! Sooooo tasty and reasonably priced! The best kind crab in Anchorage! You can tell they cooked it in salt water.

name: cathy b
text: For a bar/grill place it's ok.  We did have a phenomenal entree of Hailbut Collar Asian seasonings, along side of Jasmine rice. Excellent!   Tender and very moist. A small side salad with house dressing of cilantro, garlic vinaigrette.

name: Edmund Ausman
text: A little slow on service. Food and beverage choices were good. Recommend, however, plan extra time.

name: Barry Hutchins
text: Wonderful food very friendly staff

name: jon long
text: Beer was good and the service was great. The food wasn’t anything special and I would say wasn’t worth the price. My pizza was average and my wife’s burger was about the same. The server was great with handling service with how much it was for a Thursday night. I’d go back again but will know that it’s nothing that stands out

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Jon.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit?  I've been loving our Moose Joose, a juicy and hazy NEIPA, so delicious!

name: kelleigh miller
text: Great food and even better 🍺. The avacado fries are Very different. The Tuna Nachos were outstanding and the pizza was yummy. Great sized portions for the salads and the lettuce was fresh.

name: Lt. Colonel David K. Swendiman
text: Super cool, great staff, amazing food.  Good price.

name: Erika Leyva
text: Great beer and food, the place is beautiful.

name: Wayne
text: Great place to enjoy your time in Anchorage and have a bite to eat with a brewski and enjoy the view of kinik arm.

name: MaryAnn Brooks
text: Food & drinks were amazing! Took a minute for service but Daryll was extremely friendly

name: Salley Kim
text: Nachos with yak meat was interesting. Friendly waitress and nice vibe at this place.

name: Meleia Allen
text: Great beer and food. Cool restaurant

name: Ice Beard
text: Great time up on the roof. A bit windy but the fire kept us nice and warm.

name: David Huntley
text: I have to say OVER PRICE and not very good. I had the Chicken wings, and they tasted horrible, to me the flavor was just bad, there was no dry rub and they tasted rubbery hard to chew horrible experience considering I spent almost 100 on delivery for food. Wont be going back there again... Horrible food experience IMO

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave your feedback. I'm sorry you didn't like the chicken wings as they are one of our highest selling items. If you could provide more details on your visit (others items ordered, date/time, ticket#) it would help to address your concerns. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Jennifer Britton
text: Food is delish, great variety of food and drink optionsc, staff are fun and friendly!

name: Larry Lake
text: Great beer. Great atmosphere, very important! Great food. Great servers and all working here were very friendly. Best whiskey selection I’ve ever seen.

name: Whit Breeden
text: Of the two downtown breweries, this one is vastly superior to Glacier in atmosphere, service, and beer. Flights come pre-arranged, you'll find an excellent Stout and a delightful saison. Order the pretzel with beer cheese if your eating.

name: doris savetilik
text: we ordered p/u. wings were rubber, no sauces on it; just hard and smooth rubber w/chicken hair. the watery ranch sauce didnt help!

resp.text: Hello and thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I apologize that you did not like the smoked dry rub wings. They are not prepared with sauce on them as they are smoked and covered in a dry rub. If you could send me the details of your transaction (date/time, other items ordered, ticket #) so I could look into it. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Nick Pestrikoff
text: Food was flavorful and the Ceasars Salad was great, the halibut was cooked to perfection and their Caesar dressing was memorable and go again for sure.

name: Robbie Huck
text: Not impressed 😕, service was ok, food was very sub par for the amount of money spent. I know all restaurants have a off day and I might give you guys another shot but it was hard to to pay as much as we did for a not so great meal between the bunch of us. Out of the 5 people at our table 4 of them complained about the food.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. How can we improve for your next visit?

name: marcus
text: Andrew and Julia made this trip the most magical experience ever! It's no wonder that this place is always packed because it is the best place to go for food and the best service! Food and beer is to die for! A must stop if you're in town!

name: Geririgged
text: A large beer list of mostly just their own concoctions. I love eating here - the location, the ambiance, and the massive menu. that said they don't have the best beers in town. food is killer tho and it's a fun place to hang and eat/drink. enough tvs around the ground floor to catch a game

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, appreciate the review.  Did you have a entree on your visit?  I love our Halibut Tacos, so tender and delicious.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Jason Faucher
text: Absolutely awesome 👌 food and beer 🍺 😋

name: Antonius Gautama
text: A legend resto to celebrate my brother b'day

name: David Bresky
text: Had a great meal, been wanting to try it for a long time.  Had some friends from out of state visiting so decided to go for it.  Wish we had tried a long time ago!  Service was very friendly, a bit slow but not bad.  We had cauliflower,  wings, pizza, nachos, and Ruben all great!  Great selection of beer.  We will definitely go back!

name: Ashlee Allen Beutler
text:
The food is amazing here! We’ve been here a couple times. They also have great customer service.  We LOVED their Gold Rush pizza and thought it was better than Moose’s Tooth.  We also loved their banana bread dessert.  We saw pictures on the reviews and it looked so good The banana wasn’t too strong and it tasted amazing!!!! We’d go here just to order that.

Go early because it gets busy.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Ashlee, appreciate you stopping by.  Did you have a favorite dish on your visit?  I'm loving our locally sourced and juicy Yak Burger, its superb!  Hope to see you back soon for more.

name: Richard Hepburn
text: Sat at the bar.  Went in at 11.  Had the Elk meatball with melted mozzarella and marinara.. Was Awesome.  Also liked the seafood chowder that had chunks of Salomon and halibut.  Be careful if the bar snack of Carmel popcorn laced,with jalapenos... Nice bit of 🔥 on them.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Richard.  Glad you enjoyed our locally sourced Elk meatball, its a particularly delicious protein.  Hope to see you back for more soon!

name: Angel Gonzales
text: The restaurant is located in a quiet downtown corner, close to the water. I love the food, and have never had a complaint when it comes to service.Even though they are a very popular restaurant, I have never had to wait long to be seated. They also have an amazing space downstairs for events/parties.

name: Deborah Lindsey
text: Enjoyed the ambience of the outdoors.  Service was ok.  Food was on the warm to cool side.  My experience was ok.

name: Greg Rhoades
text: Food was good and the roof deck was a nice venue.  Slow service - really slow service.

name: Amanda Akin
text: Always busy and theres a reason why. Erika is by far the best server in the joint!

name: Michael Gardner
text: Amazing place 2 go eat and have good drinks and beer also Amazing staff.

name: Seth Kniegge
text: Amazing food and atmosphere.

name: stephanie garcia
text: 2nd rooftop bar has killer view and live music on Fridays. Mon-thur catch Becky Kotter, food and a brew on patio.

name: Joan Kentch- Welch
text: Halibut tacos and Tahitian Vanilla Creme Brule were delicious!

name: Evelyn Posala
text: Their calamari, poke, king crab grilled cheese sandwich and fish & chips are delicious. Their desserts are okay (tried 3 different types). Beautiful scenery!

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Evelyn.  Did you have a favorite dish on your visit?  I love our Meat Lovers Mac and Cheese, comes with grilled steak and crispy bacon, delicious!  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Regina Knowlton
text: The food was great and so was the service for the most part.  Getting the check took a very long time.

name: Dimitrios Alexiadis
text: Other than the wait 49th is a must go spot in the summer if you want a gorgeous view of Mt Susitna!

name: Abed Fede
text: Great place to eat at! A really good alternative to Moose's Tooth. I enjoy their nice scenery and view for a place located in Downtown. It's in it's own chill spot indeed.

name: Audrey Morris
text: Food was excellent.  Seafood artichoke dip was to die for.  Expect long waits for the food but the overall service is excellent and if you have the time to linger it is worth it.

name: Izaak Philip Bruce
text: I enjoyed visiting this restaurant. For me the highlight was the excellent beer selection, but the food is also good.

name: Wes Schaffran
text: It's a fun place to go. Great atmosphere. Their beer is really good. The food is good but about average.

name: Shane Bledsoe
text: Great view from top deck.  Food is also great.

resp.text: Thank you for coming in!!!

name: Dawn McCombs
text: Great food, service and prices

name: Danielle Atherton
text: A little pricey, but definitely worth it! Amazing food and decent selection. The soft pretzel with cheese is the perfect app amount, halibut fish n chips is to die for, and the chocolate mousse cake is wonderful to share as a topper for the meal. Went there for my birthday and was not disappointed! And try the blueberry cream soda!!! Delicious!

name: John Nelson
text:
I was a bit disappointed after several recommendations to visit this place. The bartenders seemed a bit "spaced" out. The first one asked me for my ID immediately, but then walked away and never greeted me again. The second came up to me about ten mins later (super friendly) checked my ID, and at which point I asked about the flights. He had to radio to some one to find out more info. This took at least another five mins.

Tried at least 7 different beers and all of the beer were mediocre at best. Went with the halibut for dinner, and while it was good, it was made with so much cheese and what not, that the you couldn't taste the fish at all. Dinner came out quick, but it was a struggle to get drinks.

I will visit them again in a few months, but this first time was definitely a miss by far.

resp.text: Hello, my name is Chad Kaina and I am the General Manager. I wanted to thank you for coming in and for your feedback. We are always trying to improve our customer service and your feedback helps to pinpoint where we need to focus. If you could send a bit more information, (time/date, server/bartenders name) it would help to address these issues. Please reach out at your convenience to chad@49statebrewing.com, I look forward to hearing from you.

name: G T
text: Server did not know the drinks we asked for. Bad server. Food is too pricey and smaller portions.

name: Mike Stierwalt
text: Excellent excellent excellent food! The waitstaff is spot-on and the beers there are fantastic. They have a awesome viewing deck that is perfect when the weather is right. They are very neat clean and efficient. You will not be disappointed eating here.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Mike.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I love our Golden Dahl, a tasty Belgian Tripel celebrating Alaska's majestic Dahl Sheep.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Mike 907
text: Great customer service recommend to anyone trying to have either a romantic dinner date or just a good hang out spot for friends super beautiful on the rooftop and to top it off it was a beautiful night thanks for the fun experience!

name: Brandon Musgrove
text: It was pretty good.  I highly suggest you get there early in the evening.  We got there about 5:15 and still waited for about 35 minutes to be seated this was on a Tuesday.  By the time we left at 7:30, the wait was over 1.5 hours.  The food was good, the beer was REALLY good.  You won't be disappointed.

name: Priscilla Velarde
text: I am only giving this place 2 stars because of the beer and the view. When we first arrived nobody acknowledged us so we sat ourselves only to find out that we couldn’t sit where we were seated. We moved and couldn’t get any staff to acknowledge us again. We were only there to order drinks and I totally understand that they were busy. Multiple staff member walked by our table and still nothing. Finally my friend got up to get a server and someone took our order and then we never seen them again. We ordered for the second time and it took far too long to get our drinks. We asked for our bill when we got the drinks because we didn’t know when we would see another staff member. There was staff everywhere but for some reason we were invisible. Stay away from this place is you want a drink in less than an hour.

name: Geoff Brady
text: This place has some fantastic tasting food and great atmosphere. I don't drink beer but the people I was with said that the beers were some of the best tasting ales they ever had. My only issue and it seems kind of petty but at $2.99 for a soda, I should get more than one refill. Yea it's pricey to live here but soda isn't that expensive up here. Other than that, great food and great fun.

name: Dorothy Rogers
text: The wait was rather long, but the food was good.

name: Andrea Schuster
text: Their food is tasty but can be hit or miss. The Mexican street corn and pretzel with beer cheese are favorites but the last time I ate there the corn was slightly burned and the cheese nearly cold. They do have great beer and the atmosphere (especially the deck on sunny summer days) is fantastic. They also hold fun events (geeks who drink, nerd nite, etc.) It is definitely worth stopping by 49th State.

name: Katherine Lewis
text: Great food and pretty good beer (just a matter of personal taste. Most love the beer). It's one the local favorites here in Anchorage. The outdoor seating is totally worth it, so grab a jacket and enjoy the world-class views of the ocean and the mountains while eating.

name: Douglas Price
text: Great food and service

name: Brock Tucker
text: Ordered food two hours ago. Called and get put on hold. Different person answered five minutes later. Repeated that I ordered food hours ago. Told "I have all the info I need to make sure your food gets to you". What a joke.

resp.text:
Hello Brock,
I apologize for the lack of customer service you received when placing a delivery order. No excuse for waiting longer than 2 hours for your food. If you could provide me with a few more details (date/time, items ordered, ticket #) it would help me to address with my staff. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Terrance Aldridge II
text: Really nice views if you are upstairs on the deck or near the windows!  You can see the Port and also watch as the military flies it's patterns throughout the day!  But the food was awesome!  The pretzel and cheese was amazing!  And burgers and chicken sandwiches were on point! Very nice job!!

name: Cl Smith
text:
Overall the food was good. I was slightly disappointed that my fries were warm which indicated they probably has been sitting for a couple of minutes.

Service was excellent but expect a wait if you do not make a reservation. Luckily, my group had one. However, the line to get in was long tonight, a Thursday. Plan ahead.

name: derrick mells
text:
Love this place! Great food and great service.

Only thing I hate is trying to park my truck downtown, not that they can do anything about that. Well, I'll give 6 stars if the staff teach me how to parallel park...

name: David Tierney
text: Excellent service and great atmosphere. Some of the best wings I’ve had in Alaska.

name: Michael McGuiness
text: Good food, views, and people.  Had the Halibut fish and chips that were delicious.  The bread pudding dessert is awesome.

name: Lea Rueter
text: 907 Day specials was their Peak 3 burger for $9.07 (normally around $13) and a plastic Stein full of their lager (also $9.07). Pretty good! Had nachos with friends, pretzel is always soft and delicious. I enjoy their cocktails. Baja Steak Salad- tender steak chunks, excellent.

name: Daniel Wood
text: Very good food and very good service. It is pricey, though.

name: David Burdett
text: Raquel (server) was amazing. Friendly and helpful. Food is awesome as is the atmosphere. Always enjoy coming back here....four times now. Do yourself a favour. You will not be disappointed.

name: Ian Fox
text:
The only problem is the prices, but you're getting what you pay for.
Every meal here is delicious. Portion size is great. Drink selection is great.
Events are very fun here too.

name: Nick Delicata
text: This establishment is very unique. Awesome decor, as well as layout of the restaurant. I’ve been here over a dozen time, and every time except once has been outstanding. (Ran into a very rude bartender) The food is always great, and the beer selection is amazing. I would recommend this place to anyone. They seem to have it all here. If you’re ever in anchorage visiting be sure to stop here it will be worth the time spent here. They also have a really cool view of mountains from there.

name: Ivan David Peña Nesbit
text: Awesome place with good food and beers

name: Melissa Brown
text: Delicious as usual!

name: Heath Hilyard
text: The food and beer are really good.  The Bavarian pretzel app is a great indulgence.  The service is usually friendly and prompt.  The deck is a great choice on a sunny summer day.

name: Eric McPherson
text: Great downtown stop. Good take on some great Alaska dishes. Fairly priced and amazing views.

name: Agnese Giaccone
text: Very fancy place, a bit crowded in the weekend. Friendly and professional staff. Food is amazing, I strongly recommend the king salmon and the flavored popcorns. Tasty local beers. I loved it!

name: Dan Overbay
text: Awesome place with even better beers.  Great views of the Sleeping Lady (Mr. Susitna) from the roof.

name: Kathy Karpin
text: Loved it so much we went back a second time. Even though we only spent 3 days in Anchorage.  Great beer, great food, great atmosphere

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Kathy, appreciate the review.  Hope to see you back soon for more, our Solstice IPA is waiting for you.

name: Pamela Antonelli
text: The food was excellent. Only negative comment is there was no ice served with water or soda. Drinks got warm fast.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Pamela.  Did you have a favorite entree on your visit? I can't wait to have another "I See Northern Lights" pizza, it has Alfredo sauce, button, shiitake, and portabello mushrooms and more deliciousness.  Come back soon!

name: Robin Kent
text: Home made Root Beer! What! Fun fun fun!

name: Heather Brown
text: Nice setting, beautiful views with out door seating available. Our wait time was an hour and a half and I had to leave before we even got out food. The rest of my family stayed and said the food was cold and not freshly cooked. So I'm glad I left.  I guess they didn't even take my meal off the ticket until something was said about it. Which I found to be kinda messed up. The management was nice and helpful though. This experience happened on a Friday night In the middle of tourist season.

resp.text: Thank you for your review. If you could give me a little more information (date/time of visit, items ordered, server name) it would help to know where I need to address. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Jen Grundy
text: Great food and they have more than beer to drink so go if you are not a beer drinker.

name: Jedi
text: Very good food and really good house brews! Check out the yak burger or crab grilled cheese from the menu. As for beer, you can't go wrong with any on the list.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Jedi.  Glad you chose some of our locally sourced proteins, our Yak is from St Elias, Alaska and our crab is from the frigid waters of the Bering Sea.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Tyler Davidson
text: Best beer that I have had while spending time in Anchorage. They have a nice selection of cans of beer to take home and mini kegs!

name: Rebecca Coffin
text: Despite it being HOPPING busy, my husband and I were seated in less than a minute. The service was a little on the slow side, but this was to be expected with how slammed they were. Our server was thoughtful and attentive. The food was excellent. We got several tasters of beers and took home three growlers. (My favorite being the Ship Kriek!) We had a great night.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Rebecca. Did you have a favorite growler you went home with?  I can't get enough of our Solstice IPA, it has aromas of orange, melon, and a touch of pine. Hope to see you back in soon!

name: Rick Bronson
text: Crowded but we were served very quickly. Tasty IPA

name: Gideon Crowell
text: Beer is good, probably a bit overhyped. Food is exactly what you would want it to be, with only minor complaints. Service did their job very well, and we had a good trip overall.

name: Joseph Pocher
text: Great food and drinks. We sat outside at the rooftop dining area. They even had loaner blankets as the evening cooled off.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Joseph.  Did you have a favorite beer to enjoy on the rooftop? I'm a big fan of our roasty and chocolatey McCarthy Stout for when the evening cools off.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Eric Johnson
text: Worth going too. Good food, friendly staff. Long wait, and food was a bit pricey for the amount of food received.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Eric, appreciate the review. Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I've been really craving our delicious Baked Blonde lately, so good after a long day.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: G G
text: Nice evening out on the top deck overlooking the inlet and GREAT meal

name: Lisa Estes
text: I frequent breweries, alehouses and the like. Let me just say they are pricey-do not let that deter you however! Everything there is worth it. From the check-in, to waitstaff, beer, to food taste and portion size. Well worth ever penny!

name: Sarah Katari
text:
A suprisingly diverse venue with a deliciously dynamic menu; for a brewing company, I certainly didn't expect to visit a talk on AI and psychedelics!

Too bad I forgot my ID or I'd have more to say about the craft beers!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Sarah, did you have a favorite dish on your visit? I'm loving our Spicy Buddah Bowl, a delicious vegan dish with fresh avocado, roasted sweet potatoes, fresh red cabbage, and more.  Hope you can come back soon and try some of our beers!

name: Deborah Barta
text: Very nice place to hang out, drink, eat and see the crow. Our server was very nice. We sat near the pizza oven in the floor level and it was very nice watching them cooking, we noticed that there was a server slow down for quite a while and food was piling up waiting to be delivered. Our food however didn't take long and we were very happy about. I order one type of drink, maybe similar to a mojito with raspberry. It is nothing special and I didn't think it was strong, it could use an extra dose of alcohol. We order a tuna(poke style) nacho, yumm super delicious, fresh tuna and homemade chips just perfect! Pizza was good but would prefer a bit crisper bread as the middle was a bit soft. I would still return to try other food. Overall is a nice place to go.

name: Kirstie Starr
text: Waiter was great, but food was just okay. Overpriced for the quality. Reservation for 8 and they put us in a booth that barely fit 6, with the other 2 members of our group sitting at a table across the aisle. Plastic water glasses are a bad idea in a restaurant as it was hard to tell if they were dirty or just scratched.

name: Lusiano Coronado
text: Great time. We are regulars that come here! What's great about this place is that they hook you up on your birthday if you sign up for the birthday club thing they offer! I got $25 off my order if I spend over $50!

name: Garrett Robison
text: We had outstanding service and great food, they worked with us on seating. The fries were crispy the burgers were juicy and they refilled our drinks quickly.. Great job Ashley

name: theTapecat
text: Great beer great food great atmosphere

name: Jim Czech
text: Great selection of brews, and good food, too.

name: John Thain
text: Rooftop seating if the weather allows, with potential views of Denali. Great service, great food, great beers. The yak burger is expensive, $25, but I have no regrets.

name: Damon Schaeffer
text: Over rated and over priced.  Burgers sat so long the bottom buns got soggy.

name: Arnold Turner
text: Great atmosphere and food.  Good place to take family, friends, or coworkers to unwind from the day.

name: Rakshanda Visave
text: Our server was Tamara Ma'am and she was great with recommendations and service. Also the good was great. It's awesome to go here with your friends.. or loved ones ..

name: Deiniol Avery Ballais
text: The waiters and waiters are friendly people, the food had a hearty tatse.  Their root beers are okay, but their burgers (and the vegan versions) are savoury and filling that you can hardly eat your fries. A good place to eat out with friends, but be sure to make a reservation since its a popular place!

name: S L Kerr
text: SERVICE IS GREAT! I do wish they had a local non-alcoholic beer on their menu. Most Starter foods are good,  however, the nachos we had were awful...not enough cheese..radishes were watery flavored with not bite to them. These could be a great starter food. PLEASE PUT CHEESE OVER THE WHOLE TRAY

resp.text:
Hello,
Thank you for joining us. We are glad to hear you like the service and we will be sure to mention your compliments to the crew. Non-alcoholic beer is a good idea. We'll be sure to discuss it with the brewer. It might be a logistics issue, we'll find out. We'll also talk to the chef about your suggestions for the nachos. Our aim is to get it right the first time but we're always happy to add more cheese. We hope we'll see you again soon and want you to know that we really appreciate your business.

name: Colin Martin
text: Large Menu with many outstanding features. Pricy what it is but worth it for the most part. Typically pretty busy, will only accept reservations for parties of more than 6. Ample patio space for a nice day, however I still would expect to wait for a table. Great selection of beer and cocktails as well. Touristy.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Colin, and for the review. Hope to see you back soon!

name: Jack Arsenault
text: Meals were delicious, drinks were great, alcohol selection is amazing. If they don't have it I don't think it exists. Staff are great. Worth the trip.

name: 김라키
text: Despite of the Covid-19, many customers sit at the table for dinner without wearing a mask or keeping a distance. However, food is OK.

name: Kyrie Schryer
text: I am always a fan when I come here! The food is wonderful and creative! It's expensive but worth every penny! I normally get the baked Mac and cheese and it is so good!! And the staff are all so friendly!

name: Tanya Williams
text: Excellent service; we ordered our food and it arrived quickly and hot. Enjoyed the halibut tacos

resp.text: Thanks for stopping into the 49th, Tanya, appreciate the review.  Did you have your Halibut tacos fresh and Blackened or savory and Beer Battered?  I still can't decide which ones I love more, both so good!  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Gerald Macy
text: We got a small pizza and a salad! It was one of the best pizzas we have had on a while. The beer was great and the service was fast and friendly. If we ever make it back to Anchorage we will stop in.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Gerald.  Which pizza did you have while visiting? I'm loving our Kodiak Bear pizza, our take on a meat lovers pizza, I especially like the elk fennel sausage on it.  Hope to see you back in soon!

name: Paul Alexander
text: I like their food and beer. I've only eaten at this location twice but both times I've been very happy with it.

name: Janet Werner
text: The food is great! I had the Baja Steak Salad and my husband had the Buffalo Meatloaf Sandwich. The server, Kayla was pleasant and helpful when we were making our beer selection. We will definitely recommend this restaurant to friends headed to Anchorage.

name: Jennifer A
text: Good food but terrible service. After being seated it took over 20 minutes before the waiter even came to the table to take drink orders. We ordered drinks, an appetizer and our meals thinking things would go more smoothly but ended up waiting over 30 minutes on the appetizer and then another hour for food. Almost impossible to flag down a waiter for more drinks while waiting. It was busy, but not that busy.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback as it helps us improve. If you could send me a little more information (date/time of visit, items ordered, server name) it will help me to know where to address. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com.

name: Samuel Thornton
text: One of the Best fine dining to eat at.

name: Sheila McDonald
text: Great atmosphere, food, and service. This place was highly recommended by many tour guides and they are right, everyone should have a bite to eat here.

name: Preston Edson
text: What a great dining venue and the most eclectic menus we found in Alaska. Great rooftop scene. Best dining we found in Anchorage

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Preston, appreciate the review. Hope to see you back soon!

name: John Howell
text: Really good food! I got the Yak burger which was way better then it sounds. Waitress was polite and helpful, and offered good suggestions. Very busy and popular restaurant so I'd advise calling ahead for a reservation.

name: Shawn Kaiser
text: 49th State Brewing Co. Is far more the Best Restaurants from the main course, Desert plus the the Beverage .

name: Randy Weaver
text: My beer was good. I had the halibut cheeks and they were pretty good. Wife had philly but the meat was so over seasoned it ruined the sandwich. The rootbeer was awesome. I cannot say I would go back.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Randy. Glad you enjoyed our locally sourced Halibut Cheeks from the cold depths of Kachemak Bay.  Hope to see you back for a few more brews!

name: Walbert Schulpen
text: This place has plenty of traditional brewing equipment, and more importantly the know-how and determination to make a range of awesome beers. The beer alone would be a perfect reason to visit, but the kitchen does not disappoint either. To top it all off, the view from the deck on a sunny day is hard to beat.

resp.text: Thank you so much! We're definitely going to share your words with the brew crew and staff. Hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Tiffany Marie
text: Expensive but some things in the menu is worth it. I ordered a salmon and like it well.  My salmon skin was black.  Wasnt good at all. The crab legs on the other hand was yummy

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback as it helps us to improve our business. If you could provide a little more information (items ordered, date/time of visit, server name) it would help to address with my staff. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: tessie estes
text: Amazing food, beer and service! I love the deck and view always a plus in the summer!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Tessie.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I'm loving our strong and delicious Moderation IPA, get in soon for more!

name: Jeffrey Greb
text: Get the Yak burger. Tastes like sweet marinated sausage. They were out if the burnt blonde ale. But my second and third choices did not disappoint

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Jeffrey.  Glad you loved the Yak Burger, its sourced locally from Circle F Ranch in St Elias, AK.  Hope to see you back soon for more delicious entrees!

name: Jonathan Zack
text: Personally, they have lost the mentality they had when they opened. 3 years ago I would have given them 5 stars recent experiences I am disappointed. Food is good still, has a great view and you can also find fun events here such as fur rondy plays, trivia, and the skinny Raven run ends here sometimes. They don't offer any incentive for any of these events, no specials no small plate meals for the runners, no happy hour for the trivia. I don't get the homey feel, I once had here.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by, Jonathan, appreciate the review.  Hope to see you back soon.

name: kim gerstner
text:
Great location and nice views.
Friendly staff and good food.
Loved the crab stuffed jalepeno poppers

resp.text: Kim, thanks for choosing us for a visit.  I also love our bacon wrapped Crab Stuffed Jalapeño Poppers, the poblano cilantro mayo really kicks this dish up a notch.

name: Matthew Rogers
text: The grilled cheese is no joke

name: Elvira Morozova
text: Always awesome. Must have their pretzel!

name: Mark Sabo
text: Good food, good people, great atmosphere.

name: Cheska
text: Personable friendly staff.  Real people. Professional but not fake robots.  I hate fake robot staff. 🤖 food was excellent!

name: Don Schindler
text: Excellent brews, good food.  Had to wait a bit for service.

name: Drew Cason
text:
The big room with a stage is an excellent community space for trivia, plays, panel discussions and all manner of events. Also have a couple smaller spaces downstairs great for smaller events. And maybe the best deck in town for watching sunsets.

Killer baked mac and cheese, really good pretzels (the beer cheese.....) a solid tap list with new stuff to try on the regular. My only "complaint" might be the food isn't cheap, but it's also quite good, so I suppose that's fair enough.

name: Miles Gibson
text: Good venue for shows . drinks were a bit pricey though.

name: Jacqueline Libby
text: Much better than the last visit. Fast service and amazing food! The waiter knew his beers and was very good at helping make a selection.

name: Jim Robinson
text:
We were pleasantly surprised. We expected a good selection of beers on tap and were not disappointed. The surprise was the food menu which was quite extensive. There are choices for vegans, big meat eaters and those in between.

The only negative we experienced was the service - especially for drinks. Our initial drink order took about eight minutes to arrive, and our refills about five.

We will probably eat there again the next time we are in Anchorage.

resp.text: Hello, thank you so much for coming in and for your warm remarks. We really do try to provide a broad selection of items on the menu so there's something for everyone. We've been working hand-in-hand with Alaskan farmers and ranchers to provide  sustainable Alaskan foods as well so it means a lot that you liked the selection. We'll definitely make a note to the staff to watch the times on drink delivery. Thank you so much for that feedback. Hope to see you again soon!

name: Patti Armanini
text: Great pizza, great beer!

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Patti. Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I love the Hibernator, our bold take on a German Dopplebock style beer. YUM!

name: Danielle Clifford
text: Great food! Good beers. The patio was beautiful but packed, so we sat inside by the windows and looked it over the ocean. Or server did a great job and his suggestions were amazing. Definitely try the yak-a-dilla and yak burger. The crabby grilled cheese was great too.

name: Joshua Self
text: 1st time here and Loved the Brisket with the Pinot.

name: D Ro
text: Good drinks, friendly staff, fast service

name: Brice Wilbanks
text:
Overview: Fantastic brewery/bar with great brew and fantastic food. Mostly good with a few issues.

Pros:
Great food and brew. They make all of their beer and make a fantastic, smooth root beer. The place has a wheat/barley smell. They serve the brew in the correct glasses and pour it right.
The atmosphere is nice. They remodeled the place and it looks fantastic.
With a long wait, they have space for people to wait including a full waiting room w/bar.
All food was fantastic and had good flavour. The Philly cheese stake was good and a friend of ours told us the fish tacos are to die for. For appetizers, the avocado fries are very unique and worth it if you like trying new things.
-Service was nice and accommodating. They bright out the wrong fries and quickly fixed the mistake without question. Thank you!

Cons
There is always room for improvement.
-With all the people, the place gets filled up fast and leads to very long waits. Luckily as explained above, the accommodate for this with extra room. For the reference, the 1st floor is bar w/full menu-Self seating. The 2nd floor is dinner with reservations and/or pagers on walk in. They also have outside seating available.
-The noise is too loud. They have a nice atmosphere, but the music is too loud. They were accommodating when we asked them to turn down the music a little, but it was still very loud.
-Space was tight on the first level. Not much room to eat or be super comfortable.
-Slightly spendy restaurant, higher than average prices.

Bottom line/TL;DR:
Great place to eat downtown. Worth the visit but be ready for a loud environment and high prices if visiting.

name: Greg Eschenlohr
text: Everyone was so great.  We had some suggestions from friends, all of which were delicious.  The avocado fries were the bomb for an app.  I think the entree which went over the best was the Crabby Grilled Cheese.

name: Daniel Nichols
text: Nice place.  Make sure you get reservations.  They have a fun fusion of comfort food and healthy food.

name: Jacob Wright
text: Amazing and cheap beer with a superb, diverse menu of pub-fair

name: Carl Tiefenthaeler
text: Great Atmosphere and nice brewery But - Auwful service ! Waited 25 minutes after being seated just to order drinks and both tables next to us had the same problem. Had to wait another 20 minutes 4 drinks because 2 bartender were 2 busy talking to a couple rather than filling orders coming off of the POS ticket order. Our waiter even went to Management to get someone to start filling the tickets. Other than that, nice place, food was just okay but will try somewhere else next time. Oh, beer is very good also got a Flight.

name: Ryan
text: Great beer, great staff, surprisingly great food!  I'm not just saying this because I am a little buzzed after my third stout.  Our time here was very fun!  If you are a tourist looking for a few brews or some good food go check it out.  Eat where the locals eat and when I treat myself this is one of this places.

name: Brett Kirk
text: Beer was good. Ordered the fried avocado and was disappointed because the avocado was still frozen in the centers. Had to send back. My first time ever taking a bite into a frozen avocado. No bueno for a deep fried food. The sauce with the bites wasn't very good to me, as it did not pair well enough. Ahi Tuna bowl was very nice and appetizing to make up for that.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by, Brett. Glad you liked our Poke bowl, its quite the refreshing dish.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Nico T
text: During football season we head there and enjoy a nice cold beer with their breakfast pizza. Good food, good service.

name: Raymond Rifenburg
text: Absolutely fantastic. Nevena was an outstanding server. My special order meal was perfect!

name: Devon Roberts
text: The atmosphere and views are wonderful from both floors of the establishment. The decor is a polished rustic and the service is superb. There beer is on point. I can specifically recommend the cabin fever, an imperial brown ale aged in whiskey barrels. It alone is worth the trip! An always solid choice is the Mcarthy Dry Stout. It is a sure bet for Guiness drinkers. It is less creamy than Guiness but way more flavorful. The food is all high quality, but some dishes stand out more than others. Hiding on the menu in the upper left is their smoked wings. The avocado fries and buffalo cauliflower are both salty but good. The elk meatballs are hoehum but the pan fried brussel sprouts are a must.

name: Myra Scholze
text:
I ordered the impossible burger. The burger itself was great! I love that so many places have such a quick and easy vegan burger option now. However, the service was awful. The place was pretty dead, it was a Thursday night, I called beforehand to see if myself and two friends needed reservations and they assured us that we didn't. Regardless, it took nearly 20 minutes for our server to come by and offer us menus. We sat so long without menus or water that another waitress came over and offered to bring us drinks.
The food arrived and my gluten-free bun was moldy. I hate raising a stink at restaurants but after inspecting it under a phone flashlight, it was clear that there were fuzzy green areas on the bun. I mean, I get it. I'm gluten free and I keep all my bread in the freezer bc it goes bad so quickly. Also, I assume gluten-free buns aren't exactly flying off the shelf...
Our waitress swept the burger away, apologizing, but she came back shortly and got in an argument with us, insisting that "the chef said it was ash off the grill and he has years of experience so I trust him over you guys". I was flabbergasted. This woman was literally telling us the mold we saw on my food wasn't there and that somehow ash from the grill was instead on my cold, untoasted bun. It was ridiculous! They tried to tell me that they weren't going to replace it, and then they insisted that I keep the burger but they would put it on a new bun. At that point we were all just stunned. They brought a whole new plate within minutes, so I'm not sure what the whole gaslighting discussion about mold vs no mold was, but it was maybe the strangest experience I've had at a restaurant.
Regardless, none of us will ever go back to 49th State. Just awful.

resp.text:
Thank you for taking the time to review your experience. I would like to apologize for the unsatisfactory dining experience that you had at our restaurant. What you describe is not our standard of service and not how we treat our guests, so I’m very sorry that you had to deal with that. It sounds like we let you down on all accounts. I would like to send you a gift card and personally invite you back to attempt to change your opinion. If you could also let me know which day you dined with us so I can follow up with my team. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com.
Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Terese Galvin
text: Good beers, great appetizers and salads. Menu selection is favorable. Service is pretty good. On the weekend prepare to wait for a table.

name: Bene C
text: Food and beer selection is great.  Service can be a hit or miss depending on how busy it is.  I like the summer time when you can go on roof top.  They do take reservations for large party's and we've always had a good time then.

name: Sean O'Sullivan
text: really awesome Place really good atmosphere food is amazing went there for a music venue awesome bar really cool stage just a lot of fun all around

name: Dan Rood
text: Great beer and great food with a friendly waiting staff is a recipe for repeat visits.... and this place has it all!

name: Brandy Howard
text: Great food and very good beer.  Loved the view from the second story.  Very popular place, so be aware there may be a wait if you get there during popular dinner hours!  I had a grilled cheese with crabs.  It was whole king crab leg meat!  It also comes with a seafood bisque.  It was very good.  Highly recommended.

name: Nicholas Abell
text: Spent 1 month in Anchorage. Although a lot of it was spent hiking, fishing and camping we still managed to come here a lot. The beer is amazing and the staff is more than helpful!

name: Marie Josee Lamothe
text: Very friendly and professional service, awesome beer selection, great food, amazing views on the rooftop. The only downside is the long wait to get a table (both times we went, it was over an hour wait).

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Marie. Glad you could enjoy one of our beers under the midnight sun, which did you have?  I love our Vagabond Saison, a delicious, light, farmhouse-style ale.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Karen Holland
text: Food is very good. Be prepared to wait both to get a seat and for your food. We waited 40 minutes to get in and another 40 minutes to get our food after placing our order.

resp.text: Thank you for your review. If you could give me a little more information (date/time of visit, items ordered, server name) it would help to know where I need to address. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Michael Fox
text: Been here twice. Each time service was almost nowhere to be found & didn’t think the food was that great. Maybe if I get dragged here again my opinion would change. As of now, would not recommend.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. If you could provide me with more information (date/time of visit, items ordered, server name) it would help me to address the issues. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: CARLYLE TELFORD
text: I was here for science pub. The food was excellent. The service was even better. I really like the beer.

name: Sarah Dalarah
text: First time here and it was amazing. Had the Yak Quesadilla for an appetizer, could of had it for a meal it was so delicious. I got a pizza with goat cheese on it, that was equally good. Wish the bottom of the pizza was a bit crisper though. My son got mac and cheese. He loved that they put gold fish on top of it. Their twig and berry drink is so yummy. Cant wait to go there again and try their other meals.

name: Adam S
text: Pleasant atmosphere. Dimmed lights. Friendly service! Great food! My ribeye was perfectly cooked. This was my first time eating at 49th State Brewing Company and I will return.

name: Joni Young
text: Totally awesome 👍😊👏

name: Anne Komac
text: Busy, busy, busy - and for good reason. This is a large brew pub in downtown Anchorage with good food and friendly service. It's just so busy, even when you show up unfashionable early for dinner. Good beer and good food (get the yak burger or the poke bowl), but (did I already say this?) so very, very crowded.

name: Hazel Sunshine Hall
text: The food is okie. Expensive for the quality you get. It has a nice view and usually service is quick. You can get better food at other restaurants. They do a lot of events there which is nice.

name: Jia Huis
text:
Great view great vibe great menu!
Try everything that you’ll hardly try outside Alaska! Like Yak burger, king crab on a toast! Lingcod fish n chip! Would love to try more and more different menu on alaskan ingredient! Never forget to order baked blonde!  Great experience!

resp.text: Jia, thanks for swinging through for a visit.  Glad you enjoyed our locally sourced protein options, our Yak is from St. Elias, AK, and our crab is sourced from the frigid waters of the Bering Sea.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Enrico Gasparini
text: Very good the choice of local draught and craft beers. Decent food and service is very kind.

name: Theodore Combos
text: Decent service and mediocre food. Food proportions do not merit the cost. The downtown rooftop experience is worth the visit, but I would perhaps just go have some beers and eat somewhere else.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback as it helps us to improve our business. If you could provide a little more information (items ordered, date/time of visit, server name) it would help to address with my staff. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Cheryl Wirkus
text: Great food.  Little wait time.  Wish we wouldn't have had to ask for soda refills. Little pricey.  Had military discount but it wasnt for the whole bill.  Just the person with the military ID.  Would go again.

name: joanne enriquez
text: We went on a weekend day and received fast service. The Yak-adilla was delicious and would definitely come back again.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Joanne.  Glad you could try our Yak-A-Dilla, we source our tasty yak locally in St. Elias, AK.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Rahilah Taylor
text: Loved this place! On the high end for price but the food is great, the service is amazing and they have live music that you can't help but enjoy. They offer outdoor seating on a balcony the has some sweet views of the city and beautiful mountains.  They are well known for their beers having a higher percentage of alcohol ( 7%) and for the quick delivery of food. This place is typically jam packed after 6pm and hard to get a seat if you have a party of 3 or more. But it's worth the wait! The burgers are great and so is the fish and chips  (fried halibut) as well as the giant onion rings!! (Must have). This is a pretty new restaurant to Anchorage Alaska and it's definitely a spot on visit if you are hear to eat your way through the city!

name: Kay S Dee
text: Best pretzel with beer cheese. Good food: paleo options, healthy choices and requests accommodated, lots of deliciousness. And great beer.

name: Tyler Watson
text: Great brews and food. View from the balcony is fantastic on a clear day. I also really appreciate their event space where they're constantly hosting vital community events from organizations such as the Alaska World Affairs Council and Alaska Common Ground.

name: John T
text: Great local Craft Beer Selection. Good ambiance, especially if you can get on the outside deck on an Alaskan summer night. Food is pretty good. Clam Chowder is awesome. We have eaten here several times. Good place to go. Can be kind of crowded.

name: Andrew Van Ness
text:
This place took over the spot Snow Goose was in.  I was very impressed with the selection of beers and there was a great food selection.  We sat at the bar, and the bartender was very nice.

The place was packed. When one table left, it was quickly turned over. There are three levels - ground level is the bar and restaurant; level 2 is restaurant; level 3 is an observation deck.  Unfortunately, it was raining when we went, so we stuck it out on level 1.

name: Leland Jones
text: Forget the Crow's Nest. THIS is what a five star restuarant taste like, and the service is top notch. Go here for great food, great portions, and great atmosphere! Be sure to reserve a table online before you go for the best experience. Summer/Fall time on the upper deck is awesome!

name: Michelle Cottrell
text: Good food, good bear, service with a smile and a show to boot.  Good stuff

name: Magnetron Magnetron
text:
The large menu and long, in-house tap make this a nice spot for any group outing. The views from the patio are fantastic, but be sure to bring your jacket as the Inlet is windy.
It attracts quite the crowd during the tourist season, so be prepared to wait on a table _and_ food. Call ahead in the summer!
The venue has hosted a swath of local and traveling events. Their social media pages are active.  Be sure to check out what is happening.

name: Gage Stone
text:
Not enough can be said to boost this place to it's rightful spot as the best bar/restaurant in Anchorage. Incredible view of the harbor and a brilliant selection of locally sourced beer made for an exceptional first experience. The interior has tons of seating and is constantly full due to the perfect atmosphere created by the well planned space. Great wait staff and bartenders on all THREE levels. Couches with fire pits and outdoor heaters with blankets make you want to stay until close.

This is the Go-To place in downtown.

name: Christopher Moulton
text: Good beer and guest taps. Always busy in summer,  but I've always managed a bar seat.

name: Jenna Campbell
text: Very awful service. They were crazy busy, but our waitress forgot about us and never came back. Then, when she apologized later and brought us an appetizer on the house to hold us over, she then charged us for it. After 1.5 hours of waiting, the food and drinks were delivered to us and it was tasty. I don't know if it's worth it though.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback as it helps us to know where we can improve our business. I apologize you were charged for something that you did not order. If you could email me with a little more information (date/time of visit, where you sat, items ordered, server name) it would help to pinpoint the issues I need to address. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Katie M
text: Vegan pizzas 😍

name: Darren Smith
text: Out of several beers, out of several of the food items, served a broken glass with large chip on rim of beer glass. Not impressed. Much better restaurants in the Anchorage area than this place! Been to the restaurant two tines and will not go back. I will stick with Glacier Brewhouse!!!

resp.text: Thank you for your review.

name: April
text: Love how fresh and hot the food was! The server we had was also inviting and friendly to us out of town folks.

name: Everything Amazing
text:
Been here a couple times now! Food is excellent and service is top notch. Got the appetizer wings, and they were ok. A little too much dry rub.  I had the tuna poke bowl, and it was phenomenal! Everyone else had wonderful entrees too.

The atmosphere is perfect.  Has the rustic feel of Alaska, but still modern and clean. The upstairs area has a great view of cook inlet and the mountains.

name: Alan Reade
text: Everything has flavor and the service is excellent. I recommend the avocado fries and and ipa.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Alan. Glad you liked our appetizers, and I hope you had a chance to try our Just What I Needed IPA, strong and flavorful.  Hope to see you back soon for more.

name: Ivan Frey
text: Food with great service was great had a wonderful View

resp.text: Thanks for swinging in, Ivan, appreciate the review.  Come back soon for more brews and more views!

name: Alison Kelley
text: This is a nice change from the previous brewery: same great summer deck with better beer and better food. It's still pub food, but better quality. I go here to see improv, Alaska World Affairs council speakers, and other shows and enjoy the IPA selections and the roasted corn skillet appetizer.

name: Rorique Vernon II
text: Great view in good weather, heaters, firepits and blankets in not-so-good weather, or you can eat inside like a normal restaurant.  Plenty of local beer selections on tap, or bottled.  Locally sourced food, right dow town.  Bring your growler and pick up a beer you like there!

name: George Case
text: Great beer and food. Best IPA in Anchorage

name: Miloš Milovanović
text: Great place with great view...but prices are bit higher

resp.text: Thanks stopping Milos, appreciate the review.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I'm loving our chocolatey and roasty McCarthy Stout, yum!

name: Craig Walker
text:
Firecracker shrimp. 4! in a pile of mayo. Not spicy and cold. Bartender never checked on us. 17 dollars. No smiles on the staff's faces.
No resemblance to the Healy store. 😢

resp.text: Hello, my name is Chad Kaina and I am the General Manager here at the 49th in Anchorage. I apologize for the service you received on your visit. If you could provide me with a few more details, time/date of visit, bartenders name, other items ordered it would help to know where we need to address these issues. We have not had the firecracker Shrimp on the menu for a little while now that we switched to our summer menu. You can reach me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com at your convenience. I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Colby
text: Yes it's expensive. But it's a tourist place in a tourist City. Plus it's costs them more for things we can get early on the lower 48. My food was delicious. Our server was friendly and attentive. The view of the water and the mountains is what we came to Alaska for. We were very happy.

name: Don Tallman
text: Cellar Raid...great event and great beers! Plus awesome nibs to snack on. Owner, head brewer Dave and staff were amazing

name: Lynn McGhee
text: Great food and beer. Beautiful setting. Very crowded at lunch time.

name: Eric Collier
text: Right attitude and atmosphere. This is a must for anyone dining in Anchorage. The service is fast. The food is awesome and not a bad seat in the place.

name: Cayla Armatti
text: Great menu, Alaska sourced food, well prepared, nice atmosphere, outdoor seating, fantastic!

name: Joe Weessies
text: We had the avacado fries and the halibut tacos. Forget the avacado as it was just covered in chili spice. That's all you tasted but the halibut tacos were amazing.
