resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Joe.  Glad you enjoyed our locally sourced and tender Halibut Tacos, they are tremendous.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Justin Olson
text:
My favorite spot for a tasty beverage and food when downtown. Wide variety of beer choices year round. On a nice day in the summertime, the outdoor patio cannot be beat. On a clear day, you can see Denali from the patio. Can't think of much better than that.

I'm a fan of their pizza as well as the veggie burger. And their french fries are awesome. It is often crowded, so the late afternoon can be a great time to get in before the rush. Otherwise, make a reservation a few days to a week out. Or just grab a beer and wait for an open table.

No matter what you do, you won't be disappointed.

name: Samantha Thornton Delicata
text: If you’re looking for a new place to try or a great place for date night (this is it). Great food, excellent service, and so many choices for different beers.  The only problem, what to choose from the menu...if you’re in the mood for a pizza the “Sorry not Sorry” is my choice...not feeling pizza, go for the Mt. Magnificent burger with fries. YUM! This place has an amazing atmosphere and a great view from the second floor.

name: mikaila Smiles
text: Slow service, good beer, not bad food

resp.text: Mikaila, thanks for stopping into the 49th State.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit?  I'm loving our Solstice IPA, it has aromas of orange and melon, with a touch of pine needles, followed with plenty of grapefruit and citrus flavor.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Maxwell Crutch
text: King Crabby Grilled Cheese is the best. Great brews

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Maxwell, appreciate the review.  I love our King Crabby Grilled Cheese, especially when paired with a Golden Dall that really brings forth the sweetness of the crab.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Daniel Grimes
text: Fantastic selection of beer, full and well stocked bar, and the food was fantastic! The wood fired pizza is excellent with lots of choices, and they have a yak burger - one of the best burgers of any kind I have ever had. You will enjoy your visit, and if the weather is good, head up to the outdoor deck seating!

name: Brian Smith
text: Food and service was really good. The deck would be a perfect place to have a cold beer on one of anchorage hot sunny days.

name: Erica Northam
text: Food was good. Wait staff was polite and accommodating. Went there multiple timea during our tdy.

name: Greta Hixon
text: Hood food and great atmosphere!

name: Christian Galloway
text: This place was great.  Service was good, food was good, the prices were somewhat high, but no more than at a similar restaurant.   Parking was kind of limited. This place was recommended to us and it didn't disappoint.

resp.text: Glad to hear you enjoyed your time at the 49th! We really appreciate you taking a moment to share your experience and thank you (and the ones recommending us) for supporting a local Alaskan brewpub. Cheers!

name: Aaron Fisher
text: Had a company party here recently and loved every minute.  Food was great, beers were excellent and they handle a banquet room full of rowdy bikers with class.  Will be back!

resp.text: Cheers! See you soon. :)

name: Amit Kakde
text: Great place for a drink with excellent selection of liquor and food. Enjoy beautiful vistas over Cook inlet from the rooftop dining deck as you enjoy your drink. Definitely worth a visit if you're in Anchorage.

name: Aditya Salunke
text: Excellent place by the Inlet to enjoy the evening! Great food, good drafts and excellent service. We had fried avocados which were excellent for appetizers. The server made us some really good recommendations for food which were all good.

name: Martin Jetté
text: Superb terrace. The avocado fries are really good and so is the mac and cheese

name: Rebecca Wilson
text:
Food was delicious and the cocktails were wonderful. Server was relatively nice, but not overly excited to be there. BUT the seating is packed in like sardines, at least in the area we were at. Be warned.
We had a good time nonetheless and enjoyed our food and the vast selection available on the menu, but there was not much for personal space, or for having a personal conversation.

name: William Day
text:
Honestly, the food is pretty good, and the beer is decent, but it's the deck view of the Cook Inlet (and sometimes even Denali) and the buzzing, outdoor atmosphere that makes 49th State so popular and earns it 5 stars. Pro tip: A
ask your waiter for a blanket on chilly days.

name: Audrey Stachmus
text: The rooftop patio overlooking the water makes this place worth the visit! There are several great beers on tap and the “yak-a-dilla” is also fantastic. Service was a bit slow when we visited, but it was also a busy Saturday evening.

name: Gus Cotten
text: Delicious food, had one of the vegan pizzas and it was to die for.. definitely skimped on the cheese but the waitress was very friendly and assured me that all I needed to do was ask for extra cheese the next time

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Gus, appreciate the review.  I love out Vegan Cashew pizza, with housemade cashew "parmesan cheese", crushed Alta Cucina tomatoes, fresh basil, and more!

name: Staci Duquet
text: My husband and I absolutely loved this place the first time we went. We've always had great service and love that they have a wide variety of beers to choose from! They have great lunch specials too! We can't wait for summer because they have a gorgeous view of Denali from their deck outside which also has seating and heat lamps for chilly evenings.

name: Mike Mcmillie
text: Great food and good service. Not the quietest of places if you want an intimate get away.

name: Terrenna Giles Brown
text: Seafood chowder and yak quesadillas.  Two first for us in Alaska. Nice quaint place. We were able to watch the pizza maker throw his pies up in the air. Nice little free show. Food great and my bf liked the beer..and hes mot a fan of brewers.

name: Dan Cloud
text: Great food and beer.  Uber drivers are fast.

name: SueC
text: The best fries ever !   Food is pretty delish!  Some of our order was not right, but they were very happy to fix it and compensate us for the error.  Service was good.  Would def go back.

name: Anna Stadtmiller
text: Almost every single time we go here we get great beer, food, and service. Best pretzel with cheese in town.

name: Roberta Stevens
text: Very pricey, even for ANC.  Casual dining, food good, took FOREVER to get it.  Service OK.  Wouldn't return due the lengthy wait for the food.  Can't do it in a lunch hour from work.

name: Ali T
text: Food it pretty good. But it is crazy busy here all the time. Very noisy, not great for conversation. Though, the outside deck is worth a see. It has a beautiful view!

name: Howard Darlington
text: Nice spot with good atmosphere..

name: Grant Hartwig
text: Great place for beers and food. This place has the entire package. Roof top deck for summer , good food and beer. That being said their whiskey is expensive and their beer nationally ranks 3.75 out of 5.

name: J. E. Smith
text: Great two story Restaurant & Lounge overlooking the Bay.  Good atmosphere for good times!

name: Troy Bloxom
text: The food was great, the server was very attentive. They had a private meeting room which was perfect for our needs.

name: Mellonease Kirksey
text: This is a nice place to dine. I feel like throughout my whole meal I saw my waiter maybe three times. I am not sure if this was due to her having so many tables to attend to or if it was because of dinner hours. The salmon burger was drenched in tartar sauce and capers. I did enjoy our spinach dip. I am going to try them again maybe I came at a bad time.

name: Miguel Angel Morales De Jesus
text: I used to work over there as a janitor it's a good place

name: Chris Ford
text: Very popular restaurant with locals and tourists. Expect to wait during summer evenings. Great menu of eclectic fares. Fantastic selection of craft brews created in- house. Enjoy colorful sunsets from a rooftop table.

name: C E
text:
Food was great and reasonably priced in our estimation.  We got a flight of beers and were happy with everything.  In addition they have a bourbon barrel stout that rivals that which goose island puts out.
The building is open and really well done inside.  They have done some beautiful work including a large wall covered in old wine barrel staves.  Plan to go back.

name: Liviu Verziu
text: Location is great and offers great atmosphere. Beer selection is good and the food is very tasty.

name: Carmin Beck
text: This place has an awesome vibe. There are three levels of seating: open on the first floor, indoor and outdoor on the second, and outdoor on the third with a standing room bar. The food was absolutely delicious and the portions we're hefty. The beer is great. There was live music a few times that I've been there. Great place for a beer, snack, dinner, and a view.

name: Kira Light Yagami
text: Awesome place!

name: Linda Birmingham
text: Excellent food outstanding service!!!

name: Peggy Eifler
text: Great place.  There are 2 rest in Alaska.  The food is good, the selection of beers are great.  Always a good time.  Ate the 2 different time,  good food, very good service, fun place

name: Alfredo Hernandez
text: Great food and view

name: brady crane
text: AmAZING

name: Clay Lucas
text: Great view on the patio.  Can be a bit cold if the wind is blowin at all.  The heaters help a bit but they also offer blankets.  I love the selection of beers.  My favorite was the Double Shovel cider, but there were a lot of close seconds including the porter.  My wife and I shared a burger and pizza.  The food was great.  If you sit outside the food will cool a little quick.  Overall a great choice

name: Adam Wengronowitz
text: Cool place, tasty food, great vibe. Would not change tv from menu screen to watch NBA playoffs. Bartender said it was policy

name: Rhonda Kay Calkins
text:
Waitress was nice.
Way too long of a wait for mine and my husband's food. We ordered right before a table of 4 and they had eaten and left before our food came. We had to ask if it was coming.
The food was not good, unfortunately. For how they price their menu I expected more. The halibut fish and chips was distasteful.  The batter was thick which made the halibut taste off. We had waited so long for our food by the time we got it we were ready to leave.
My husband had the Mount St. Elias. He only had a few bites of it.
The salads were far too big for starters. Downsize the plate then you won't be wasting so much food.
Unfortunately we probably will not return.

name: Wynette Jones
text: An amazing beer selection.  My daughter and I sat on the rooftop deck and it was just lovely.  Food was wonderful.

name: Kerry Hall
text: Food was really good and the atmosphere is great too!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Kerry.  Did you have a favorite dish on your visit?  I've been loving our new Chicken Tacos, amazing!  Hope to see you back soon to try some of our delicious new menu items.

name: Tiana Escalante
text: Amazing food a wonderful atmosphere and the staff is awesome. They go above and beyond what I expected. I started to leave without my purse and our waiter came and brought it to me before I walked out the door.  Will definitely be back again when I come to Anchorage.

name: Crystal Moenaert
text: This is my favorite go to dinner place. Their food is unique and so delicious. They always have wonderful beer available too. The patio is so nice in the summer months. I'd recommend the 49th state to everyone. Make sure to get a reservation or expect to wait, it's a very popular place.

name: theron gillen
text: Good beer. Good atmosphere. Busy.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Theron. Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I can not get enough of our Moose Joose, a delicious, juicy, and hazy NEIPA that will make your mouth water for more.

name: Conce Rock
text: Great location with beautiful views. Food average, but overpriced. Very noisy due to open floor plan, especially upstairs. Brees are very tasty; best part of the place. Liked it better when it was the Snow Goose.

name: Mike Scherback
text: Great atmosphere and view.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Mike.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit? I'm loving our Vagabond Saison, perfect for a hot afternoon on our patio.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Taylor U
text: I went here at least 11 times over the 3 months I lived in Anchorage. By far one of my favorite places. Try the burgers or the Mac and cheese. Their beers are delicious but they seem to run out of some options. The rooftop is a great way to spend a Sunday morning/lunch!

name: Farid Sanouvong
text: Great food, great service, great atmosphere! Overall I recommend anyone that is visiting or living in Alaska to come here.

name: Chelsea Layton
text: Good food, great beer selection, wonderful service.

name: Adam B
text: This place was almost decent when it opened  . . . then it stayed open. That's when the quality wheels came off and the tourists started to cream for sub par service and an aggressively decreasing quality of "food". Oh you like craft beer, so does everyone else that doesn't have taste or originality . . .  and this is the place for you Dave.

name: Rin Mheracai
text: Always a great place to be. Even on a super busy day with a non stop sweaty croud in from the 4th of July parade the intrepid staff at 49 State were a joy to dine with, the food was delicious and the wait was not even that bad.

name: Melissa Moody
text: Always a great spot for brews and food, especially up on the rooftop deck!

name: Ali Mohammadkhan
text: The food was good and I was happy with my fish and chips. Probably the best part was its friendly staff. Also there is a roof top area that has a good view and you can keep yourself warm with blankets and heaters.

name: Harry Rohr
text: great burgers and beer and friendly service and ambience. good looking appetizers too.

name: Camille Lowery
text: Everything was good. I would recommend going there.

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Camille, we appreciate the review!

name: Oyit Ador
text: They did a terrible job welcoming guest, we had to wait but that I understand because it was busy. They brought us drinks in chipped glasses and when they finally brought our food they forgot one order and when they did bring it they forgot part of it. It was very expressive for what we ordered. The only Nice thing there is the building

name: Clay Johnson
text: Great food, laid back and classy atmoshpere. Unfortunately Cannot comment on the beer because I am underage

name: Benjamin DeHart
text: Great food, awesome brews and entertainment to go along with it.

name: Jesse Jones
text: We've had issues with long waits and slow service but they've created a nice atmosphere, good food, and great beer! And family friendly, too!

name: Cyndi Montgomery
text: Came for lunch. The food was very good. Service on this particular day was a little underwhelming, so only 4 stars.

name: Matthew Bounds
text: Wait was forever. Food was okay, but for the price it was ridiculous. Probably ordered wrong, but got the cod and chips and honestly have had the same dish at a fast food restaurant for much less and the same taste.

resp.text: Thank you for your recent review. Your feedback helps us to improve all aspects of our restaurant. We are definitely the busiest restaurant in Anchorage which can cause a waitlist but we think it’s a good problem to have. Thank you for your patronage.

name: Lara C5280
text: Super attentive staff. Lots of different items on the menu, however some of the gluten sensitive indications are misleading. However the bar tender was eager and willing to find out the information I was looking for. Food is fresh and delicious.

name: Rocky Christopher
text: Great food,great atmosphere, and a Cubs flag flying from the flag pole. Doesn't get any better. I had a crab grilled cheese. One of the best sandwiches I've ever had. I Highly recommend it. Go Cubbies!!!

name: Jeff Schmieder
text: Great service, good food and beer.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Jeff, did you have a favorite brew on your visit?  I'm loving our Just the Tip, a light bodied cream ale has a distinctive raspberry aroma from hand-harvested Sitka Spruce tips, YUM!  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Quixotic One
text: Good selection of local beer. Expect it to have the "Alaskan tax" of being pricy even though they produce it. Always crowded which is good and bad. Fantastic veiws.

name: Stephen Nocita
text:
Terrible service: waited 20+ for any service whatsoever, sitting at the bar!!  Waited another 30 minutes for a basic salad. This was with light to moderate business; shudder to see "service" if even moderately busy.
My drink lacked any body or character, flavor was watery. Saw no reason to try a second style at these prices: $9-14 for a pint of beer!
Food was mediocre.

name: Ryan Welch
text: I really love this place! The food is incredible. The beer selection is very good, and I would even venture to say some of the best beer in AK!

name: James Casey
text: Food was delicious and portions were huge. Also shellfish safe if you let the server know.

name: vrivera1010
text: Great food, great service, great servers, just love the place.

name: Jason A
text: Awesome food and view. We sat outside and enjoyed the awesome view. Pizza was great, the crab and ahi sandwiches were amazing. Staff was great and a very clean establishment.

name: Chief Reviews Everything
text: Great atmosphere and drink made for an awesome St. Patty’s day, great live music as well!

name: CraigaAK82
text:
One of the better local breweries.  The bar also has a great selection of scotch and whiskey.

The food is good and the wait staff/bartenders do a good job.

The Solstice IPA is my favorite locally brewed IPA.

name: Jack Daniels
text: Good food fair price and the best root beer in town what more is there to say besides try a float!

name: Randall Danes
text: Great ambience, nice views of Sustina and the inlet. Food is delicious. Waitresses are always willing to work with the Deaf people.

name: Kathy Jackson
text: Food was sooo good service and atmosphere was great.. i will be back

name: Jennifer Ruzycki
text: Food was very dissapointing, the fresh Halibut did not taste fresh and the breading was soft and tasteless. We waited a full hour to be seated, once seated waited 10 minutes before I got up to let the hostess know we hadn't been aknowleged by a server.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. If you could give me some more information (date/time of visit, items ordered, server name) it would help to address these issues. Thank you and I look forward to hearing you.

name: Matthew Scott
text: An excellent hangout and beer place. The food and beer were excellent! The only negative was that for the price, there wasn't a lot of food. The views from the deck are amazing. The halibut cheek fish and chips were great. There is a special appetizer right now that is an ahi tuna dip with chips that was out of this world! Great times!

name: M Tauf
text: Good service and food.  A bit pricey but the beer is good.

name: Natalie carlin
text: Great beer, atmosphere and amazing views of the chugach range!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Natalie, appreciate the review.  Did you have a favorite brew on your visit?  I have been loving our Bine Aural IPA, its hazy, juicy, and just oh so good.  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Wilbur Torres
text: Great place. They give blankets to those seating outside. Food is good. Pricey but good.

name: Nycca G
text: Their halibut tacos are the bomb!!!! Server was excellent!!! Definitely will go there again!!! 😁😁😁

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Nycca.  I love our locally sourced halibut tacos.  Did you go for the Blackened of the Battered and Fried Halibut?  Hope to see you back soon for more!

name: Cathy Snider
text: Great food.  Great bourbon selection. High prices.

name: Sarah Greenwood
text: Great atmosphere, decor, and views. The beers are awesome, and the service it's quick, informative, and friendly. The menu is unique, and has plenty to choose from. They brew their own beers, and their meat is local. Really glad we stopped in.

name: Karen Biondich
text: The beer was amazing and the Mac and cheese was out of this world. So good.

name: Kaleb Crawford
text: Great food excellent choices, great service fun atmosphere. Will go back shortly

name: Benjamin Spink
text: Wonderful tastes and authentically Alaskan. Pricey. Usually excellent service. Some of the best beers in the state are brewed here.

name: will port
text: We were wandering around downtown looking for dinner at 1030pm. The only place with the kitchen still open was 49th State, already a plus. We ordered beers that were brewed in the building (very good) and some food. My fiance received a real burger instead of a veggie burger, but mistakes happen and they replaced it right away. The manager? came out and apologized and remedied the situation quickly. We weren't upset because mistakes happen, but the effort was much appreciated. Food was great, beer was great, service was great.

name: Karmann Goff
text: Delicious food, great beer, friendly service.

resp.text: Thanks for coming in, Karmann. Did you have a favorite beer on your visit?  I love our amber colored 907 Frontier Lager, with tasty malt and biscuit flavors.  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Ray Esparza
text: Burgers were great. Seafood chowder, tuna poke tacos are a must have. Beer was on point. Atmosphere and deck was awesome. Fire pits available. Mark was a great bartender and host.

name: Katie Weniger
text: Great food! There is plenty of variety on the menu, along with options for those who are vegan, vegetarian and/or gluten free. Not to mention, they have quite the selection of locally made beer, wine, cider, etc. The staff are all friendly and accommodating. There can be a wait for seating on the 2nd floor/outside, but it's worth it. If you choose to sit outside, there's umbrellas for the table, patio heaters and even blankets.

name: Alex Medina
text: Good place to come and get some drinks with friends.  The atmosphere is great and so is the food.  However do not expect quick service they tend to be busy. So it can take a bit to get what you ordered.

name: Chris Tso
text: They brew great beer here. Full of flavor and depth. Food was good too. Halibut cheek tacos were delicious.

name: Adam Beadle
text: Me and my fiance came in today for lunch, got a booth right away. Our server April was very friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu.  The pizza we ordered  was the Ol' Smokey  and it came out in about 15 min..  So delicious.  We defiantly will be back. Love this place.

name: Rebecca Smith
text: Amazing menu!! Never a bad choice! Loved the poutine, best I've ever had! Best brewpub in ANC

name: Robert O'Brien
text: Beers great. Bar tenders were kinda lame. Wasn't busy at all had to wave them down everytime to get anything. To busy complaining to each other about customers. But we all have our bad days i guess.

resp.text: Hello, thank you for coming in today. We're glad to hear you liked our beer. Sorry to hear about the wait though. Would you be willing to shoot us an email with the time of day you were here or any other information so we may coach our staff on this issue. Your feedback is really important and allows us to ensure our standards are being met. If you could email Katie@49statebrewing.com with a bit more information, it would be really appreciated.

name: James Smith
text: Food was great, service was ecellent didn't wait to long for anything.

name: Marie Sundholm
text: Great food and beer. I've always been amazed by everything I've ordered (with the exception of a reindeer sausage pizza that was recommended by the waiter.) Huge outdoor patio that's fun when the weather is nice.

name: Rachel Burton
text: Nice atmosphere, with a cute little gift shop inside. There are three or four levels in the building, with a roof area that you can sit outside on a lovely day and enjoy some views of the water. The staff is very patient if you're indecisive because they have a lot of tempting stuff on the menu. 49th State does seafood remarkably well. I had their King Crabby grilled cheese sandwich and it was very filling and delicious, especially paired with the seafood chowder. I wasn't particularly impressed by the fries that came with it, and I also ordered a small Greek salad (which they informed me ahead of time didn't have lettuce, which was fine), but I wasn't fond of it - I'm not sure what ingredient it lacked, but it didn't taste like most Greek fare. They have delicious desserts (big fan of bread pudding). It is a little pricy. Overall, I enjoyed it a lot.

name: David Brown
text: Great selection of beers, hard to find one that's not good.  Yak nachos are fantastic. I've enjoyed everything I've tried here!

resp.text:
This is so nice to read. Thank you for sharing your experience! We are really proud to serving Alaskan raised yak and hand crafted brews. Hope to see you again soon! Cheers!
Pro tip: You can join our Birthday Club and receive a $25 voucher! Here's the link: https://us12.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=6318062b5c4b245b1f64df821&id=d29b46bb17

name: Jeff Sterling
text: Average pricey for Anchorage.  Great beer selection and food.  Try the brisket poutine!

name: Charles Purvis
text: Had the Yak burger it was good but not worth the price of $ 24.99. Didn't have any beer.  Service was also good for being busy.

name: Judi
text: We stopped on Anchorage to do a little shopping and to have lunch on our journey from Fairbanks to Seward and decided to dine at 49th State Brewing Company. Upon our arrival we were checking in because we could see a large group waiting for a table when another patron offered us her buzzing remote as they had changed their minds deciding to eat somewhere else. Thank you to the kind stranger! We were promptly seated near the windows overlooking a beautiful harbour and noted the brewing company is beautifully decorated with a stunning live edge table in the front of the dining room. We were immediately greeted by our lovely server who had such a nice and welcoming personality. I ordered a cheese steak and my daughter ordered seafood mac and cheese. Both meals were very good and plentiful. My daughter couldn't finish but wanted to take her meal with her. Luckily we had a cooler and just stopped for ice so she enjoyed her leftover later telling me it was still very good. She had 2 craft beers that she enjoyed. I am not a beer lover but I do recommend the 49th State Brewing Company.

name: Benjamin Phelps
text: Best view in town! Very efficient service.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Benjamin.  Did you have a favorite brew to go with the view?  I'm in love with our Golden Dall, a bold Belgian Tripel that has lots of fruity esters and a subtle spiciness from the yeast. Tasty!

name: Erin Kirkland
text: Look, we love the beer. We love the food. But 49th State needs to improve their level of service. When they're on, they're on big. When they're off though, oy. And when the season is a busy one, like anytime between May-September, it's doubly important to have good service. The past two visits have yielded good service, but as always, we are waiting to see about the next time. How about 3 for 3!?

name: Guadalupe Duarte
text: Great place, service, excellent beer, highly recommend the cod tacos and chowder. We decided to be on the terrace enjoying the gorgeous views despite de cold weather, the table with firepit was so welcoming.

name: Rhianna Murphy
text: They have an ENTIRE VEGAN PIZZA COMPLETE WITH CHEESE. I was so stoked when I learned this! I like the rustic aesthetic there as well. Service was excellent. Food was good. But why was it so cold inside? 😣

name: Dakota Vonjames
text: Best beer in town, amazing food, it is pricey bust worth the money, also very packed all the time

name: Misieli Taufaeteau
text: Chicken tenders and selection of beer I had were good.  Took about 30-45 minutes to get seated with reservations.  Service was great after that and they bought us a round for waiting.

name: Paul Allen
text: Great range of beer. Not sure try the plate which gives you 5to sample.

name: Ken B
text: The steak salad was excellent. Clean tables and booths. Service was a bit slow, but it was the lunch rush so I can't judge over that. A+ service. I would recommend to friends and family.

name: Barbara Frey
text: Great food and view.  Too bad it's all the way in Alaska or I would go back.

name: Xavier Collazo
text: This is one of my favorite places in Anchorage. The set up of the restaurant is very sticking and comfortable. The waiters have been great and the food is on point. It can get a little pricey but what didn't get pricey in Alaska.

name: Julie Nielsen
text: Besides the slow service that we received to put our order in. The food was awesome

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback as it helps us to know where we need to improve. If you could email me at ckaina@49statebrewing.com with the date and time of your visit, servers name, or the items ordered, it will assist us in addressing the issues. Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

name: Jonny Walker
text: Went in as a group for lunch, there was a larger group seated and several tables with smaller groups. The wait staff did a great job and the food was delicious.

resp.text: Thank you for coming in and for taking a moment to spread the word. Cheers!

name: Angela Kaczorowski
text: Staff was awesome and attentive, poutine was delicious. Crab was out of this world. Fried halibut was tasty but mushy. Views of the ocean were beautiful. Pasta was dry and undersauced, banana bread foster was dry and not a cohesive dish. A bit pricey for conventional bar food, and there are better breweries in Anchorage. It's was a good night out but probably won't be returning.

name: Pete Donahoo
text: Great place!  Large in house beer selection (more in winter than summer), in my top 5 for food in the downtown area. The interior design really feels Alaskan including mountain/bay views from the balconies.

name: Christine
text: Good food - I love the buddha bowl! Good beer too! Check for events, they have some fun stuff happening there!

name: David O'Brien
text: Nice atmosphere, great view, great food & beer, plus a theater!

name: Kim Murphy
text: Nice place. Very expensive and portions are extremely small. Great food though. Nice a variety for those who want gluten free.

name: HW Ellie
text: Wonderful views of Cook Inlet including the Sleeping Lady. Staff was very friendly, knowledgeable about food and drink items. The menu offers a great variety of selections including opportunities to try local cuisines like the yak burger or reindeer sausage pizza. Also enjoyed sampling the in house brews with a flight of own choosing.

name: Tim Johnson
text: Great food, but took a long time. Just be prepared to make it an evening

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Tim!  Did you have a favorite entree or beer on your visit?  Try our Big Eye Ahi Tuna, its togarashi crusted and served over golden turmeric brown rice with a mango chutney. YUM!

name: Andrew McConnell
text: Maximillian who works nights is awesome. Dave should give him a raise!

name: Megan Mackiernan
text: Crab grilled cheese sandwich was DIVINE!

name: Greg Dahl
text: Great menu and good service.

name: Anabella Campana
text: Great view, great food!

name: Sahid Martin Robles Bello
text: Fantastic brews, great food and a friendly staff.

name: Chaparra B
text: Great service. The only reason it's not 5 stars is because we had to ask for our water to be refilled. After a while, had to go and grab our own water, but after that, waiter took great care of us.

name: Bryan Ballweber
text: Beer was pretty good, food and wait staff need a lot of work.  Waitress never would come by our table and food was over cooked and cold when served.  Was super disappointed.

name: Sharon Miller
text: I think I've had two or three memorable burgers in my life, and 49th definitely made the next most memorable. I order the venison burger. Absolutely a burger to die for! A real juicy beauty with complementing sauce that had my taste buds dancing! My mouth waters as I think of it! I had an amber ale as well that made a nice addition, I wish I could remember the name. I came here again for New Years and didn't have any food but I had one of their free beers, and I was impressed with the hoppy flavour. If their free beer is that good then I can't wait to try the other beers, being new in town. This is definitely a spot in town I will continue to visit and recommend to other newcomers.

name: Ron Baioni
text: Great food, large portions and very very good beer. Popular place so plan on a wait, especially if you want to see the sunset upstairs on the deck.

name: James McCaughan
text: Great view with great food, try to go to the top deck.

name: Matthew Bigman
text: Solid brewery and gold food, though be prepared to eat heavy. Plenty of options should leave everyone happy, though the summer crowds can be a bit of a turn off.  Beer options are varied and tasty.

name: Micah Heakin
text: Love the beer here. The food is good too but I go there for the flights of beer. Cozy and nice ambiance. Servers were on top of their game on both my visits. I will be back.

name: Teagan Presler
text: Great show space and service. Food was okay, nothing amazing but decent. Loved the atmosphere in the general eating area as well. Worth checking out!

name: Amy Guimond
text: We had really high hopes for the beer but were left underwhelmed.  Food was awesome,  but you really go to a brewery for beer.  Better beer elsewhere in anchorage if only in town for a day or 2...

name: TinaMarie Chaney
text: Best salmon on the planet. Extremely noisey and too busy for my comfort, but fun if you're not looking for a romantic spot... has a great atmosphere/view from the balcony if you're into crowds.

name: KK6WGO Rollins
text: Good food, fair pricing, great view from balcony.

name: Steven Johnson
text: Great food and beer! Stop at the gift shop for some shirts or beer to bring on the go.

name: Denise Easley
text: Great drinks and a fabulous view!

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Denise.  Did you have a favorite beer on your visit?  I love our Baked Blonde, it has fruity, floral, and honey notes, tasty.

name: Ryan Libby
text: Not the experience we were looking for.  Service was slow even at 9:30pm inattentive staff,  recieved wrong appetizers, wifes beer took 20 minutes to arrive after ordering (mine arrived in under 5 minutes). Food was "average at best" even though I had a huge chunk of plastic in my steak.  We were greeted by a mouse that I management seemed unsurprised by.  Most likely will not return.  Our meal was compensated due to the issues however the quality control leaves lots to be desired.

name: Arun Nokia7
text: Nice ambience. Great food and service

name: Doomsi Something
text: Good variety of food, and nice views over the water.

name: Casey Spence
text: Wendy the waitress was awesome. The food is typical Alaska. Over rated..  The Beer. GREAT!

name: Nolan Spillane
text: Good service mostly good food. Idrk

resp.text: Thanks for stopping, Nolan, appreciate the review. Hope to see you back soon!

name: Keri Wittwer
text: While our experience with good and drink wasn't good today, we've been here before, and they are amazing. The manager remedied our problems, and made us very happy. We LOVE them and will definitely return.

name: Holly Segura
text: My sandwich was good but it took foever to get and Husband steak had no flavor.. Was super small too.

resp.text:
Hi Holly, thank you for coming in to see us at the 49th. We're glad you liked your sandwich! Looks like there was an issue getting it to you quickly though. Sorry that happened. We really want everyone that comes in to experience the service and food quality that we are known for. Our GM would like to know if you have any further insight for us that you think would be helpful. Her email is Katie@49StateBrewing.com. We appreciate any insight you may have as to what was a win and what could have been improved upon.
Also, if you are regularly in Anchorage, you should join our Birthday Club. Members receive a $25 voucher on their birthday as well as inside info on deals. Here is a link: https://us12.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=6318062b5c4b245b1f64df821&id=d29b46bb17
We thank you for supporting local business and hope that you will give the 49th State another visit.

name: Logan T .PhD
text: Great food and beer. I highly recommend the Bavarian pretzel!

name: Nathan Elliott
text: Good food and great service.  Prices a bit high given the overall experience.  Very loud environment made conversation difficult.  Dining here was a pleasant experience, but shy of 5 stars for me.

name: Chris Mandery
text: Steady selection of rotating beers, friendly service, quality food and appetizers.

name: Papa Vomit
text: Most vegan items worth ordering on any menu in town. Not just salads either.

name: Ryan Larson
text:
Stopped in for lunch and some beers on our way out of town. This place is pretty big and looks brand new. We each ordered a flight of beer and we were not impressed (disclaimer - we are not beer people!) but the food was awesome!

I ordered the poutine and it was thick and rich. I think my wife got a flatbread and it was really good as well.

Highly recommended if you are in the area.

name: Chelsea Cassell
text: The new decor and furniture here are great.  I like the atmosphere a lot and there is a huge beer selection. The menu has a lot of promising dishes with excellent descriptions, but they have sounded better than they  tasted in my experience.

name: Matt chu
text: In my opinion, a couple overpriced gimmicy food but hey thats generally how it goes, staff was helpful and the food was good, got the meatball and reubin.

name: Inna
text: Great food, great beer, great service.  Highly recommend.

name: Lorelle Noble
text: Great spot but very busy long wait for table

name: Martin Moody
text: By far one of the best pizza's I have eaten in the ANCHORAGE area.

name: lil nihi
text: Good food and drinks. Okay service

name: Chris Rac
text:
Brought a party of about 20 in.  Our server Joe was on top of everything from removing plates to asking about refilling drinks to ensuring we had everything we needed and were happy.  This is one of my favorite places in Anchorage and this recent experience just made it that much better.

(Pro-tip: try the yak-a-dilla.  I never thought I would enjoy it but it's one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten)

name: Lady Wax Studio AK
text: The waiter we had was hilarious and wonderful.  He helped me choose a great drink and the food there is so yummy!  LOVE the yak quesadilla!

name: Road Less Traveled
text: Bleh! Old fries, tasteless burger, rubbery chicken, and watery ranch dressing. Sat for 15 minutes before anyone asked us if we wanted drinks, apparently we arrived at the 2pm shift change. Waitress wasn't attentive, not once. Had to flag her down for dessert and to close out, it wasn't even busy. Not impressed, maybe next time. Oh, however, the blue berry pie was great! That's about it...

name: Matthew Jones
text: Good food, servers that are genuinely interested in the customer's dining experience. Awesome outside seating with a great view.

name: Brianne Belford
text: The salmon sandwich that is on the lunch menu is delicious!

name: Tyler Pendergrass
text: Great food and beer.

name: Marsha Roberts
text: Great city views, fabulous bartender on the rooftop and delicious halibut!

name: R W
text: Fun clean comedy show! Come check it out

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in, Robert. Glad you could enjoy some local talent from the 49th State.  Hope to see you back soon for more laughs over some craft beers.

name: abe kline
text: Top quality pub food. Chicharones are a bit spicy. Deep fried avocado and tower of onion rings are amazing. Fish and chips are the best I've ever had. Pizza (both gluten free and gluteny) have great rusts and inspired toppings. The beer menu is stellar with several award winning beers, all of which are made on the premises.

name: Sarah
text: The food is top notch with good variety. Beer selection is great as well. This is my favorite restaurant in Anchorage hands down due to the atmosphere, views, food, and beer. Their Solstice IPA is fantastic.

name: Stephen White
text:
Excellent food and beer selection.

Very heavy tourist scene

name: Andria Dolan
text: A little pricy for what you get, quality suffers a bit.

name: Michael Barker
text: Great atmosphere, great food, sort of expensive, what great place isn't expensive in Alaska though?

name: TJ Rotello
text: Excellent beer and food. Never a bad experience.

resp.text: Thank you for coming in!

name: Philip Weedin
text: This place is great! Or at least it would be if I was old enough to drink

name: Landis Loftin
text: I can be a picky diner but between the excellent service, delicious and exciting food and refreshing beer, well I am only sorry I didn't eat here sooner! This will now be a go-to place for me.

name: Chuck Bost
text: Service was slow... zero gluten free options that looked good, no soy gluten dairy free options...   Atmosphere seems nice.  Staff seems moderately friendly.  No Gluten free beer!

name: Kevin Vakalis
text: Friendly staff made my visit welcoming. Food is good. Expect to speed a little more than usual.

name: Tammy Neff
text: Went for lunch. It was ok. Husband loved the draft selection. Music was blaring,  not crowded but couldn't hear to people at our table. Food was ok. But hubby was happy, that matters.

name: Nick Lupu
text: Good food. Great patio roof. Amazing view

name: Jerry Q
text: Food and staff were great. We had a wonderful experience and Alex kept us entertained throughout our meal. Looking forward to the next visit.

name: Johanna Desbiens
text: This place is always busy you need reservations but the beer is really good. The food is good we have gone back a few times, but mainly for the beer and atmosphere. It's not a great place for groups, we always seemed to get squished into their biggest tables but great for late night drinks and catching up with friends.

name: Ryan Stafford
text:
A remodeled layout from top to bottom and a redesigned menu has given new life to this restaurant.

The 49th State Brewing Co not only has great tasting beer, but also a delicious list of appetizers.  If you want a quick drink and bite then eat downstairs.  If you want more of a dinning experience with a booth then eat upstairs.  I personally rather eat outside, but I have yet to do so.

This place is loud downstairs, so if you don't want to yell across the table then eat upstairs.  There is an elevator near the restrooms if you don't feel like taking the stairs.  The line for a table may go all the way out to the sidewalk, so try to make reservation and get here early.

name: Maggie Jones
text: I always enjoy the food here which is why  I'm giving it four stars.  Tonight though, service was not exceptional.  No water,  no napkins or silverware,  no crayons for the little one.  Had a reservation and our booth was given to a single diner.  We were placed at a table that was obviously closed down.

name: Jennifer Slatter
text: Great Food and Service!

name: Nicholas Armon
text: This place is amazing, great food, great atmosphere, great staff... all around great... can't talk this place up enough.

name: Kimberly Gilhousen
text: Good selection of beers. Food tasted good as well. Friendly service.

name: Ryan Stonebraker
text: Great atmosphere! The macaroni and cheese was top notch.

name: Lyssah Van Baalen
text: Nothing that blows me away about this place. It's very nice, typical brew house like you can find anywhere in the world. Good view from the top floor. Food is good, nothing spectacular, but good. Beer is also good. Have had average service here, but not bad. Menu is front and back, on the larger size for a brew pub. Beer menu is also front and back, so good selection there, too. You can buy beer to go in a variety of sizes and flavors. My friend brings a reusable shopping bag when we come and gets three to-go. Good location in central downtown with access to everything. If it weren't so vanilla, and by extension, completely forgettable due to of lack of uniqueness, I would rank it higher. It's very adequate.

name: Xavier Orozco
text: Good beer, cool ambiance, food not great and pricey to boot. Halibut with little to no flavor, mac and cheese with seafood that tastes bland. Disappointed but again, good beer especially the baked blonde and tripel. Cool place. Good for a decent view and a few beers.

name: Emilie M
text: It's nice to see a replacement for the snow goose that caters to locals. Great beer, decent food and lots of choices on the menu. Make sure to check out the events they host like Treks bikes and brews ride.

name: Sarah Ostermann
text: Lively atmosphere, good food and drink selection. Servers are nice, though there doesn't seem to be enough of them. Food seems a typical for a pub.

name: Red Man
text: Good food, great view from the deck. A little expensive and a wait for the table.  It was worth it though.

name: Heather Percy
text: Wonderful food with a "something for everyone" kind of menu. Yakadilla, lemon pepper wings and the berry and spinach salad are my favorites. Good beer variety and creative cocktails too! On a sunny, warm day their deck can't be beat!

name: D Morse
text: Surprisingly great food.  Seafood Louie Salad was primo!! Server was awesome.

resp.text: Thank you for coming in and for taking a moment to write a review! We're glad to hear you enjoyed the Seafood Louie. We love looking at a plate loaded up with seafood, don't you?! Hope to see you again soon!

name: Charlie Byrd Jr
text: Great friendly staff. Shout out to the Events coordinator Allie for finding room for my party of 30 on a Friday evening. Highly recommend putting this place in your rotation.

name: Susan Moravsky
text: Had a reservation, and there was a mixup with the table we were given. Food was pg, juice rooftop deck and some nice views. Food was pretty good.

name: Jo Pppp
text: Fish and chips are the best

name: Jason Hotch
text: Great reboot of a former brewery/restaurant into a new brewery/restaurant. Decor has been updated to be a bit more trendy, and overall feels bit more cozy. 5 star if service was faster.

name: Milton Hunter
text: I would have hated this place 5stars but they only had one table with a built in fire pit around it.  Food and drink selection was abuntant

name: Christy Reynolds
text: Very nice place, great food. But it is spendy

name: Teagan Roehl
text: Love their beer

name: Katie Halvorson
text: Went at noon in tourist off season. It was delicious food and great service.

name: Paul Robarge
text: Good food and great location and atmosphere.

name: Dualkarnain Siyah-Chal
text: Great food and views.  Pricey but delicious.

name: D NOW
text: Good beer, good food, cool staff, strongly recommended! Very nice view in 3rd floor, worth a look!

name: Lewis Wasserman
text: Great food, great service, and a variety of locally brewed beers.

name: David Olson
text: Great variety of food and drinks.  Views were awesome.

resp.text: Thank you so much for joining us! Hope to see you again soon!

name: azdren poshka
text: Always good food and service

name: AlaskA Trucker
text: It was a t star place. Except now it's hit an miss, its amazing or it sucks. Couldn't even get silverware the waitress was no where in sight

name: Michael Gillespie
text: The best brewery ever. Great food as well. If I lived here, I would live here.

name: R K Nibbe
text: Good food. Good brews. Great atmosphere.

name: Tammy Faucher
text: Great food and service.  Portions were on the smaller side though.

name: Ash A
text: I enjoy the atmosphere, beer selection pretty good. Staff is about on par with the rest of Alaska, a little slower but friendly most of the time. The food I've had is pretty good, steak, burgers and halibut.

name: Talia Green
text: One of our favorites. The wait gets pretty long there in the summer though so that keeps us from going in as often as we would like.

name: Mike Dietz
text: Ace!

name: Ana Owczarzak
text: Amazing food and excellent beers! Epic views of Cook Inlet and amazing multilevel rooftop.

name: John Casseus
text: Awesome food and great location.

name: Kevin McKinley
text: I had the King Crab grilled cheese with the clam chowder and it was so delicious. I was impressed by the service also they were packed for lunch so you may want to get there a tad early.

name: John McFalls
text: Great beer great food and an amazing environment to meet and visit friends.

name: Ki Deshi
text: The Brisket Poutine here is very good, but it's made with a blend of light cheeses instead of cheese curds-- and so, it lacks the heaviness of a true poutine. It's still delicious and worth every penny spent. Very fast service and very friendly staff.

name: Richard Sassman
text: Free Range Buffalo Meatloaf and Alaskan Chowder delicious

name: Nancy Minnick
text: Great place for food and drinks. Order the halibut cheeks

name: Jessica Zambon
text: Great beer, food....mehhh

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Jessica, appreciate the review.

name: Justin Knowlton
text: A really good place to eat with lots of yummy options. I can be a little pricey, but what resturaunt isn't around here. Everything we have ordered here has been good and the service has usually been pretty good as well. Get the pretzel! You won't be dissappinted.

name: Steve Coates
text: Good service, food we had was good. Personal size pizza is a lot of food!

name: Sarah Allyn
text: Rooftop ambience is hard to beat; plus I love how they get creative with the new items on the menu including the shishito peppers. Service is good, too.

name: Justin Nellums
text: Amazing food and fast service!

name: peace_love&muzic
text: Good beers! Fun atmosphere. I'm glad we stopped in here. :)

name: russell mckenzie
text: Always a great time! Perfect service, awesome food, can't ask for more!

name: Derek Brasch
text: Great selection of local ingredients and lots of beers to choose from. Great place to meet friends but is pretty busy most of the time so book a reservation or get ready to wait a bit.

name: Jeremy Landreth
text: 49th has atmosphere perfect for a downtown Anchorage culture. Being a fan of the original location in Healey I wasn't surprised when they brought all the favorites of their craft beers, gastro pub delights, and chill vibes to the big city. Expect wait times on the weekends but there is plenty of room upstairs/downstairs. Great selection of pizzas, burgers, and my all time favorite side order of Chili and Lime Chicharones.

name: ahl ma ahs
text: Be nice, treat everyone the same

resp.text: Thank you for your review. How was your experience?

name: Scott C
text: Great food! Great beer! Great atmosphere. Try the Yak quesadilla.  Enough said

name: Madison Clark
text: I feel like the food isn’t worth the price. Great location downtown. Low flavor beer.

name: Dee Emswiler
text: Was going to avoid as too large and commercial, but I was genuinely impressed

name: James Peters
text: Like an idiot, I misheard the hostess and went upstairs when the open seating is all downstairs.  Luckily, Katy (sorry if I misspelled your name), one of the friendly managers came to my rescue and seated me and served me (the server for the area I stumbled into wasn't scheduled for another ten minutes).  She had to run around doing manager stuff, but as a guest I had no idea because she was attentive, fun and funny.  Thanks to her my experience was grand.   The beer was great, the food, superb.  The view awesome.  Thank you 49th State.

name: Team Inner Peace
text: Food is great but takes a long time to get

name: Ken Erickson
text: Decent brewpub and restaurant.  Has outdoor deck with nice view of Ship Creek, Cook Inlet and Sleeping Lady.

name: Tyler Hill
text: Great food and view

name: David White
text: Great atmosphere and friendly service. I only had a couple drinks and the Bavarian pretzel, and it's definitely a must have

name: Violet Yockel
text:
Been here many times and the service always lacks. Hostesses with attitude, non-responsive Management... And don't bother using the contact link from the website because they won't ever respond. I've been waiting for weeks!
At least the crabby grilled cheese is on point

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. Did you contact us via our website or Facebook? How can we be of service?

name: Chelsi Marian
text: The beer cheese and pretzel....YUM! Nachos, burgers. Great restaurant.

name: Amber Clarambeau
text: Their blue cheese dressing is amazing

resp.text: Thanks for dropping in, Amber.  Come back and try our Baja Steak Salad, the cilantro lime vinaigrette will blow your mind!  Hope to see you back soon!

name: Nick of Alaska
text: Beautiful setting overlooking the inlet, new menu.  We had a burger, the king crab raviolis, and the halibut cheeks and fries.  The food wasn't amazing and was overpriced.

name: D Thomas
text: Excellent space, service and atmosphere.

name: AJ Dandino
text: Food was great. Service was pretty good. I'd give our server an A for effort, but it took forever for the food to come out!

name: Deborah Kocsis
text: good food, excellent brews crafted on site, very knowledgable and friendly staff.  a bit noisy

name: Sheri Schoenberg

text: We were taking 3 new coworkers out to welcome them to Anchorage. There was a total of 12 of us so we tried to call several hours before and make a reservation.  We were told that wasn't possible.  About 45 minutes before arriving I tried to call and do call ahead seating.  The hostess I spoke with seemed exasperated at the idea that anyone would call to begin with.  She then informed me that I should have made a reservation and that they wouldn't be able to seat us.  At this point 12 people are headed that direction, otherwise we would have happily gone to a different restaurant with kind service. I told her that 12 people were about to arrive and asked if we would be able to be seated.  She said in a frustrated tone "I guess we'll figure something out" and hung up.... When we arrived she simply handed us a buzzer and told us to wait, no estimated waiting time given. This is not my 1st bad encounter with the hostesses here and I've only lived in Anchorage for 2 months myself.  Everyone I talk to says they hate how rude it is there, but like the food and drinks. I will say the food, drinks, and our waiter were absolutely wonderful! I'm just surprised at the way we were treated (12 people, some new to anchorage, is the chance for a lot of money and spreading good word.... or bad if you're rude).

text:
I heard about the rave and how good this place is so we visited to take my in-law from TX. We made reservations and was able to bypass the long waiting time. The place can be very crowded and unfortunately we were sat beside a big group celebrating an occasion. It was very loud in the restaurant that we have to yell at each other in order to have a normal conversation. Our server did her best but after 15 mins of being sat, we finally got our drinks. The beers were okay, mostly were flat. After getting our drinks, it took our server a whole 45 mins to come back and take our order for appetizers. The appetizers were actually good. We ordered the crab stuffed jalapenos and crab nachos. Now the dinner was hit and miss. We ordered the yak meatloaf and it was extremely dry and almost tasted like a stale loaf of bread, another had the steak sandwich and it was okay, nothing that stood out, just tasted like a regular steak sandwich, another ordered the crusted halibut and it was overcooked. Halibut is a fish that should not be overcooked or else it would taste like cardboard no matter what sauce or seasoning you add. I ordered the halibut and chips and it was actually very good, batter was perfect and the fries were ok. It's like mashed potatoes inside a crispy potato skin shaped like fries. Another ordered the rock fish and it was spot on scrumptious. Our server only checked back to give us our bill and never checked how everything was. The price was a little up there but not worth the food, drinks and service we received.

I believe that our expectations were just really set high because of what we're hearing about 49th State and were sadly disappointed. Will we be back again? probably not. There are other brewery/restaurants in town that are way less expensive with better service and food.
