text: Very good, good workers, good customer service.

name: Tobias Jahnkuhn
text:
(Translated by Google) During our visit there was a delicious coffee latte for my girlfriend and for me a nice cold iced coffee. Both were highly recommended!

(Original)
Bei unserem Besuch gab es einen leckeren Kaffee Latte für meine Freundin und dazu für mich einen schönen kalten Eiskaffee. Beide waren sehr zu empfehlen!

name: Misty
text:
I HIGHLY recommend this restaurant.  Wow, what a fantastic dinner and introduction to fresh, Alaskan seafood.  Honestly, I was served the best Fish n Chips I've ever had, hands down.

My son had some incredible, sweet and creamy oysters on the half shell, and coconut shrimp which was crispy and delicious.  My other son who is not a seafood fan, enjoyed a grass fed, organic burger, every last bite.

It can be a little busy with 5 cruise ships in port in this tiny town of Juneau, Alaska's capitol city, but the staff work together like a well oiled machine and to ensure your meal is timely, hot, fresh and delicious.

resp.text: Thanks Misty! We're so glad you came by, and we really appreciate you coming online to give us a detailed review. We love hearing about the specific items people enjoyed, but even more than that we love to hear that our staff are rocking and rolling! We hope you'll come see us again soon, and thanks again for providing this feedback, it's so appreciated!

name: Kelley Rubino
text: Awesome view. Great service. Food was amazing

resp.text: Hi Kelley! Now THAT'S what we want to hear from our guests! Thanks for the cool review.

name: Collin Kimball
text:
Excellent food. Good portions. Decent pricing. Good service.
4 star because I did receive a dirty spoon but that was taken care of and hospitably and I moved on with my meal.

name: Ania M.
text:
This one was a toss! Lunch was good, most delicious salmon spread with addition of fresh horseradish was the bomb.
Dinner on the other hand was less than desirable. We ordered a wine, from wine list. They delivered something else without letting us know that the requested bottle was not available. Warning- never order prime rib- I asked for medium and it came out gray, literally gray from overcooking and it was so hard that if I threw it at the wall it would bounce back. I don’t know what happened to it but it’s possible someone heated it up too long or placed on microwave.

name: malde sharad
text: Nice food  with  good quality & service

name: Tom Capote
text: Locals eatery, the Cod and Halibut with chips were great. Friendly service!

name: Kevin McElheny
text: Love visiting the outside patio great view of the water and lots of wildlife and things happening no float planes right now but most summers there are views of the cruise boat and float planes landing great food and excellent service

name: Dylan Bratlie
text: Always great food and great service. It's a must go in Juneau.

resp.text: Thanks for your review, Dylan! Hope to see you here at The Hangar again soon.

name: sari r
text: Excellent restaurant. Terrific view. Good service. Love the food!!

resp.text: Yay, thanks Sari!

name: Gabriel Cazares
text: Pretty good. Staff is friendly enough, food is decent enough, but the view was pretty awesome.

name: Kirsten Faulkner
text: This is my favorite place to get wings in town! The spicy sauce is the best! I will warn that they are not always the most consistently cooked, but even over cooked they are pretty good. Especially from 4-5:30 when they are half price, it doesn't get any better then that. We don't really go here for anything other then their appetizers because the prices are higher then we feel the food is worth the couple of times we have eaten the main food here.

resp.text: Sorry to hear that, Kirsten. We have one of the largest and most varied menus in town. Some items are more expensive than others, but we always have affordable selections and specials with generous portions and great service in a one-of-a-kind atmosphere :)

name: Melissa Kratz
text: The service was good and very friendly for sure, but the food is what I came for and that was just ok. The halibut chowder was pretty good, but the crab was disappointing. I live in the midwest and the crab isn't this fresh, but I can probably find a better deal that includes all you can eat instead of this expensive "half pound" with succotash....

name: M P
text: The staff was great and the food was good as well.  I have eaten here many times and this time management did a great job on improving the staff and servers.  In the past it wasn't as good.

name: Lev Tobias
text: This place continuously slides to being more mediocre over time. Pretty average food, often not that hot. Service is lack luster. I know they can do better, because they used to. What happened to the tempora rock fish?  They've never been able to do good fries, which is weird. And they use some strange chemical flavored whip cream on desserts. That said, it's a good location. And you know what you'll get out of the place.

name: Robert Lobue
text: They had some incredible service there. Our server recognized that the steak was slightly over done and gave us a 20% discount. You were not planning on complaining at all. Very good sense of humor as all of them had.  Definitely recommend!

name: Mary Epchook
text: The service was great! I enjoyed my time eating comfortably. the servers had great timing. Awesomely considerate and accommodating.

resp.text: The pleasure was ours Mary, thanks for being a great customer! We hope you'll come see us again soon. Thanks for the review!

name: C J Walker
text: Excellent tempura halibut!!

resp.text: Thanks, CJ! We're passing on your compliment to the kitchen team.

name: Kristina Pimenta-Brambila
text:
We liked it....the pizza place there was awsome...but be prepared.....
ITS A TOUREST TRAP!!!!
So if you want a quite spot.....NO!!!! NOT HERE !

name: Kevin Allen
text: Great view good food and fun atmosfear

name: Jeremiah Blankenship
text: Soup is hot, beer nice and cold. Great selection, easygoing staff, lots of seating, great view. Nice to see the action in the kitchen. Bar menu and regular menu. Good specials. Always parking. Historical building.

name: Maria Miller
text: Had the daily special for Wed. which was meat loaf and mashed potatoes. It was really good. Fresh warm bread brought to the table. Should have taken a picture!

name: Bendik ban jr
text: Good food and excellent service.

name: Mike Grosshans
text: Food was a bit overpriced, quality was good. I would have rated it higher but the waiter seemed to either disliked his job, had something else to do or on his mind. He seemed to want to be somewhere else and really didn't want to give good customer service or to be polite to us. It was not that busy when we were there. There were several open booths.  Good news is we are just tourists and will most likely never be back. I'd suggest to check out one of the other MANY more eating places. Otherwise risk getting our server. Again... maybe he was just having a bad day. Maybe should have taken the day off.

name: Alex Nolan
text: Favorite place to go out and dine. Must visit for anyone who isn't local. Best food in town for any occasion.

name: Janet Passey
text:
The view was wonderful.
Unfortunately my meal was not.
I ordered the king crab boil, the crab leg meat was dry and crumbly, not even worth the effort. Maybe 1 tablespoon of meat. The manager wouldn't replace it, only gave us dessert.
My husband had the king salmon and he enjoyed it.

name: Bondiamo
text: We stopped in for cocktails on the deck and watched the seaplanes land and take off

resp.text: A drink on the deck while watching the float planes is pretty hard to beat. Thanks for the review Anthony!

name: Jeremy Sydney
text: Friendly staff, and the best fish and chips I've ever had. A must whenever I'm in Juneau.

name: Aaron Pressel
text: I received a recommendation to go here by one of our guides.  The food really is pretty good but the service was very poor.  The waiter was inattentive and forgetful and  I had to flag him down in order to keep him from walking right by my table.  In addition, my girlfriends drinking glass was dirty and since the waiter didn't check on us for a while it took forever to get another glass. The place was busy, but from what I was able to gather, they are busy frequently.  Overall, I really regret going here.  Alaska is very expensive in general and I was only in Juneau for a few days.  Really, there are better places to go to spend 80 dollars.

resp.text: Hi Aaron, thank you for the review. We're glad you enjoyed the food, but we're so sorry that our service was not there to match it during your visit. A dirty water glass is unacceptable on its own, but it is made worse by our lack of attentiveness. We really appreciate you coming online to provide this feedback. This will be discussed with our team in order to prevent this from happening again, but that doesn't make up for what happened during your visit. We'd love the chance to make this right, so please reach out to us at info@hangaronthewharf.com so we can discuss it further. Sorry again that we were not up to our normal standards during your visit, and thank you so much for giving us this feedback.

name: Mikayla Mitchell
text: Definitely one of the top 3 nicest restaurants in town. Food is always great. Blackened salmon caesar salad is so good.

name: Steven Fritsche
text: This place has terrific food. The ambiance is great, not too loud. The view of the water is nice. The service is really good.

resp.text: Thanks for the review Steve!

name: Melody Halderman
text: I like it, but if you don't mind the alcohol environment, then it's a good place to visit. It's kinda like a bar,& a restaurant all in one. I haven't seen any children in there though. It's not a place i go to very often, but it has some darn good food, for a fairly good price too. So, it's an excellent place for adults to have a quiet bite to eat, or otherwise. I don't know what their policy is on whether kids are able to go into there, or not. Check it out for yourself,& see if you like it, like me. They're real nice,& (as far as i was able to tell), they're very polite too. 😁😋😍😎

name: Chris Jones
text: Great food! Beautiful view if seated by the windows. Has pool tables upstairs. Have had problems with some waiters/waitresses' attitudes, but overall the staff try to be friendly when you visit.

name: Sam Parks
text: Had the everything burger was awesome 1st time eating out since the pandemic

name: hannah rogers
text: came for the vegetarian options. Pretty busy at 7pm on a Sunday. I found a seat at the bar. It was so hot I chose to sit outside. Ended up being surrounded by cigarette smoke and couldn’t enjoy the nice weather outside so I moved back inside to the bar. The veggie tacos were amazing. Service was pretty good. The WiFi worked!

name: Dana Ziskrout
text: Without exception, the best halibut chowder, for that matter any chowder, we've ever had anywhere in the world. No exaggeration. Service was great. View of the water and ships accentuated a wonderful family dining experience.

resp.text: Hi DC, thank you so much for that glowing review of our chowder. We hear a lot of praise for that item but "best in the world" is pretty high praise and we definitely appreciate it! Thanks for taking the time to leave us this feedback, it's reviews like this that keep us all going every day, so thank you!

name: Reese
text: Had a wonderful time tonight. My friend was visiting from Fairbanks and she's never been. Pete K. was an excellent server and The Hangar has never let me down!!! Thank you!

name: Jim Robinson
text:
The Hangar on the Wharf is one of the best restaurants in Juneau. It has a great view over the harbor and convenient parking. The food is good, service is quick and friendly, and the beer selection is great. It is our go-to place downtown.

They have comfort food, appetizers and fresh seafood. Reservations are recommended for the restaurant, but it is usually possible to get a table in the bar.

name: Frodo Friedman
text: Before this latest visit, I had very bad experiences. Terrible service and overpriced mediocre food. However, I was invited to lunch and was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the food. Only complaint was the server was TOO on top of things. It was kind of annoying. Every bite I took he asked if everything was good here. And the water girl filled up my glass before it was even close to empty. Still I prefer that to how it was before. Four stars

name: Jagdish Yellesetty
text:
Great waterfront dining with great views.
Halibut and chips are very good.
They do seafood well.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: TheVagrantDog
text: Disclaimer- this is a personal opinion. My wife loves Hangar on the Wharf, and has proclaimed my noncommittal shrug to be blasphemy. Still, every time I've gone I've had an issue of some sort. Last time I was there I was given the wrong food, and when my sandwich did show up it had a nice double coating of dressing on it (I'd ordered it dry). That said, once I scraped off the dressing the sandwich was good, I love their root beer, and the price is okay... but if they want four stars from me they'll have to make better fries.

name: Ken Springer
text: I was afraid it would be a tourist trap because it is located at the docks, but it turned out to be an excellent fish restaurant.

resp.text: Thanks Ken! We're known for being 'where the locals go' so we're glad you found us!

name: Kathy Miller
text: The view is absolutely stunning whether you're just visiting our you live here year round!!! Always great options for seafood had the rockfish and chips and it was delicious♥️

name: Gregory Martin
text: Nice place to dine 🍽

name: StreetBread
text: Definitely good food. Good atmosphere. TVs can watch the game or have a brew. Cool little outside dining area as well. They are usually well staffed.

name: Massive-Headwound Harry

name: Carol Simpson

name: Bradford Rich

name: David Dial

name: Catherine Hatcher

name: Cheryl Griffitts
text: Its awesome

name: Jer Grant

name: Kim Tavares

name: Nearsighted Nelly
text: Great service with a great view. One of my favorite spots in Juneau

name: Snoberry
text: Went here for our first date night in Juneau and was very happy. The food was delicious and well seasoned with very generous portions (my wife got mashed potatoes with her steak, ate her fill, and had enough left over to bring home for 2 more meals!). Staff was friendly and draft beer pours were to the rim. Definitely going to be our new date night spot.

name: Luis Magalhaes
text: Fair price and delicious food

name: Mark Hutter
text: I like Hanger on the Wharf. I'm glad it's there. The owner is friendly and down to Earth.  You can expect good tasting food coming your way. Quality of ingredients needs some work like organic options but other than that and if they change oil for friendseveryday that'd be test

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Mark! We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review. :)

name: Cheyenne Girmscheid
text: Great environment, service, and food. Can be busy and loud at times.

name: Joyce Wagner
text: Had linguini and clams.  Huge amount of delicious food.  Tons of clams.  Not a huge price.  Try it out.

name: George W.
text: Great stop for a beer on return to cruise ship. Also offers views of seaplanes comingvand going between the cruise ships.

name: Pamela Tapert
text: Really good burgers, clean, staff were awesome, you can watch the sea planes land from your table and ocean waves ,Cruise ships

name: JoAnne Owens
text: Not a huge menu for lunch and a touch pricy. Halibut sandwich was good.

name: Stephen Gasche
text: Love their Impossible Burger. Good sports bar

name: bfrog 78
text: The people that serves are really good and nice. Tip them good please.

name: Mike
text: Third visit the charm. The crab legs were incredible! Very good wedge salad. Service from Betty was the best of our three visits!

resp.text: Hi, Mike. Thank you for all the return visits! Our salads are perennial winners in the Juneau Readers' Choice Awards. So glad you enjoyed your meal!

name: Paul Deanne
text: Server was great! Food was decent great view

name: Joseph Pocher
text: Good food and drinks. Great view during the season. Fills quick. Recommend reservations

name: mbaines95
text: Great fish and chips and drinks! I highly recommend!

name: Jimmy Fox
text: Food is excellent. Service a leeeetle slow. Busy night.

name: Miranda Olsen
text: Delicious food and fabulous views of Juneau!

name: Larry Burke
text: Halibut and Chips and the Fish tacos are great. Quick service and a nice view from the restaurant.

name: Nick Wolf
text: Good food, nice staff

name: Dawn Duval
text: Great food, great customer service, great views. Prices are decent for what you get. Make a reservation for faster seating, gets busy in the summer and in the evenings.

resp.text: Thanks, Dawn! The pub side is open seating in case you can't call ahead!

name: Zac Schasteen
text: Great please to drop in and have a burger.  Would have given it a higher rating, but the price for a meal was pretty ridiculous.  The quality of food was good, but not $25 entree good.

name: GingerandHerb Conly
text: Awesome, awesome place.  This restaurant was reccomended for us to try while visiting here.  We are glad we did.  Beautiful views of Gastineau channel.

resp.text: We're so glad the Conly's enjoyed their time at the Wharf. Thanks so much for taking the time to write us a review. We appreciate it!

name: S P
text: Terrific place to visit. Crowded in the summers, or when the cruise ships are in. Perfect in the winters. Great food, especially the halibut and chips and oysters on the half shell. Great service!

name: Heather Warden
text: Awesome food nservice

name: Natasha Hoover
text:
Food was good, view amazing. Sit in the restaurant. Christian was our server and he was great! Super helpful, friendly, answered questions. Also, we were probably the last table of the night sat less than 15 minutes to close and he seemed happy we were there and that he could serve us.

If we were sat immediately in the bar and just met Christian the would be more than a 5 star review. However, we went to the bar first waiting on a table. The bartender seemed uninterested in having more people to help claiming that several seats at the bar were taken by patrons that were outside smoking. Other customers got up while we waited for seats and sat next to these empty seats. Multiple times people tried to sit in these empty bar seats and were greeted with an abrasive bartender asking,  "Do you plan on staying here?" Then after someone's reply she would say there are people sitting here but they are outside smoking. There was two water glasses in those seats that looked like dirty dishes as they were sweating from the completely melted ice that once was in the glass. We sat at the bar for about an hour, I think the hostess forgot we were waiting on a table but that was ok cause a patron sitting next to us was great conversation. If the bartender was our experience here this would be a 2 star review with only the view making up for the stars. Sit in the restaurant. You will get great service and a wo derful view sans attitude from the bartender who doesn't want to tend bar....

name: Ellen Ritzman
text: It was excellent as usual. Wonderful food, great service.

resp.text: Thanks Ellen, we're so glad you came by, and also grateful you took the time to come by and give us this review! Cheers!

name: Lyle Ring
text: Good but overrated in my opinion.  It's crowded, loud, and the food was good but not great.

name: John Hobson
text: Awesome menu, great tap selection. Amazing view of Gastineau Channel.

resp.text: Thanks John!

name: Bonnie Wesselhoff
text: Great location. If you want a booth windowside- make a reservation!

name: Cayla Armatti
text: My favorite restaurant in Juneau, with a varied menu, expecially seafood prepared in many different ways. The Halibut Parmesan is my favorite. I also live their freshly prepared salads.Highly recommend The Hangar. Ask for a table by the window, with a great view.

name: Erin Kirkland
text:
The Hangar's grub is uniquely Alaska, but that's not the only reason we visit. It's the ambience, the view of Gastineau Channel from the windows where float planes, boats, and cruise ships appear.
Staff are very helpful and there are some of the best fries ever here. it can get crowded on cruise ship days, so plan to stand in line; or just go early or late.

name: Kari Hull
text: Fun, upbeat place with good food and good selection of on tap beer

name: Jeff Wood
text: Great tempura halibut fish and chips, crowded when cruise ships in, much more relaxed in the off season

resp.text: Thanks Jeff!

name: Jamie Brown
text: Everyone in our party of 5 greatly enjoyed their meal.  Good service, good food.

name: Curt Sumner
text: Popular with the locals. Good food, good service.

name: Debbie Norris
text: Fantastic food. Grwat view, awesome staff

name: G Lee
text:
Duck L'Orange I asked for rare, or or showing pink in the meat, was overcooked, dry, the orange sauce overly strong.  When they don't ask what doneness level as for a steak, it's a low bar for dining.  And to have it overcooked just ruins it.

Someone else in our group ordered a jack Daniels burger, the plate looked very nicely dressed, but couldn't see the burger.  Our friend exposed the burger, looked like a burnt hockey puck, awful.

name: Larry Smith
text: Expect the place to be busy. Friendly servers and good selection of American food.

name: Kimberly Hendrickson
text: Awesome view!! Friendly staff and good Idaho garlic french fries 😋

name: John Heylin
text: Decent spot. Love the history. And lots of good seafood options. Weird how they have a bar menu and a table menu that have different items, you have to combine the two to figure out exactly what you can order.

resp.text: Glad you had a good time! We have a lunch menu 11am-2pm, the dinner menu starts at 5pm. Our pub menu fills the gap between services and lasts until the bar closes.

name: Darryl Robinson
text: The food is excellent the steak salad was out of this world

name: Louise Holt
text: Great food and service.  Also beautiful view of cruise ships and the cool planes that land and take off from the water.  Really a cool place for tourists.

name: Tevarn kans
text: Great rock cod and chips. Delicious

name: Rainbow Alaska
text: Best spot (well probably the only place in town) for chicken fried steak. The service tends to be very bad though. It's different every time for portion sizes so it's always a hit or miss. I go there typically once a week so it's good enough to keep coming back.

name: Naresh Atmaramani
text: Great place with good food

name: Michelle Bowers
text: Food is great and they have a great atmosphere!

resp.text: Thanks Michelle!

name: Kodak Dirty
text: Halibut, Salmon and King Crab! I’d give 10 stars if I could. Halibut Chowder is the Best. I had the Halibut Caesar three days in a row.

name: Kathy Dittmaier
text: Good burgers and sweet potatoe fries.

name: Jake Byrd
text: Always good food and service here. A bit pricey but no more so than the other places downtown. (I have noticed that portions get smaller here during the summer we will see if that holds true this year)

name: Buck Jones
text: Good shrimp!

name: Adam O
text: Had a great dinner with my parents when they were in town. I love the cod and chips, calamari and sweet potato fries!

resp.text: Great to hear! Thank you.

name: Elisabeth Nyang
text: Would give 3.5 stars. My fish and chips were surprisingly mediocre. Great views of the water. Excellent service.

name: Sarah Struble
text: Service was quick staff was really nice but  everything we had to eat was subpar. Fried mushrooms were huge and tasted slight foul. The loaded fries (cannot remember the exact name) were not fully cooked the cheese was only barely melted. I got a Cobb salad which was the best of the three dishes but was really only adequate. I have eaten here before and it was delish, perhaps just an off night?

name: Kevin Williams
text: The service was very bad and the waiter was very rude. The food was over cooked and the crab dish had shells everywhere in it and management allowed this all. I will not ever go back.

resp.text: Hi Kevin. Really sorry to hear about this experience. I would love the opportunity to hear more about what happened and see if there's anything we can do to make this right, including a refund. Please email me at info@hangaronthewharf.com if you're interested in discussing your experience further. This kind of thing is definitely not acceptable by our management team.

name: Megan Mackiernan
text: Service was just ok but the food was FANTASTIC. I had the halibut chowder bread bowl with a caesar salad.  Amazing!

name: Ernesto Castoza
text: Excellent service and great food

name: S P
text: Amazing views, great food and drinks with friendly staff.

name: Pauline Williams
text:
The only reason I am giving one star is so i can leave a post.
It has been a long time since the last time I ate at The Hanger and I was sorely disappointed in not just the service, but the food too. All of our food orders came at seperate times. I ordered the special of chicken and dumplings which came with dumplings and veggies and a small amount of gravy and NO chicken at all. I had to wait for a bowl of chicken since I was not offered an alternative meal.By the time it came out my bowl of dumplings and slightly cooked veggies was luke warm. I got a cup of coffee and was eventually given a refill but when I tried to take the last drink I got a mouthful of coffee grinds. The server just said well I didn't charge you for the coffee, but looking at the receipt he in fact had charged for the coffee. In my opinion not only should my friend not have been charged for the coffee but my crappy meal should have been compted since I was never offered a different meal. I didn't even eat half of my meal it was so crappy. I think it will be a very longtime before I ever eat there again.

name: Patrick McGonegal
text: This is a local favorite. Consistently good food and friendly waitstaff... And a great view!

name: Janice m. Koch-Carter
text: One of my favorite places to eat and the service is great !!"

name: Joshua Hennig
text: Great restaurant with many tasty choices.  The halibut nachos are delicious and go well with the many beers that they have.  I paired it with a flight of IPAs and it was good!

name: Paige Alden
text: Great pool tables! And drinks of course.

name: Jordan Brazille
text: I wasn't able to get a table, but it looks like a beautiful restaurant and clearly a popular place

name: Alaska Kingz
text: Good service and best fish and chips in town

name: talya j
text: good food. service is bad on occasion.

resp.text: Thanks Talya. Sorry the service wasn't good! If you wouldn't mind sharing more details so we can try and correct our mistakes, please email us at info@hangaronthewharf.com . Thanks for the feedback, it's really appreciated.

name: Dionisia Bostick
text:
Update: After almost a year I returned realizing it was a server who shoved me and he still works there still has a bad attitude but luckily we had a different server, wish I remembered his name, great service, some of the best I've had in Juneau, food was ok, husband got the everything burger, kids had nuggets and fries both please. My petite prime rib was a huge serving but chewy and tough so I wouldnt order that again, I'll try a burger next time or maybe something fried.

9 months ago
The cook walked into me and shoved me and laughed

resp.text: Sorry, would you mind sending an email about this to us?

name: Vanor Blake
text: On the water you can see bald eagles  from your table while u eat. Not cheep eats but good food.

name: Brandon Slater
text: Great food, awesome place to watch the sea planes take off. The ahi salad is incredible!

name: Bill J
text: Pretty decent based on location.  Alot of tourist traps close by.

name: Lexy Lindoff
text: Great customer service, delicious food, and the BEST Crème Brûlée!!!

name: Scotwebs
text: Great view of the harbor and good fried shrimp

name: Mary Katasse
text: Fantastic place to eat and enjoy good company! Customer service is outstanding! :)

resp.text: Thank you, Mary!

name: Simba Nia Blackman
text: over priced and bit great service.

name: Fredrick Nauska
text: I only ever order the tempura halibut fish and chips. Delicious. Good atmosphere.

name: James Ahlgrim
text: Excellent food and staff

resp.text: Thanks James!

name: Alaska Family Guy
text: THEE best halibut and chips in Alaska. I suggest if you serve fish n chips, you come here to sample the standard. Impressive.

name: Michael Marth
text: Definitely recommend taking the tram up Mt Roberts as this provides a gorgeous view of Juneau. The ride up was about five minutes and recommend that you get on the tram facing the harbour as this will allow you to capture the moment. At the top of the mountain, there is a boutique for shopping however step outside and walk up the mountain. We got about 1 mile from the summit where the grade of the mountain increased and recommend good poles for climbing. At this point we stopped as you will encounter snow and we weren’t prepared for hiking on that terrain. Make sure to have a good camera.

text: Great spot to take visiting family and friends. Views can't be beat!

name: Jennie Louwes
text: The Nature Center (and Raptor Center) are within very close proximity to each other and quite a bit smaller than one would expect or anticipate. That being said, The Nature Center is cheerfully and brightly lit and has quite a variety of hands on things for kiddos to touch and marvel at. Close quarters may cause a family to wait on the decking prior to taking their turn inside the building; however, it's worth the wait if looking at various paw prints/tracks, feeling different fur samples, etc. isn't something your kids have had an opportunity to experience before. Be forewarned that The Nature Center also contains a gift shop. Make sure to express, to your bigs and smalls alike, what your intentions are prior to entering in so that ground rules are laid down before being inaindated with all the pretty things😊 Over-all, the Nature Center may be small; but, if you've taken the tram up the side of Mt. Roberts, The Nature Center is a cozy, nice, quaint space to pop on in and see. 5 stars for cleanliness, helpfuness, atmosphere, and hands on science/learning fun for kids.

name: Joseph Dutko
text: Cruising down the beautiful Inner Passage to our last stop in Alaska was this beautiful city of Ketchikan.  Boy, do they get water soaked, their average annual rainfall is 12 & 1/2 Feet, pretty amazing and yes it rained while we were there.  Lots of shops and sights that will entertain and sate  everyone's tastes.  It was hard to say goodbye as we pulled away from pier on our trip down the coast.  Thanks ALASKA, what a beautiful State, and wonderful people wherever you go.  We enjoyed and so will you.

name: Vincent Sabio
text:
The Visitors' Bureau has lots of information (as one would expect), plus free maps and tour information. At the other end of the building, you can arrange tours on site, as well as get information from the tour operators on their tours and packages.

The person working the Information counter (Sharon) didn't seem to be very fond of tourists. She had very little patience for the group in front of us, and initially didn't seem to want to help our group at all. Once we told her what we were looking for, she was much more helpful. She's definitely not the friendliest person in town, though.... 🤨

name: Joyce Parish
text: Best small town Cruise stop. Had loads of fun and barely had time to visit the NPS.  Tongass state park visitor center was another bucket list item for me. Be sure and check it out if you are in Ketchikan Alaska.

name: Gary Crispens
text: This is a great first place to stop when you arrive because they have all of the local knowledge for site seeing, dining, shopping and local history. They will save you time by pointing you to where you want to go and money with discount coupon books for most of the local merchants. Friendly staff are ready to assist so stop on by.

name: Robert Relyea
text:
This is more a tour clearinghouse than your traditional visitors center. Your can book Jay about any tour you want from the vendors, usually for less than you would pay for your excursions from the ships.

The vendors were very accommodating and they were polite not only to us but to each other. They each gave their own spiel, then suggested a competitor with a slightly different offering so they can give their pitch. Then they let you decide.

name: The Nealons
text:
Ketchikan was a most pleasant surprise.
The visitor center was well staffed and friendly.
Start your visit here it is a short easy walk from the cruise port. The views along the way are begging to be made into memories. So take your time and enjoy this spectacular city.
Theres lots to do well within walking distance of the cruise port. Skip the overpriced Tourist Trap tours.
Head out on your own leisurely stroll and Ketch, Ketchikan if you Can.
The rewards will be memories that last a lifetime.

The park is filled with totems along a wide walking path.
Inside the museum we were suprised to fins a wonderful lady sharing her experience in beading.
What a great day in Sitka.

name: Michael Buck
text:
Highliner is a pretty cool coffee shop. It is located right next to Sitka's fire department. It was busy when I went (9am-ish) but it wasn't overwhelming. The atmosphere inside was that of a typical coffee shop. The coffee was outstanding and so was their food! If you're hungry, get their breakfast burrito!!! You'll be good for the day! Their carmelitas are super delicious as well. Prices were reasonable.

Went there again in May 2018 and it was still awesome! Great breakfast food!

name: Steve Johnson
text:
The coffee is good! The cookies are great and the bagel sandwiches are the best.
Smoked salmon bagels! Or a sandwich with spinach, tomatoes and cream cheese is one of the best lunches you can have downtown. A quick bite on the go and a great cup of coffee. If your looking for a slower pace they have tables. Chairs. Couches a nice place to relax and enjoy the nostalgic pictures of the fishing fleet decorating the walls. A highliner is a fisherman who catches well but is also of good character, a safe operator and proper demeanor. This cafe is popular for young adults to bring a date. Gentlemen, remember to seat your date and pay for the drinks a little chivalry and kindness is the sign of a true highliner....
